description:
Solution Architect – AI, Automation & Finance Transformation

 







This role has been designed as ''Onsite' with an expectation that you will primarily work from an HPE office.



Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today's complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what's next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.





Job Description:

 


We are looking for a Solution Architect to own the end-to-end architecture of enterprise AI, automation and analytics solutions across the Finance Transformation portfolio. This is a design-and-decide role with real accountability: the architect sets the target-state architecture, chooses the platforms and patterns, secures approvals from enterprise technology, security and data governance, and then stays close enough to delivery to guarantee that what ships matches what was designed.


The role sits between business intent and technical execution. It translates finance and operations problems — forecasting, reporting, reconciliation, transfer pricing, deal support, backlog analytics — into solution designs that are scalable, secure, governable and supportable, and it holds the line on architecture standards when delivery pressure argues otherwise.

It is an advanced role, but not a detached one. The architect is expected to write code when a pattern needs proving, run the proof of concept personally, and lead engineers and vendor teams through the build rather than handing over a deck and stepping away.



Architecture Ownership

Own the target-state architecture for AI, GenAI, agentic AI and automation solutions across the Finance Transformation portfolio, and maintain the roadmap that moves the estate towards it.Produce solution architecture artefacts to enterprise standard: context and component diagrams, integration and data-flow designs, sequence flows, non-functional requirements, and documented architecture decision records with the options considered and the rationale for the choice. Make and defend build-versus-buy, platform-selection and pattern decisions, stating explicitly the trade-offs in cost, delivery time, supportability and risk.Define reusable reference architectures, solution patterns and shared components so that each new use case starts from an established baseline rather than a blank page.Own non-functional design across performance, scalability, availability, cost, observability and supportability, and set the acceptance thresholds each solution must meet before production.Run design reviews and technical governance forums, and take solutions through enterprise architecture review, security review and data governance approval.Maintain a current view of the solution landscape — what exists, what it depends on, what is being retired — and prevent duplicate or divergent builds across teams.
AI and Agentic Solution Design

Architect LLM and agentic solutions end to end: orchestration and agent topology, tool and function calling, retrieval and grounding strategy, memory and state, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and fallback behaviour when the model is wrong.Design retrieval-augmented generation over enterprise content, including chunking and embedding strategy, index design, source-of-truth selection, freshness and permission-trimmed retrieval.Define the evaluation and assurance approach for AI solutions: golden datasets, accuracy and groundedness measures, regression testing on prompt or model change, and the criteria that decide whether a solution is fit to go live.Design guardrails and responsible-AI controls covering prompt injection, data leakage, hallucination containment, PII handling, auditability of AI-assisted decisions, and the boundary between what the agent decides and what a person approves.Set the model strategy — model selection, routing, versioning, cost and token management, and the approach to upgrades — and revisit it as the platform landscape moves.Determine where machine learning, deterministic automation, or a conventional application is the right answer, and say so plainly when generative AI is not the appropriate tool for the problem.
Design the data architecture underpinning AI and analytics use cases: source systems, ingestion patterns, curated layers, semantic models, lineage and refresh cadence.Architect solutions on Microsoft Azure, Greenlake and Databricks, selecting the appropriate compute, storage, orchestration and serving components for each workload.Design integration architecture across enterprise platforms such as SAP, Salesforce, Anaplan, ServiceNow and Power BI, covering API, event and batch patterns, error handling, idempotency and reconciliation between systems.Define identity, access and secrets architecture using Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, OAuth, managed identities and role-based access control, and ensure least-privilege design is applied rather than assumed.Set the deployment architecture across environments, including CI/CD approach, promotion path, environment parity, configuration management and rollback strategy.Design for control and audit readiness where solutions touch financial data, including SOX-aligned controls, evidence capture, segregation of duties and traceability from output back to source.
Delivery Leadership

Lead engineers, data teams and vendor partners through implementation, reviewing designs and code against the agreed architecture and correcting drift early.Build proofs of concept personally to de-risk unproven patterns, and convert what is learned into a documented pattern the team can reuse.Break large initiatives into deliverable increments with clear technical dependencies, sequencing and defensible estimates.Identify architectural risk, technical debt and single points of failure early, quantify the impact, and put a remediation path in front of decision-makers before it becomes an incident.Support production stabilisation after release, lead root-cause analysis on significant technical failures, and feed the findings back into the architecture.Raise the technical capability of the team through design mentoring, code and design review, internal enablement sessions and written guidance.
Stakeholder and Governance Engagement

Work directly with Finance, Operations and Transformation leadership to understand the business problem behind the request, and challenge the requirement where the stated ask will not deliver the intended outcome.Present architecture, options, cost implications and risk positions to senior business and technology stakeholders, adjusting depth to the audience without diluting the substance.Partner with enterprise architecture, security, infrastructure, DataOps and compliance teams to secure approvals and keep solutions aligned to enterprise standards.Manage vendor and partner technical engagement, including solution assessment, scope definition, design review and acceptance of delivered work.Contribute to portfolio-level planning by advising on feasibility, effort, sequencing and platform readiness across competing initiatives.



Required Skills and Experience

Architecture

Demonstrable experience owning solution architecture for enterprise systems that reached production and remained in service, not proof-of-concept work alone.Strong command of integration architecture, API design, event-driven patterns, and data architecture across transactional and analytical estates.Proven ability to produce architecture documentation and decision records that withstand enterprise architecture and security review.Experience designing for non-functional requirements — scale, resilience, performance, observability and cost — with evidence that the design held in production.
AI and Automation

Hands-on experience architecting and delivering GenAI or LLM-based enterprise solutions, including RAG, tool and function calling, and agentic orchestration.Working knowledge of agentic frameworks and platforms such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, Copilot Studio or equivalent, with a clear view of where each fits.Experience with Azure OpenAI or comparable enterprise LLM platforms, including evaluation, guardrails and cost management at scale.Understanding of the machine learning lifecycle — feature engineering, training, deployment, monitoring and drift — sufficient to architect ML solutions and govern the teams building them.Experience with enterprise automation and RPA platforms, and sound judgement on where automation beats an AI-first approach.
Engineering

Strong hands-on Python, retained and current — able to prototype, review code credibly and debug a production issue.Strong SQL and practical experience with Databricks, cloud data warehouses and modern data pipelines.Solid grounding in Microsoft Azure services, containerisation, CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code practices.Working knowledge of Power BI, Power Platform and the Microsoft 365 ecosystem as delivery surfaces for finance solutions.
Domain

Experience delivering solutions in enterprise Finance — forecasting, financial reporting, reconciliation, transfer pricing, deal desk, tax or order and backlog analytics.Understanding of financial controls, audit expectations and the governance constraints that apply to systems handling financial data.
Preferred Skills

Recognised architecture certification, such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Databricks or TOGAF.Experience establishing AI governance, model risk or responsible-AI frameworks in a regulated enterprise. Experience defining reusable platform capabilities or an internal developer experience adopted across multiple teams.Exposure to FinOps and cloud cost optimisation for AI and data workloads.Experience operating in a global organisation across multiple regions and time zones.
Candidate Profile

Thinks in systems and trade-offs, and can hold both the enterprise view and the implementation detail at once.Makes decisions under incomplete information, records the reasoning, and revises the position when evidence changes.Retains genuine hands-on credibility and earns the respect of engineers by doing the work, not by title.Communicates with equal effectiveness to a CFO stakeholder and to a data engineer.Comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements, and able to shape a defensible scope from an open-ended problem.Willing to say no, or not yet, with reasoning and an alternative attached.Takes ownership beyond the design phase and treats production outcomes as part of the architect's accountability.
Experience and Education

Ten or more years in software engineering, data or AI, including at least three years in a solution architecture or technical lead capacity.A track record of architecting and delivering multiple enterprise solutions into production and through post-release support.Recent hands-on delivery of GenAI or agentic AI solutions in an enterprise setting.Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science or a related discipline. Equivalent industry experience will be considered.

We are partnering with a data-driven consumer business seeking a Senior Manager, Data & Analytics to lead a multidisciplinary data team and act as a strategic partner to senior leadership.

This is a highly visible leadership position combining team management, stakeholder engagement, analytics, business intelligence, and data strategy. The successful candidate will help shape how data is used across the organisation, driving better decision-making through actionable insights and scalable analytical capabilities.

This role would suit an experienced analytics leader who enjoys operating in a player-coach capacity, balancing strategic leadership with hands-on involvement where needed.

The Opportunity
You will lead a small team spanning multiple data disciplines and serve as the primary point of contact for data and analytics across the business.

The role requires someone who can translate complex business questions into analytical solutions, influence senior stakeholders through evidence-based recommendations, and build a high-performing data function that supports commercial growth and operational effectiveness.

Success in this position will come from the ability to combine strong leadership, commercial acumen, analytical thinking, and technical credibility.

Key Responsibilities
Leadership & Team Development

Lead, mentor, and develop a multidisciplinary team covering analytics, business intelligence, reporting, and data management.

Establish clear ownership, priorities, and accountability across the team.

Foster a culture of continuous improvement, collaboration, and delivery excellence.

Act as a player-coach, providing guidance while remaining close enough to the work to unblock challenges and support key initiatives.

Business Partnership

Partner directly with senior business stakeholders to understand priorities and strategic objectives.

Translate business needs into actionable data and analytics initiatives.

Provide thought leadership and challenge assumptions through data-driven insights.

Influence decision-making through effective communication and storytelling.

Analytics & Insights

Drive analysis across customer, commercial, operational, and financial performance.

Identify opportunities, risks, trends, and areas for improvement.

Deliver meaningful recommendations that lead to measurable business outcomes.

Establish and evolve KPI frameworks that support organisational performance.

Data & Reporting

Oversee reporting, data quality, governance, and analytical processes.

Partner closely with technical teams to ensure scalable and sustainable data solutions.

Improve analytics capabilities, reporting structures, and business visibility into performance.

Support adoption of modern analytical approaches, including AI-enabled tooling and predictive analytics where appropriate.

Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, scalability, and decision-making through technology.

Required Experience

6+ years of experience in Analytics, Business Intelligence, Data Science, or related disciplines.

Previous people leadership experience, including team development and performance management.

Experience leading broad data functions rather than a single specialist discipline.

A proven track record of partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing decisions.

Experience working within fast-paced, data-rich business environments.

Technical Requirements

Advanced SQL proficiency.

Strong experience with modern BI and visualisation platforms such as Looker, Omni, Tableau, Power BI, or similar.

Understanding of data pipelines, data transformation processes, reporting environments, and data quality principles.

Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and engineering teams.

 Daily catered lunches in our San Francisco office



 
 

 At Hayden AI, we are committed to creating an inclusive and diverse workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity. We believe that our differences make us stronger and drive innovation. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate against any employee or applicant based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. We are dedicated to fostering a work environment that celebrates diversity and ensures that every individual has the opportunity to contribute to our mission and achieve their full potential. 


 Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Hayden AI employees or any other company location. Hayden AI is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.


 
 




 
 About Us
 At Hayden AI, we are on a mission to harness the power of computer vision to transform the way transit systems and other government agencies address real-world challenges.


 From bus lane and bus stop enforcement to transportation optimization technologies and beyond, our innovative mobile perception system empowers our clients to accelerate transit, enhance street safety, and drive toward a sustainable future.


 About the Deep Learning Team
 The Deep learning team's work is at the crux of Hayden AI's solutions to its customers. The team is responsible for building and maintaining advanced models that are able to perceive the world and the knowledge produced by the models is used downstream to implement various customer use-cases. The team runs a number of models both in the cloud as well as on the edge device serving different scenarios. The team also works closely with the platform team to build out Hayden AI's MLOps infrastructure to achieve better scale and reliability.


 

 
 
 
 About the Role
 As a Deep Learning Engineer at Hayden, you will make key contributions towards building foundational AI capabilities for Hayden that will enable solving complex problems for Hayden AI Customers. In this role, you will build, train, evaluate and deploy state of the art ML models in production at scale. You will report into the Director of AI within the Perception Org and work closely with other engineering as well as product teams to deliver value to Hayden AI customers. We are looking for someone who has familiarity with or growing expertise in at least one of the verticals below — depth in a specific area is valued but not required on day one.


 
 
 
 3D vision models to predict depth and 3D structure,


 
 
 
 Video/temporal behavior models to predict intent,


 
 
 
 Deep understanding of Vision language models and hands-on experience fine tuning them,


 
 
 
 Deep understanding of foundation models in perception.


 
 
 
 Deep knowledge of Nvidia edge device stack for running ML models and cuda know-how in terms delivering highly optimized models


 
 
 This position is based in San Francisco and follows a hybrid schedule with at least 3 days in-office per week.


 


 Key Responsibilities
 Below are your primary responsibilities. These represent the core areas where you'll make an impact. As part of a rapidly evolving team, we look forward to your impact expanding over time.


 
 
 Come up with solutions to complex problems in perception using deep learning.


 
 Articulate ideas both verbally and in written form culminating in clear design and project plan docs for their work


 
 Contribute to team roadmap and planning


 
 Work with cross functional teams across the company and contribute towards delivery of end to end solutions for the customer


 
 


 Required Qualifications
 The qualifications below outline the experience and skills most relevant to success in this role. We recognize that skills and potential come in many forms, and we welcome diverse experiences that advance our mission.


 
 
 Experience: 1-2 years experience building and deploying machine learning models for perception in production settings.


 
 Core Skills: Solid hands-on experience designing, training, and evaluating machine learning models for perception. Demonstrated ability to independently build ML pipelines and deploy models to cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure); familiarity with MLOps practices including experiment tracking, model versioning, and automated workflows. Hands-on experience in PyTorch, Python, and related skills.


 
 Personal Attributes:Good communicator, self starter and ability to collaborate with others, quick learner who can adapt to a fast paced startup culture


 
 Education: Bachelors or Masters in Computer Science or related field


 
 Nice to Have: Experience working in perception problems in self driving car companies that aligns closely with the work of this team.

Holland's Rail Measurement Systems and Services (RMSS) provide railroad track measurement and testing services and technologies since 1995. RMSS Product Development Team design, build and deploy track inspection and measurement systems domestically and internationally. The product line includes hi-rail, rail-bound and locomotive attended and autonomous measurement systems.

We are seeking a Computer Vision Engineering Intern for a full-time summer internship (40 hours per week). The intern will develop image processing algorithms for our track geometry and rail profile measurement systems, and develop and optimize image recognition algorithms for video recordings. Final-year undergraduate and graduate (Master's or PhD) students are preferred.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop image processing algorithms for camera- and laser-based rail profile and track geometry measurement. Develop, train, and optimize image recognition models to detect track features and assets in video recordings. Prepare and label image and video datasets from field recordings. Test algorithm accuracy and speed against reference data, and document results. Work with the software team to integrate prototypes and present final results to the team. 

Basic Qualifications

 Final-year Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD student in Computer Science, Electrical/Computer Engineering, or a related field. Coursework or project experience in computer vision, image processing, or machine learning. Proficiency in Python and OpenCV; experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. Available to work 40 hours per week on-site for the full summer. 

Preferred Qualifications

 C++ and/or GPU (CUDA) experience. Experience with object detection on video, camera calibration, or laser/3D measurement. Interest in railway or infrastructure inspection. 

Physical And Environmental Requirements

 Primarily office and lab work; occasional outdoor field work near railroad tracks with required PPE. Ability to lift up to 25 lbs. with or without reasonable accommodation.

description:
Become a part of our caring community



Become a Part of Our Caring Community



Humana is seeking a Lead Applied Scientist to design, develop, and scale intelligent decision systems powering our Next Best Action (NBA) platform.



Our platform combines machine learning, reinforcement learning, and decision intelligence to deliver personalized recommendations that improve healthcare experiences and outcomes for millions of members.



We are looking for a hands-on technical leader who can translate complex business problems into scalable, production-ready decision systems. The ideal candidate combines strong machine learning expertise with an understanding of decision science and software engineering.



This role goes beyond building predictive models. You will have end-to-end ownership of models and decision policies, from initial prototyping and experimentation through offline evaluation, simulation, testing, production deployment, and ongoing monitoring. You will help define how intelligent systems make decisions, evaluate their behavior under real-world constraints and uncertainty, and continuously improve their performance based on production outcomes.



Key Responsibilities



Machine Learning and Reinforcement Learning



Design, develop, and improve machine learning and reinforcement learning models for personalized recommendations, sequential decision making, and policy learning.



Decision Intelligence and Simulation



Apply decision science, operations research, and simulation techniques to formulate complex decision problems, evaluate alternatives, and improve outcomes under business and operational constraints.



Scalable ML Engineering



Develop and improve production ML pipelines using Python, PyTorch, Databricks, PySpark, Ray RLlib, and MLflow, supporting large-scale data processing, model training, and inference.



Model Evaluation and Experimentation



Design experiments, simulations, offline evaluations, and performance metrics to assess model effectiveness, policy behavior, decision quality, and business impact before and after deployment.



Production Deployment and Monitoring



Own models and decision policies throughout their lifecycle, from prototyping and testing through production deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Partner with software engineering and platform teams to ensure production systems are scalable, reliable, and observable.



Constraint-Aware Decision Making



Incorporate clinical eligibility, member preferences, business rules, operational capacity, and other constraints into intelligent decision systems.



Technical Leadership



Provide technical direction on model architecture, algorithm selection, evaluation methods, engineering best practices, and system design while collaborating with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.



Use your skills to make an impact



Required Qualifications




Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, or a related quantitative field.


6+ years of professional experience in machine learning, applied science, decision science, or related engineering disciplines.


Strong experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, and monitoring machine learning solutions in production environments.


Solid understanding of reinforcement learning, sequential decision making, or other advanced decision-making techniques.


Strong Python programming skills and experience with machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.


Experience with distributed data processing and ML platforms such as Databricks, PySpark, Ray, or equivalent technologies.


Strong software engineering fundamentals, including software architecture, code quality, automated testing, and scalable system design.


Demonstrated ability to translate complex business problems into analytical models and production solutions.


Demonstrated experience owning models across the full lifecycle, including prototyping, offline evaluation, simulation, testing, deployment, and production monitoring.




Preferred Qualifications




Experience with reinforcement learning algorithms, contextual bandits, Markov Decision Processes, or offline policy evaluation.


Experience with operations research, simulation, or decision analysis.


Familiarity with MLflow, Ray RLlib, Databricks, and distributed model training.


Experience developing recommendation systems, personalization platforms, or Next Best Action solutions.


Experience with event-driven architectures, Kafka, Redis, or rule-based decision engines.


Familiarity with decision mapping, multi-objective decision making, and decision making under uncertainty.


Experience monitoring deployed models and policies for changes in performance, data distributions, and decision behavior.


Experience within healthcare, insurance, or other regulated industries.




Additional Information

description:
Introduction A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact.


At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.


Your Role and Responsibilities As an Applied AI Specialist, you will drive the design, implementation, and management of AI-driven solutions that operationalize AI-first Application Management Services. This role involves collaboration with various stakeholders to deliver scalable, user-centric AI capabilities that automate workflows and improve service delivery, leveraging expertise in AI solution delivery and operational governance.


Your primary responsibilities will include:


 Solution Design: Translate business and operational requirements into scalable, user-centric AI capabilities that automate workflows, augment decision-making, and improve service delivery.


 AI Implementation: Implement and manage AI-driven solutions that integrate with observability, telemetry, event management, and operational monitoring platforms to enable intelligent automation and incident response.


 Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize agent performance through model evaluation, prompt refinement, agent configuration, and logic enhancements to improve accuracy, reliability, and business outcomes.


 Operational Governance: Maintain operational governance of AI solutions by managing production stability, performance thresholds, compliance requirements, risk controls, and responsible AI practices.


 Stakeholder Collaboration: Collaborate with application operations, platform operations, engineering, architecture, and business stakeholders to design, deploy, and continuously improve agent-based solutions.


 This position can be performed from anywhere in the United States.
Required Education Bachelor's Degree
Required Technical and Professional Expertise 

 AI Solution Delivery: Deep expertise in designing, implementing, and managing AI-driven solutions that operationalize AI-first Application Management Services. Experience with translating business and operational requirements into scalable, user-centric AI capabilities.


 AI Integration: Experience with integrating AI agents with observability, telemetry, event management, and operational monitoring platforms to enable intelligent automation and incident response.


 Agent Performance Optimization: Experience in monitoring and optimizing agent performance through model evaluation, prompt refinement, agent configuration, and logic enhancements to improve accuracy, reliability, and business outcomes.


 Operational Governance: Deep expertise in maintaining operational governance of AI solutions, including managing production stability, performance thresholds, compliance requirements, risk controls, and responsible AI practices.


 AI Technology Utilization: Experience with utilizing Agentic AI frameworks, AI orchestration platforms, observability tools, telemetry systems, event management solutions, and automation technologies to deliver scalable and sustainable AI-enabled operations.


 Preferred Technical and Professional Experience Advanced AI Frameworks: Experience with utilizing Agentic AI frameworks to deliver scalable AI-enabled operations.


 AI Orchestration Tools: Knowledge of AI orchestration platforms and automation technologies to improve service delivery.


 Telemetry Systems Expertise: Familiarity with telemetry systems and event management solutions to enable intelligent automation.


 About Business Unit IBM Consulting is IBM's consulting and global professional services business, with market leading capabilities in business and technology transformation. With deep expertise in many industries, we offer strategy, experience, technology, and operations services to many of the most innovative and valuable companies in the world. Our people are focused on accelerating our clients' businesses through the power of collaboration.
We believe in the power of technology responsibly used to help people, partners, and the planet.


Your Life @ IBM In a world where technology never stands still, we understand that dedication to our clients' success, innovation that matters, and trust and personal responsibility in all our relationships, live in what we do as IBMers as we strive to be the catalyst that makes the world work better.


Being an IBMer means you'll be able to learn and develop yourself and your career, you'll be encouraged to be courageous and experiment every day, all whilst having continuous trust and support in an environment where everyone can thrive whatever their personal or professional background.


Our IBMers are growth minded, always staying curious, open to feedback, and learning new information and skills to constantly transform themselves and our company. They are trusted to provide ongoing feedback to help other IBMers grow, as well as collaborate with colleagues, keeping in mind a team-focused approach to include different perspectives to drive exceptional outcomes for our customers. The courage our IBMers have to make critical decisions every day is essential to IBM becoming the catalyst for progress, always embracing challenges with resources they have to hand, a can-do attitude, and always striving for an outcome-focused approach within everything that they do.


Are you ready to be an IBMer?


About IBM IBM's greatest invention is the IBMer. We believe that through the application of intelligence, reason, and science, we can improve business, society, and the human condition, bringing the power of an open hybrid cloud and AI strategy to life for our clients and partners around the world.


Restlessly reinventing since 1911, we are not only one of the largest corporate organizations in the world, we're also one of the biggest technology and consulting employers, with many of the Fortune 500 companies relying on the IBM Cloud to run their business.


At IBM, we pride ourselves on being an early adopter of artificial intelligence, quantum computing, and blockchain. Now it's time for you to join us on our journey to being a responsible technology innovator and a force for good in the world.


IBM is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, pregnancy, disability, neurodivergence, age, or other characteristics protected by the applicable law. IBM is also committed to compliance with all fair employment practices regarding citizenship and immigration status.


Other Relevant Job Details IBM offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program. Eligible employees may have access to:


 Healthcare benefits including medical & prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, and mental health & well-being Financial programs such as 401(k), cash balance pension plan, the IBM Employee Stock Purchase Plan, financial counseling, life insurance, short & long-term disability coverage, and opportunities for performance-based salary incentive programs Generous paid time off including 12 holidays, minimum 56 hours sick time, 120 hours vacation, 12 weeks parental bonding leave in accordance with IBM Policy, and other Paid Care Leave programs. IBM also offers paid family leave benefits to eligible employees where required by applicable law Training and educational resources on our personalized, AI-driven learning platform where IBMers can grow skills and obtain industry-recognized certifications to achieve their career goals Diverse and inclusive employee resource groups, giving & volunteer opportunities, and discounts on retail products, services & experiences We consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable law.

The compensation range and benefits for this position are based on a full-time schedule for a full calendar year. The salary will vary depending on your job-related skills, experience, and location. Pay increment and frequency of pay will be in accordance with employment classification and applicable laws. For part-time roles, your compensation and benefits will be adjusted to reflect your hours. Benefits may be pro-rated for those who start working during the calendar year.

Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

Databricks Solution Architect to define and lead the end-to-end architecture for a large data modernization program. You will bring deep expertise across cloud-based engineering, Databricks platform, data migration, data modeling, data architecture, data engineering, and reporting, and connect governed data products to ML, GenAI, and advanced AI solutions across hyperscalers.

Responsibilities

 Define the target data and AI architecture across the AWS/Databricks data platform and GCP-based ML/GenAI services, and the integration patterns between them. Lead the data migration architecture: re-engineering approach, migration patterns, Integration & Ingestion patterns, sequencing, cutover, reconciliation, and risk management. Own data architecture and data modeling standards, covering conceptual, logical, and physical models, lakehouse/medallion layers, and data product design. Define data engineering patterns and standards for ingestion (Fivetran), transformation, orchestration, CI/CD, observability, and cost control on cloud-based platforms. Architect the reporting and analytics layer, including semantic models, governed metrics, and self-service access on top of data products. Design the ML/GenAI lifecycle: feature engineering, model training and serving, RAG and agentic patterns, MLOps/LLMOps, monitoring, and evaluation. Architect secure, scalable cross-cloud data movement and integration across hyperscalers (AWS, Microsoft Azure, GCP), selecting services based on fit, cost, and performance. Ensure the architecture uses data products from the Databricks lakehouse, including SAP-sourced data via SAP BTP / BDC Connect. Define security, data privacy, responsible AI, and governance guardrails for AI use cases. Provide architectural oversight on related initiatives, such as the Tier-1 application migration from MySQL to Databricks Lakebase. Evaluate and shape the roadmap for advanced AI capabilities (agentic AI, frontier models, and emerging superintelligence-class technologies) as they apply to the client. Lead architecture reviews and communicate design decisions to executive and technical stakeholders. Design end-to-end architectures that embed AI capabilities into enterprise applications and workflows, defining reference patterns for AI services, models, and orchestration layers that integrate with existing systems, APIs, and data platforms. Collaborate with stakeholders to translate business objectives into scalable, resilient, and policy-compliant designs, balancing vendor-managed services with custom development and meeting performance, security, compliance, and cost objectives. Drive governance for AI integration: prompts, guardrails, and lifecycle management, with observability, privacy, and responsible AI principles embedded from design through operations.

This job can be performed from anywhere in the US

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

 Must be able to travel 4 days per week (mandatory). Databricks Certified Data Engineer or Machine Learning Professional, with proven expertise architecting enterprise-scale data, AI/ML, and Generative AI solutions. Advanced expertise in data/solution architecture, enterprise data migration, data modelling, lakehouse/data-product architecture, reporting, and cloud-based data engineering using Databricks and AWS. Hands-on experience with Spark (PySpark and/or Scala, Spark SQL), Delta Lake, MLflow, Unity Catalog, and large-scale batch and streaming workloads. Experience with open table formats, including Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg, and modern data-sharing patterns such as Delta Sharing and Lakehouse Federation. Experience architecting enterprise AI/GenAI solutions, including RAG, agents, MLOps/LLMOps, observability, guardrails, privacy, and responsible AI, with working knowledge of AWS, Azure, and GCP. Strong expertise in integration, security, and architecture leadership, including APIs, microservices, event-driven patterns, Kafka, and Amazon EventBridge/SQS, with strong technical and executive-level communication.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

 Knowledge of SAP BTP, SAP Business Data Cloud, SAP-native data products, and SAP IS-U. Experience with Fivetran, Databricks Lakebase, OLTP-to-lakehouse patterns, Collibra, Erwin, or ER Studio. Advanced knowledge of AI orchestration, RAG/hybrid reasoning, microservices, and AI governance tooling. Experience with reporting and analytics architecture, including semantic layers and BI delivery on a lakehouse. Experience in the utilities or energy industry, with relevant cloud or Databricks architecture certifications.

Launch your career like an IBMer

Every IBMer has a story. For many, it started with an internship.

As an IBM co-op, you won't just gain experience - you'll start thinking, working, and growing like an IBMer. From day one, you'll contribute to real client projects across diverse industries, working alongside experienced IBMers who are invested in your success. High-performing interns have a clear pathway into IBM's Associate Program, launching careers at one of the world's most innovative technology and consulting companies.

About The Team

In this role, you will join IBM's US Federal team to deliver secure, mission-critical technology solutions for government agencies. You'll work with federal, state, and local clients while developing specialized expertise in government compliance and security standards. This role offers unique career growth in a high-demand sector where your contributions directly impact public services and government missions.

Your Role And Responsibilities

During your co-op experience, you can enhance your knowledge and gain professional experience by working on client projects. This role provides an exceptional opportunity to build a compelling portfolio, acquire new skills, gain insights into diverse industries, and embrace novel challenges for your future career.

At IBM, we prioritize continuous learning, skill development, and personal growth within a culture of coaching and mentorship. As a co-op, you'll experience this culture and have the opportunity to advance to our associate program based on results and performance.

Mentored Analytical Support: Receive mentorship from diverse professionals in science engineering and consulting applying analytical rigor and statistical methods to predict behaviors.Data Integrations: Develop skills in writing efficient and reusable programs to cleanse integrate and model data. Gain exposure to cloud platforms, ETL tools, and data integration, expanding your tech toolkit.

The primary internship program dates are May 24, 2027 and end May 26, 2028. This role requires candidates to work in University Park, PA.

Candidates must have the ability to obtain and maintain a Federal security clearance while in IBM Consulting-Federal.

To give yourself the best opportunity for success, we advise applying only to roles that align with your skills and experience, rather than applying broadly across all entry-level positions. description:
POSITION INFORMATION

Department / Function: Engineering – IPG Defense
Reports To: Chief Engineer
Work Location: Huntsville, AL
Employment Type: Full-time (Exempt)
Travel: Less than 10%; occasional travel to field test sites.
Security / Clearance: Not required; active DoD security clearance preferred.

ABOUT IPG DEFENSE
IPG Defense, a stand‐alone business of IPG Photonics, was incorporated in 2026 to provide direct support for defense products. Headquartered in Huntsville, AL, IPG Defense is bringing commercial scale to laser defense systems, leveraging IPG Photonics' 36 years of experience in fiber laser technology. Our mission: develop and deliver the most advanced, next‐generation laser defense solutions for military and civilian use — systems that accurately and reliably detect, track, target, and neutralize threats.


IPG Photonics is the world's leading developer and manufacturer of high‐performance fiber lasers and amplifiers for diverse applications in numerous markets. Founded in 1990, IPG pioneered the development and commercialization of optical fiber‐based lasers — a critical technology in our high‐energy laser (HEL) systems, including the CROSSBOW program.


Your skills and experience will play a key role in shaping our growing organization, building our capabilities, and delivering on our mission. Join us and build a career that will shape the future of laser defense.


POSITION SUMMARY
The Software Engineer – Computer Vision develops real‐time image‐processing and tracking algorithms supporting beam control, target acquisition, and stabilization in defense laser platforms. Working at the intersection of optics, sensors, and software, this role enables IPG's directed‐energy systems to perform with precision under dynamic field conditions. This opening targets a mid‐level engineer; junior and senior candidates may also be considered, with level determined by experience and qualifications.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Design and implement computer‐vision algorithms for object detection, optical flow, and target tracking.
Develop tracking and state‐estimation pipelines (e.g., Kalman filtering, track initiation and maintenance) for maneuvering targets in cluttered scenes.
Integrate vision pipelines with gimbals, sensors, and beam‐steering hardware.
Optimize GPU‐accelerated code on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson, including CUDA and TensorRT deployment.
Process EO/IR imagery to support laser targeting and feedback control, including camera calibration and sensor characterization.
Build data, simulation, and playback tooling to evaluate algorithm performance against recorded and synthetic scenarios.
Support modeling, field testing, and algorithm performance validation.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
3–7 years of experience in real‐time computer vision or image processing (junior and senior candidates considered at the appropriate level).
Proficiency in C++ and Python, with OpenCV on Linux.
Experience with real‐time, low‐latency video processing pipelines, including color correction and optical‐flow techniques.
Experience with GPU acceleration (CUDA) for latency‐sensitive applications.
Familiarity with optical systems and sensor calibration.
Strong written and verbal communication skills for cross‐disciplinary collaboration.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Active DoD security clearance.
Experience with multi‐target tracking, state estimation (EKF/UKF), or data‐association methods.
Experience with deep‐learning‐based detection and classification (PyTorch or TensorFlow) and edge deployment (TensorRT).
Experience in beam stabilization or adaptive‐optics control.
Knowledge of high‐speed camera integration and EO/IR sensor phenomenology.
Prior defense or aerospace program participation.
Master's degree or PhD in a related field.

WORK ENVIRONMENT & PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS

Lab and test‐range environments; laser‐safety PPE required.

WHY JOIN IPG DEFENSE

Work at the forefront of directed‐energy and photonics innovation on systems that matter to national security.
Vertically integrated technology: we design and build our own lasers, giving engineers end‐to‐end ownership from component to fielded system.
Small, expert, fast‐moving team in Huntsville, AL — one of the nation's fastest‐growing aerospace and defense hubs.
Career growth through hands‐on work across the full product lifecycle: concept, prototype, integration, field test, and production.
Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package — see Compensation & Benefits below.

description:
Ibotta is seeking a Data Scientist, Strategic Partner Analytics to join our Publisher Insights team and contribute to our mission to Make Every Purchase Rewarding. Our team leverages the latest developments and best practices in data analyses, testing methodologies, and statistics to provide actionable insights to the Marketing Team.

 As a Data Scientist, you'll work on our Rewards Optimization models, which use uplift modeling to deliver personalized treatments in our weekly retention programs. You'll own these models end to end, from working with stakeholders and preparing data through model development, production deployment, and ongoing monitoring. You'll be able to advance not only your technical skills, but your organizational and leadership skills as well, by contributing to the creation of best practices for the team and company, and learning from the more senior scientists and managers on the team.

 This position is located in Denver, Colorado as a hybrid position requiring 3 days in office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday). Candidates must live in the United States.



Not based in Denver? We will offer a relocation bonus to help make your move to the Mile High City a smooth one.

 What you will be doing:

 Build, retrain, and tune the uplift models that decide which bonus each saver receives in our weekly retention programs, balancing incremental redemptions against cost.

Own these models in production: maintain feature pipelines, deploy new model versions, and monitor performance and drift over time, following Ibotta's model development standards.

Manage weekly model operations: review results as they come in, adjust model parameters to stay on budget, and within performance thresholds.

Help design and analyze the A/B tests and holdouts that measure bonus performance and produce training data for our models.

Report model performance and business impact to Marketing stakeholders, and explain results clearly to non-technical audiences.

Analyze large datasets on saver behavior to find insights that improve our models and marketing programs.

Work with analytics engineers, data engineers, and Marketing partners to find, define, and prepare the data needed for analysis and modeling.

Contribute to team best practices, including documentation, code review, and reusable modeling workflows.

Embrace and uphold Ibotta's Core Values: Integrity, Boldness, Ownership, Teamwork, Transparency, & A good idea can come from anywhere.

 What we are looking for:

2+ years of progressive experience in a professional data science, machine learning, statistics, or data analysis role, or related experience.

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Data Science, Economics or similar field required; Advanced degree preferred.

Deep Python (pandas, scikit-learn) and SQL skills. Spark or PySpark experience is a strong plus.

Hands-on experience building and evaluating machine learning and statistical models, such as gradient boosting and neural networks (TensorFlow/Keras or PyTorch).

Working knowledge of experimentation and causal inference. Exposure to uplift or heterogeneous treatment effect modeling is a strong plus.

Experience deploying or maintaining at least one model in production, using Git and an orchestration tool such as Airflow or Databricks Jobs. Experience with model monitoring and drift detection is a plus.

Experience building features from large, event-level datasets.

Comfortable using AI coding assistants, and able to review, test, and debug the code they produce.

A passion for driving important decisions using data and data storytelling, including explaining model results and trade-offs to non-technical partners.

Experience with marketing incentives, promotions, loyalty, or retention programs, or with models that balance competing goals such as volume and cost, is a plus.



About Ibotta (“I bought a...”)


 Ibotta (NYSE: IBTA) is a leading performance marketing platform allowing brands to deliver digital promotions to over 200 million consumers through a network of publishers called the Ibotta Performance Network (IPN). The IPN allows marketers to influence what people buy, and where and how often they shop – all while paying only when their campaigns directly result in a sale. American shoppers have earned over $2.6 billion through the IPN since 2012. The largest tech IPO in history to come out of Colorado, Ibotta is headquartered in Denver, and is continually listed as a top place to work by The Denver Post and Inc. Magazine.

description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.


 
 Scope of the Role:


 

 


 We are looking for detail-oriented Voice Specialists to evaluate the performance of AI models through real-time, voice-based conversations. In this role, you will interact with two different AI models using the same assigned scenario, carefully compare their responses, and provide structured evaluations based on defined quality criteria.


 The goal of the evaluation is to create a fair, consistent comparison between models and identify which model delivers the stronger overall conversational experience.


 What You'll Own:


 
 Review an assigned scenario and roleplay a natural conversation with two different AI models.
 Conduct comparable conversations with Model A and Model B, keeping the scenario, conversational approach, and overall interaction as consistent as possible.
 Maintain approximately the same number of conversational turns with each model to support a fair comparison.
 Record your voice during each interaction and pay close attention to the quality and behavior of the model's responses.
 Evaluate each model across five defined evaluation dimensions.
 Identify and categorize relevant error clusters that may occur in the audio or conversation.
 Compare the performance of Model A and Model B based on the evaluation criteria and your observations.
 Select the model that demonstrated the stronger overall performance according to the defined evaluation framework.
 Write a detailed rationale explaining your final preference, referencing specific examples and observations from both conversations.
 Apply evaluation guidelines consistently across different scenarios and model interactions
 
 You'll Thrive in This Role If You Have


 
 Bachelors Degree
 Strong attention to detail and ability to notice subtle differences in conversational quality.
 Excellent listening and comprehension skills.
 Strong written communication skills, particularly the ability to explain observations clearly and objectively.
 Ability to follow detailed evaluation guidelines consistently.
 Comfort speaking naturally and roleplaying different conversational scenarios.
 Ability to compare two interactions fairly without allowing personal preferences to influence the evaluation.
 Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills.
 Reliability and consistency when completing structured evaluation tasks.
 Familiarity with AI assistants, voice-based AI, or conversational systems
 
 The expected hourly salary range for this position is $20-$25 p/hour, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.


 


 
 

 Please be aware of recruitment scams involving individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent employers. Innodata will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the application process. To learn more on how to recognize job scams, please visit the Federal Trade Commission's guide at https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.


 If you believe you've been targeted by a recruitment scam, please report it to Innodata at verifyjoboffer@innodata.com and consider reporting it to the FTC at ReportFraud.ftc.gov.

What You'll Need to Succeed: 

Qualifications

•3–5 years of experience in procurement analytics, sourcing operations, supply chain analytics, or a related field

•Advanced analytical and reporting skills, including experience with Excel, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

•Ability to work with large, complex datasets and translate findings into actionable insights for operational and executive audiences.

•Strong understanding of sourcing and procurement processes, spend analytics, savings methodologies, and key performance metrics.

•Excellent communication, data storytelling, and stakeholder management skills, with strong attention to detail and data integrity.

•Ability to manage multiple priorities, work independently, and drive projects to completion.




Preferred

•Experience with spend analytics, ERP, procurement, or supplier management platforms (e.g., SpendHQ, Coupa, SAP, Oracle, Jaggaer, Ivalua, Ariba).

•Experience partnering with Finance on spend reconciliation, savings validation, and reporting.




What Success Looks Like in Year One

•Deliver trusted dashboards, reporting, and self-service analytics that improve sourcing visibility and reduce ad hoc reporting requests.

•Establish accurate, Finance-aligned sourcing data that provides clear visibility into spend, savings, demand trends, and sourcing performance.

•Enable data-driven decision making through improved spend governance, category insights, and resource planning.




Role Overview:

The Senior Data Analyst, Sourcing Operations transforms procurement and sourcing data into actionable insights that support strategic sourcing decisions, operational efficiency, savings tracking, and executive reporting. This role partners closely with Sourcing Operations, Finance, and IT to maintain data integrity, develop scalable reporting solutions, and provide analytics that drive category strategy, spend visibility, and organizational planning.




What You'll Do: 

Spend Analytics & Category Intelligence

•Develop and maintain spend analytics, including spend cubes, managed vs. unmanaged spend reporting, supplier utilization, category trends, and spend segmentation.

•Analyze supplier concentration, tail spend, maverick spend, pricing trends, and contract coverage to identify savings, consolidation, and sourcing opportunities.

•Build the analytical foundation for category strategies by evaluating spend patterns, business demand, risk, and growth trends.

Reporting, Dashboards & Insights

•Develop and maintain executive and operational dashboards for spend, savings, sourcing performance, pipeline activity, and business demand.

•Deliver data-driven insights and presentation-ready reporting that support leadership decision-making, category planning, and resource prioritization.

•Drive operational efficiencies through reporting automation, process optimization, and data-driven decision support.

Data Governance & Systems Integrity

•Own the accuracy, consistency, and integrity of sourcing and procurement data across sourcing, procurement, contract management, and reporting platforms.

•Perform data audits, resolve discrepancies, maintain data standards, and partner with IT and Finance to ensure reliable system integrations and reporting.

•Establish and maintain data definitions, governance processes, and a single source of truth for sourcing data.

Savings & Value Management

•Maintain sourcing savings tracking and reporting, including projected versus realized savings and total cost of ownership (TCO) metrics.

•Partner with Finance to validate savings methodologies, reconcile spend data, and ensure reporting accuracy.

•Report progress against sourcing goals and communicate realized business value to leadership.

Business Demand & Strategic Planning

•Analyze spend, consumption, and sourcing request trends to identify business growth patterns and emerging sourcing needs.

•Support workforce planning, category prioritization, and sourcing strategy development through data-driven recommendations.

•Identify opportunities to expand sourcing coverage, improve compliance, and optimize resource allocation across the organization.

description:
SUMMARY Supports claims operations by maintaining and organizing accurate claims data in collaboration with the Claims Manager and Director of Risk Management. Creates routine and ad hoc reports, dashboards, and summaries to support reporting and decision-making. Reviews data for accuracy and completeness, resolving errors and inconsistencies as needed. Tracks claims activity trends and processes high-risk activity and travel requests following established procedures. Maintains organized records to support audits, legal requests, and public records requirements. Helps ensure timely, accurate information is available to support effective claims management across the District.




ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following.




To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.




Collaborate with Claims Manager and Director of Risk Management to refine reporting specifications, define required data fields within the risk management information system (RMIS), and improve the consistency and functionality of claims data and reporting tools.




Standardize incoming data (incident reports, medical invoices, internal logs) by applying naming conventions, data validation rules, and controlled vocabularies to support accurate reporting.




Create analysis-ready datasets by transforming raw RMIS extracts (e.g. Excel files) using established data-cleaning routines, field mapping, normalization, controlled vocabulary alignment, and key-field matching.




Assist in organizing, sorting, filtering, and coding claims data to support operational reporting needs.




Perform routine data audits to identify missing information, duplicate records, or data inconsistencies.




Run scheduled (weekly, monthly, quarterly) and ad-hoc reports using established templates, and compile spreadsheets, lists, and charts for the Claims Manager or Director of Risk Management.




Analyze claims data to identify patterns, root causes, and emerging risks, and communicate findings to the Claims Manager and Director of Risk Management.




Track and monitor trends in incident types, common injuries, and reporting patterns using established spreadsheets and district templates.




Prepare data reports and visualizations (charts, graphs, tables) that clearly communicate trends and respond to leadership requests regarding claims activity and losses in the district.




Review and process high-risk activity (HRA) and travel requests in a timely manner in accordance with established procedures. Maintain shared tracking tools, document follow-up actions and materials received and prepare summary information for Claims Manager and Director of Risk Management and cross-functional partners.




Maintain retention-ready electronic records by applying consistent file structures, metadata standards, and appropriate access controls within shared repositories. Assemble data packets and structured exports to support audits, legal discovery, and Colorado Open Records Act (CORA) responses under the direction of the Claims Manager and Director of Risk Management, ensuring completeness and data privacy compliance.




Perform other duties as assigned.




EXPERIENCE: Three (3) years' of experience in data heavy administrative support, claims/benefits operations, analytics support, or related fields with strong Excel proficiency.




EDUCATION AND TRAINING: High School degree required. Post-secondary education, including two years towards a Bachelor's degree and/or an Associate's Degree is strongly preferred.




CERTIFICATES, LICENSES & REGISTRATIONS: None.




KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Knowledge of claims administration processes, risk management practices, and the use of risk management information systems (RMIS) within a public sector or educational environment, including general familiarity with workers' compensation, liability, and incident reporting requirements. Knowledge of data governance principles, record retention standards, and public records requirements, including the Colorado Open Records Act (CORA) and data privacy expectations applicable to school districts. Knowledge of basic analytical concepts, reporting methodologies, and common metrics used to evaluate claims activity, losses, and risk trends. Skilled in organizing, cleaning, standardizing, and validating data from multiple sources such as incident reports, medical invoices, internal logs, and RMIS extracts to produce analysis ready datasets. Skilled in using spreadsheet and reporting tools (e.g., Excel) to sort, filter, code, analyze, and visualize claims data, including the preparation of charts, tables, and summary reports for operational and leadership audiences. Skilled in maintaining structured electronic records, applying consistent naming conventions, metadata standards, and access controls to support audit readiness, legal discovery, and records requests. Ability to analyze claims and incident data to identify patterns, trends, and potential risk indicators and to communicate findings clearly to the Claims Manager, Director of Risk Management, and other stakeholders. Ability to perform routine data audits, identify data quality issues, and follow established procedures to resolve missing, duplicate, or inconsistent records. Ability to manage multiple reporting cycles, respond to ad hoc data requests, and support time sensitive activities such as high risk activity reviews, travel tracking, and records requests while maintaining accuracy, confidentiality, and attention to detail.




The physical requirements, mental requirements and work environment factors described below are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.




PHYSICAL DEMANDS: Ability to focus on objects at varying distances and distinguish between colors (with corrective lenses). Perform tasks that require manual dexterity, including operation of computers & small office equipment. Basic mobility and the ability to navigate the office environment safely. Ability to speak clearly, listen attentively (with assistance devices), and convey information accurately. May be required to give presentations to groups.




MENTAL FUNCTIONS: Ability to analyze situations, identify potential risks, and devise effective solutions. Ability to remain flexible in dynamic environments, adjusting plans and strategies as necessary to accommodate changing requirements or circumstances. Ability to effectively communicate and collaborate with other teams. Ability to manage time and priorities to meet deadlines.




WORK ENVIRONMENT: Work is performed in a semi-secured office building with a typical office environment and risk factors.

Forward Engineer – AI, Cloud & Orchestration

$90 - $110 per hour | Providence, RI | Hybrid | Consulting

A bit about us:

We are a leading strategic service provider with over 25 years of experience helping organizations transform their technology infrastructure to drive business success. Our team specializes in delivering innovative IT solutions across cloud services, cybersecurity, networking, data center modernization, and managed services.

With a client-centric approach, we empower businesses to overcome complex IT challenges and accelerate their digital transformation. Our solutions are tailored to meet the needs of mid-market and enterprise clients across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, finance, government, and education.

Backed by a deep bench of certified experts and strategic partnerships with top-tier technology providers, we offer a comprehensive portfolio that includes cloud architecture and migration, disaster recovery, security operations, IT modernization, and more. Our mission is to help organizations not just keep up—but stay ahead—in an ever-evolving technology landscape.

Why join us?

Jobot Consultant Benefits

As a W2 contractor through Jobot, you'll have access to a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and financial security:

Health & Wellness

Medical Insurance – Multiple plans available, including PPO and HDHP options

Dental Insurance – Coverage for preventive, basic, and major services

Vision Insurance – Includes exams, lenses, frames, and contact lenses

Financial Benefits

401(k) Retirement Plan – Includes employer match to help you save for the future

Weekly Direct Deposit – Reliable and convenient payment schedule

Time Off

Paid Sick Leave – In accordance with state and local laws

Paid Holidays – Select paid holidays may apply depending on contract length and client

Additional Perks

Access to Jobot's Dedicated Support Team – For payroll, HR, and benefits questions

Career Support – Ongoing access to a recruiter who advocates for your career goals

Option to Convert – Many Jobot contracts include potential for full-time hire

Job Details

Forward Engineer – AI, Cloud & Orchestration

Location: Providence, RI (Onsite with some remote flexibility)

Employment Type: Contract-to-hire

Level: Senior / Principal Individual Contributor

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a highly skilled and innovative Forward Engineer – AI, Cloud & Orchestration to help enterprise organizations design, build, and deploy next-generation solutions leveraging artificial intelligence, cloud technologies, automation, and intelligent orchestration.

This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving complex business challenges, developing cutting-edge technology, and bringing innovative solutions from concept to production.

Unlike traditional architecture or consulting positions, this role combines deep technical engineering expertise with direct customer engagement. You'll work closely with business leaders, technical stakeholders, and engineering teams to understand challenges, design solutions, write code, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

The ideal candidate is a technically versatile problem-solver with strong experience in Generative AI, Microsoft Azure, software development, enterprise integrations, and workflow automation.

What You'll Be Doing

AI Engineering & Intelligent Automation

• Design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade AI applications, intelligent agents, copilots, and automated workflows.
• Build solutions using leading LLM platforms, including OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Microsoft Azure AI.
• Develop Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions and enterprise knowledge architectures.
• Integrate AI capabilities into existing enterprise applications, business processes, and operational environments.
• Rapidly transform business requirements into prototypes, minimum viable products (MVPs), and production-ready solutions.
• Evaluate emerging AI technologies and identify practical applications that deliver measurable business value.


Enterprise Orchestration & Integration

• Design and implement intelligent workflows connecting applications, APIs, enterprise data, infrastructure, AI agents, and business processes.
• Automate complex processes spanning multiple systems, departments, and technologies.
• Develop event-driven workflows that monitor conditions, analyze data, recommend actions, and trigger automated responses.
• Integrate business rules, approval processes, governance controls, and human-in-the-loop decision-making.
• Identify opportunities to eliminate manual processes, improve operational efficiency, and streamline enterprise workflows.


Cloud Architecture & Engineering

• Design and implement secure, scalable cloud and hybrid-cloud solutions, primarily within Microsoft Azure.
• Develop and support cloud modernization, application integration, and infrastructure automation initiatives.
• Work with cloud networking, compute, storage, identity, security, containers, and data services.
• Evaluate existing enterprise environments and recommend practical future-state architectures.
• Apply cloud cost optimization and FinOps principles to engineering decisions.


Software Development & DevOps

• Design and develop production-quality software, APIs, integrations, and automation solutions.
• Write clean, scalable, maintainable code, preferably using Python and modern development frameworks.
• Integrate enterprise applications using REST APIs, webhooks, event streams, and other integration technologies.
• Implement CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Infrastructure as Code where appropriate.
• Build reusable automation components and integration frameworks.


Observability, SRE & Operational Intelligence

• Design and integrate observability solutions across cloud platforms, applications, infrastructure, and enterprise systems.
• Leverage tools such as Grafana, Azure Monitor, and ServiceNow to improve operational visibility.
• Correlate logs, metrics, traces, and events to identify issues and improve system performance.
• Apply AI-driven analytics to anomaly detection, root-cause analysis, predictive operations, and automated remediation.
• Support reliability engineering practices, including service-level indicators (SLIs), service-level objectives (SLOs), and operational readiness.


Data, Security & AI Governance

• Integrate structured and unstructured enterprise data into AI and automation solutions.
• Develop data pipelines and integrations that support intelligent applications.
• Incorporate security, identity management, access controls, and data protection into solution designs.
• Support responsible AI adoption through appropriate governance, auditability, human oversight, and compliance controls.


What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience in software engineering, cloud engineering, solution architecture, DevOps, SRE, automation, or related technical disciplines.
• Proven experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise-scale technology solutions.
• Strong hands-on expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud architecture.
• Practical experience with Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and AI-powered applications.
• Experience building or integrating AI agents, agentic workflows, or intelligent automation solutions.
• Strong programming and software development skills, with Python strongly preferred.
• Experience developing APIs and integrating complex enterprise systems.
• Solid understanding of distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, and modern application architectures.
• Experience with workflow automation and orchestration.
• Familiarity with observability, monitoring, and enterprise operations.
• Understanding of enterprise data integration, security, and governance.
• Strong communication skills with the ability to collaborate directly with business executives, customers, and technical teams.


Preferred Technical Experience

Experience with several of the following technologies and disciplines is highly desirable:

• AI & LLMs: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Claude Code, Azure OpenAI, AI agents, RAG, vector databases, and agentic frameworks.
• Cloud & DevOps: Microsoft Azure, Azure DevOps, AWS, Kubernetes, containers, Infrastructure as Code, and CI/CD.
• Automation & Integration: Python, REST APIs, event-driven architecture, workflow orchestration, and enterprise integration platforms.
• Observability & Operations: Grafana, Azure Monitor, ServiceNow, SRE, automated remediation, and FinOps.
• Enterprise Platforms: Microsoft 365, Copilot, enterprise data platforms, and business process automation.
• Experience supporting healthcare, financial services, or other highly regulated enterprise environments is a plus.


Beyond the Technical Skills

We're looking for someone who can do more than design an impressive architecture.

The ideal candidate will be able to:

• Engage directly with business and IT leaders to understand complex operational challenges.
• Translate business needs into practical, scalable technical solutions.
• Move seamlessly between strategic discussions, solution design, and hands-on development.
• Communicate complex technical concepts clearly to nontechnical stakeholders.
• Collaborate across software engineering, infrastructure, security, data, and business teams.
• Take ownership of solutions from initial discovery through implementation and production.
• Thrive in environments where requirements evolve and creative problem-solving is essential.
• Balance innovation with security, reliability, cost, and measurable business value.


The Ideal Candidate

We're looking for a builder, not just an architect.

You might spend the morning collaborating with enterprise leaders to understand a business challenge, the afternoon designing an AI-enabled solution, and the following days writing code, integrating platforms, and bringing that solution into production.

You understand how to connect the entire technology ecosystem:

Business Processes → Data → AI → Applications → Cloud → Observability → Automation → Business Outcomes

You're curious, adaptable, technically broad, and passionate about turning emerging technologies into real-world enterprise solutions.

Why This Opportunity?

This position offers the opportunity to work at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, combining advanced software engineering, cloud architecture, and intelligent automation. You'll have the chance to solve challenging business problems, work directly with enterprise customers, influence technical direction, and build solutions that deliver meaningful operational impact. If you're a hands-on engineer who enjoys working across AI, cloud, software development, and enterprise automation—and wants to see your solutions make a real difference—we'd love to connect.

We provide an inclusive work environment that celebrates diversity and all qualified candidates receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, military status, genetic information or any other basis protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.
