We are searching for the best talent for an Experienced Automation and Robotics Engineer to be located in Spring House, PA.

Purpose: The Experienced Automation and Robotics Engineer provides hands-on engineering depth for integrated workcells. The role connects instruments, robots, sensors, transfer mechanisms, guarding, utilities, and basic control interfaces so scientific workflows can run reliably in automated form.

The Engineer will design, configure, test, troubleshoot, and improve the physical automation and robotics components of integrated discovery workcells. This role complements laboratory automation scientists by owning physical feasibility, robot motion, equipment integrations, controls handshakes, safety behavior, serviceability, layout constraints, and technical vendor follow-up for assigned systems.

At this level the engineer begins to own defined physical integration packages, rather than simply supporting assigned tasks. The role contributes to interface definitions, FAT/SAT execution, safety and serviceability reviews, and remediation of physical, mechanical, and controls-related failure modes.
 
You will be responsible for: 

Physical System Design and Integration


Contributing to the design and deployment of robotic workcells, transfer stations, labware nests, custom fixtures, grippers, guards, sensors, actuators, label/barcode presentation points, and automated peripherals.Supporting robot reach studies, equipment layouts, service envelope reviews, deck access assessments, operator intervention points, and physical interface testing between instruments and workcells.Supporting integration between orchestration software, device drivers, robot controllers, PLCs or safety controllers, sensors, instrument PCs, and IT/OT infrastructure.Authoring or contributing to URS, FDS, SDS review comments, interface control notes, FMEA inputs, FAT/SAT protocols, safety test scripts, commissioning records, and punch-list documentation.

Simulation, Safety, and Vendor Support

Support technology evaluations, proof-of-concept studies, design reviews, and vendor demonstrations for future automation and robotics capabilities.Contribute to engineering standards, interface templates, safety review practices, maintenance guidelines, and technical playbooks.Support audit, inspection, or quality documentation requests where automated systems intersect with regulated or quality driven workflows.Participate in lessons learned and continuous improvement activities to improve future automation delivery.Qualifications/Requirements

Preferred:
Experience with PLCs, robot controllers, AMRs, cobots, machine vision, industrial networks, OPC UA, Ethernet/IP, PROFINET, safety PLCs, or device drivers.Experience with simulation, CAD, digital twin, throughput modeling, robot path modeling, or layout planning tools.Experience supporting outsourced technical projects and vendor deliverables such as URS, FDS, SDS, FAT, SAT, FMEA, risk assessments, and punch-list closure.
Other: 
Travel may be required for vendor assessments, FAT/SAT activities, site visits, system builds, workshops, training, technology scouting, or cross-site deployment support.

This role supports the transition from isolated automation projects to integrated, reliable, AI-native, and ultimately self-driving discovery laboratory systems. description:
Data Scientist, Media ConsultantNew York, NYWE HAVE CREATED A WORLD WHERE ART AND SCIENCE ARE BEST FRIENDSKnown is what happens when a data science firm and a creative agency stop arguing and start collaborating. We were built from scratch with PhD data scientists and award-winning creatives working on the same briefs, from day one. That structure earned us an Ad Age #3 A-List ranking, back-to-back Data & Insights Agency of the Year wins, plus Emmys, Cannes Lions, Clios, and Effies across clients in finance, tech, entertainment, consumer goods, and real estate. We're distributed across the U.S. and unapologetically ambitious.

If you're tired of choosing between doing smart work and doing creative work, you'll fit right in here. BUT ENOUGH ABOUT US, LET'S TALK ABOUT YOUAbout the role: Known's Media Science team uses advanced analytics, machine learning, statistics, and algorithms to plan and optimize advertising dollars. We partner with our clients to translate their business goals into meaningful metrics, and buy media across all channels to drive those target outcomes. We are looking for someone to join the team and work alongside data analysts, data scientists, media strategists, media buyers, and software engineers.

This role is on the "Buyer Science" team: a group of data scientists who specialize in media measurement, data analysis, experimental design, and campaign optimization. You'll work hand-in-hand with Known's media strategists, media channel experts, and directly with clients to elevate their media performance and drive real business value.

You will also work with other data scientists to develop campaign measurement strategies, build experimentation plans, and collaborate with media planners and channel teams to ensure media allocations are built scientifically. At the Consultant level, you'll conduct analyses in service of campaign optimization, surface insights that go beyond media metrics to incorporate first party data, and help drive business strategy.

You may find yourself working with our development team (Skeptic) to help productionalize deeper and more technical approaches to common media challenges. In many cases you would work with senior managers on the team and in some cases (especially over time) you would be expected to lead projects independently.

You would be expected to embrace your project management responsibilities, from defining key business objectives, to designing the measurement or analytical approach, to analyzing data, and presenting findings. You would also be expected to ensure that our clients have an amazing experience and reinforce our relationship with them as trusted and valued partners. WHO YOU ARE AND WHAT YOU HAVEA degree from a well-regarded college or university. STEM degrees are preferred.3+ years of hands-on experience doing quantitative analysis, statistical modeling, optimization and/or statistics. Experience utilizing Python and SQL.1+ years of experience building data science software.

Experience in strategy consulting, marketing and/or marketing research, with specific passion and background in technology and/or media. This should include examples of account / client management.

Understanding of the advertising and media landscape, especially as pertains to measurement vendors and ad platforms.

Superb communication and presentation skills, with a specific fluency in talking about strategic business problems – you combine a drive for analytical reasoning with a practical understanding of what our clients in marketing are trying to achieve.

Ability to communicate technical information with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience in making appropriate research or analysis recommendations for these business problems.

Proficiency in Google products (Sheets, Documents, Slides) and/or Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).Ability to think strategically, analytically, and proactively about diverse business problems.

Passion for managing the quality & accuracy of data sources and downstream analytics, including checking your and others' work.

Experience working on a variety of projects simultaneously and delivering results on a deadline. WHAT YOU'LL DOProject management and ownership. While you have will account-level project management support, you will independently manage workstreams you own.

Understanding the client's overall business objectives and translating them into a campaign and measurement strategy.

Overseeing the performance of media campaigns and amazing our clients, both by meeting their targets and creating insightful narratives through bespoke reporting. Writing reports and presenting to clients in a way that is engaging and persuasive.

Developing research, measurement, or analytical approaches.

Statistical analysis of complex datasets.

Managing the ingestion and cleaning of new datasets relevant to your work / projects.

Creating reproducible work through common coding languages (Priority: Python and SQL).Working with other data scientists and engineers to productionalize new tools.

Interpreting data to understand the business implications of the research. Framing analyses, stories, and slides for client media plans and reports.

Serving as the key client point of contact on campaign measurement, optimization, and data infrastructure.

Creation of interactive data tools that are delivered to clients, such as dashboards for marketing campaign performance, media experiments, or simulation tools – you would be provided training in how to create these, but prior experience with MCI is a plus. SOME OF OUR PERKSUnlimited paid time off401k with company matching and no vesting periodAnnual bonusesGenerous medical planPaid parental leaveONE LAST THING TO ASK YOURSELFAll this might sound great, but you're probably still wondering, "Would I be a good fit for Known?" or "Would Known be a good fit for me?" Our culture is propped up by four values that we aspire to every day: We are one team.

We see the good. We never stop learning. There's always a better way. At Known we are setting out to build something more than just a company. We are building a legacy filled with exceptionally talented people with a kaleidoscope of backgrounds, experiences, and origin stories who feel encouraged and empowered to bring their whole selves to work, and to partner with us in molding and shaping our culture through our values.

Known is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate against employees or qualified job applicants on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any other federal, state or locally protected class.

The base salary for this position is $120K - $130K. This range is posted in compliance with state and municipal Pay Transparency laws. In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to receive additional Known benefits.

About KindlingKindling is a Nashville-based snack company making protein pretzels for people who'd rather be outside. We pair the crunch of a classic pretzel with nutrient-dense protein, fiber, and whole grains, in craveable flavors like Sea Salt, Dill Pickle, Honey Mustard, Garlic Parmesan, and Churro.

We're a young, fast-growing brand in natural, conventional, club, and e-commerce channels, built by a founding team that has scaled a nationally recognized better-for-you brand before. We give 1% of revenue to the outdoor spaces where communities thrive and play, through the Kindling Impact Foundation.

Our mission: Every moment outside matters. We're here to feed it.

About the RoleWe have more data than we have hours to read it. SPINS, Circana, retailer portals, distributor feeds, shelf data: it's all coming in. We need someone who can turn it into a clear answer: where we're winning, where we're leaking, and how sales can activate against it.

This is an analyst seat with a sales-support job. You'll help build the story behind every line review, sell-in, and promo decision, and you'll sit close to the sales team, not off in a reporting corner.

Please note: this role will report to the Head of Sales.

What You'll DoTurn data into direction˃ Own weekly and monthly performance reporting across SPINS (via Bedrock), Circana (Costco), and retailer portals: Walmart Luminate, Target, and Albertsons.

˃ Diagnose the “why” behind the numbers, covering velocity, distribution, pricing, promo lift, and share against the category and competitors.

˃ Spot risks and opportunities before we're asked about them: underperforming stores, voids, and distribution gaps worth chasing.

˃ Use distributor and shelf data (UNFI and KeHE via Treator) to connect what ships with what sells.

Arm the sales team˃ Build category review, line review, and sell-in decks that give buyers a reason to say yes.

˃ Run promo post-evaluations and trade ROI so we spend where it works.

˃ Support Costco rotation planning and read results: demo lift, sell-through, and the case for the next rotation.

˃ Partner on trade and deduction visibility as we roll out Confido.

˃ Field ad-hoc questions from sales, brokers, and leadership. Fast and accurate beats perfect and late.

Build the system˃ Help shape how we use Bedrock, Treator, Confido, Dirty Hands, and whatever comes next.

˃ Create repeatable dashboards and scorecards so the basics run themselves.

˃ Use AI tools to speed up analysis and free up time for thinking.

What You'll BringMust have˃ [2–4 / 5+] years in CPG sales analytics, category management, or insights, on the brand side, at a broker, or at a data provider.

˃ Deep, hands-on SPINS experience. Circana or Nielsen is a plus.

˃ Experience in at least one retailer portal (Luminate, Target, Albertsons, or similar).

˃ Strong Excel. You build the model; you don't just open it.

˃ The ability to turn a pile of numbers into three sentences a buyer or CEO will act on.

˃ Comfort learning new tools quickly. We'll teach you our stack, and you'll probably end up teaching us.

Nice to have˃ Natural/specialty and conventional channel experience.

˃ Club channel, especially Costco.

˃ Experience with trade spend or deduction platforms.

˃ Power BI, Tableau, or similar.

˃ Experience at an early-stage or high-growth brand.

What Success Looks LikeIn your first 90 days˃ Weekly reporting is running across all data sources.

˃ You own the next major line review deck.

˃ You've found at least one opportunity we weren't seeing.

In your first 12 months˃ Sales walks into every buyer meeting with a data story.

˃ Promo decisions are backed by post-evals.

˃ The reporting runs itself, so you're spending time on insight, not assembly.

The Culture We're BuildingWe're not just stacking resumes—we're gathering the kind of people you'd want around a campfire. Curious minds. Brave creatives. Whole humans.

The Heartbeat – How we show up

Be a Steady Flame – Transparent, consistent, and always lit with integrity.

Invite Others to the Campfire – Every voice matters. Roast marshmallows, not ideas.

Kindle Your Passions – Burnout isn't a badge of honor. We value balance, walks in the woods, and midday creative breakthroughs.

The Output – What we expect

Defend Our Den – Care about the craft. Own your wins and your misses.

Seek Higher Ground – Challenge assumptions. Expand your view. Ask why (then why again).

Take Swift Action – Light the match. Follow the spark. Adjust as you go.

Perks of the GigHealth, Dental, and Vision Insurance

Unlimited PTO + generous holidays

Competitive parental leave (family-first, always)

Tons of snacks, real talk, and laughter

A career you'll be proud of and a team that feels like family

Ready to Build Something That Matters?We're on a mission to bring more energy, joy, and adventure to the snack aisle. If you believe in building brands that inspire people to get outside, eat better, and live brighter— join us and help keep the fire going.

Join Knightwerx and help build the perception systems that enable autonomous aircraft to understand and navigate the world around them.






This is an opportunity to work on real-world autonomy challenges at the intersection of computer vision, machine learning, robotics, and aerospace. You'll develop perception capabilities that transform raw sensor data into actionable intelligence, enabling autonomous systems to detect objects, understand complex environments, and make informed decisions in dynamic operating conditions.






If you're excited by building cutting-edge AI systems that move beyond research and into operational products, you'll have the opportunity to see your work deployed on next-generation unmanned aircraft used by both commercial and government customers.






Perception Pipeline Development

 Design and implement real-time computer vision algorithms for high-resolution cameras, depth sensors, and multi-modal sensor inputs.
 Develop object detection, image segmentation, depth estimation, and multi-object tracking capabilities.
 Train, fine-tune, and evaluate machine learning models for scene understanding and 3D occupancy mapping.





Machine Learning and AI

 Optimize AI models for deployment on edge computing platforms.
 Integrate perception outputs into autonomy, planning, and control systems.
 Validate performance through simulation and real-world hardware testing.

 Bachelor's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field.
 2-5 years of relevant industry experience.
 Strong C++ software development skills.
 Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar deep learning frameworks.
 Strong understanding of classical and 3D computer vision principles.

Preferred Qualifications

 ROS2 experience.
 Services-oriented architecture experience.

 Familiarity with Kubeflow, Airflow, Metaflow, or similar ML infrastructure tools.





Why Knightwerx 


 


At Knightwerx, you'll work directly with the engineers building the UAV's, autonomy stack, and mission systems. You'll have ownership, visibility, and the ability to influence technical decisions that move products from concept to flight.






We're building American-made, AI-powered unmanned systems where speed, innovation, and execution matter. Engineers here work close to the mission, close to customers, and close to the products they help create.


About Knightwerx


Knightwerx develops American-made, AI-powered unmanned aerial systems and remote sensing technologies that support human-machine teaming in mission-critical environments. We build next-generation aerospace and autonomy solutions for both commercial and government customers where performance, speed, and reliability matter.






As a growing company, we offer the opportunity to work close to the mission, close to the product, and close to the decisions that shape what gets built.

description:
Who We Are
At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission-critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward - always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.


The Role
The Marketing Analytics & Data Science Lead is a senior individual contributor responsible for advancing Kyndryl's marketing measurement, audience intelligence, and predictive analytics capabilities. This role serves as the analytical engine behind marketing strategy, helping the organization better understand buyer behavior, optimize investment decisions, and improve marketing's contribution to revenue growth.


This role combines deep analytical expertise with business acumen to solve complex marketing challenges through advanced analytics, attribution methodologies, predictive modeling, and audience insights. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing actionable recommendations that influence strategic marketing decisions across channels, audiences, and the customer lifecycle.


Working closely with marketing leaders, campaign teams, digital teams, operations, sales, and data engineering, this role will identify opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness through data-driven decision making, and advanced analytical techniques.


Key Responsibilities
Marketing Measurement & Attribution
Lead the evolution of marketing measurement frameworks and attribution methodologies that quantify marketing's contribution to pipeline, revenue, and business growth.


Develop and evaluate multi-touch attribution approaches, influence measurement strategies, and channel contribution models that guide investment decisions and budget optimization.


Identify measurement gaps and recommend improvements in data collection, metadata strategies, campaign tagging, and platform integrations to improve reporting accuracy and analytical rigor.


Advanced Analytics & Predictive Modeling
Design and develop predictive models that improve marketing effectiveness, including response scoring, buyer propensity models, lead prioritization, audience engagement models, and lifecycle analysis.


Apply statistical techniques, machine learning methodologies, and AI-enabled approaches to identify patterns, trends, and opportunities hidden within large marketing and sales datasets.


Translate analytical findings into practical recommendations that improve conversion rates, pipeline generation, audience engagement, and marketing ROI.


Audience Insights & Segmentation
Develop audience segmentation frameworks that support account-based marketing, customer expansion strategies, digital engagement programs, and campaign personalization.


Analyze customer, account, behavioral, technographic, and engagement data to identify growth opportunities and uncover actionable audience insights.


Analytics Strategy & Thought Leadership
Serve as a subject matter expert on advanced analytics, marketing measurement, and data science methodologies within the marketing organization.


Drive innovation by evaluating emerging analytical techniques, AI capabilities, and measurement approaches that improve marketing effectiveness and operational efficiency.


Present analytical findings and strategic recommendations to senior marketing leaders and stakeholders, translating complex methodologies into clear business actions.


Kyndryl currently does not require employees to be fully vaccinated against COVID-19, however, if you are hired to work at a client, customer, or partner location, you may be required to show proof ofvaccinationto align with their respective COVID-19vaccinationpolicies. Those who believe they are eligible may apply for a medical or religious accommodation prior to the start of employment.


Who You Are
Key Competencies

Advanced analytical problem solving
Statistical reasoning and experimentation design
Predictive modeling and machine learning
Marketing measurement and attribution expertise
Strategic thinking and business acumen
Executive communication and storytelling
Intellectual curiosity and innovation
Independent ownership and accountability
Cross-functional influence without formal authority
Passion for translating data into measurable business impact

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in marketing analytics, data science, revenue operations, business analytics, or related analytical disciplines.
Advanced SQL skills with experience working across large and complex datasets.
Strong proficiency with Python, R, or comparable analytical and visualization platforms.
Experience developing predictive models, scoring methodologies, segmentation frameworks, or statistical analyses used in business decision making.
Strong understanding of attribution methodologies, funnel measurement, and marketing performance evaluation.
Experience working with CRM, marketing automation, data warehouse, and digital measurement platforms.
Ability to independently scope, lead, and deliver complex analytical projects from problem definition through implementation.
Strong communication and data storytelling skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
Experience leveraging AI and machine learning techniques to automate analyses, accelerate insight generation, or improve business outcomes.

Prefered Qualifications

Masters degree in Data Science, Analytics, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business, or a related field.
Strong proficiency with Power BI

Being You
Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it's how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we're not doing it single-handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That's the Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect
With state-of-the-art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well-being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter - wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learningprograms give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, includingMicrosoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company-wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non-profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

The Data Scientist – SME will serve as the lead technical expert for optimization and advanced analytics within the portfolio. This role will own the design and implementation of prescriptive analytics solutions—especially optimization models—that set safety stock levels, recommend resupply quantities, and balance risk and cost across the supply chain. The SME will work closely with logisticians, ammunition SMEs, and data engineers to operationalize prescriptive decision support tools in Army Vantage and related environments.


LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.


 


Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.


Responsibilities
Responsibilities



 Continue to improve processes that: 
 
 Recommend ideal resupply quantities by installation and ammunition type
 Align regional inventory to demand, reduce excess shipments and storage waste, and safeguard against stock-outs
 
 Advance the Army along the analytics continuum from descriptive/diagnostic to predictive/prescriptive analytics, ensuring models are operationally actionable.
 Work closely with logistician and ammunition SMEs to formulate, implement, and tune linear, mixed-integer, stochastic, and multi-objective optimization models that consider:
 
 Forecasted demand (unit forecasts and ML-based forecasts) and available depot stock
 Transportation costs, storage constraints, and depot capacity.
 Additional optimization constraints, decision variables, and objectives that reflect real-world policies, doctrine, and operational constraints: 
 Readiness priorities and surge requirements.
 
 Collaborate with data engineers to ensure pipelines provide clean, timely input data and to embed optimization models into the application and Vantage workflows.
 Design and implement model performance metrics and KPIs and conduct near real-time monitoring of model impact.
 Lead experimentation, scenario analysis, and sensitivity studies.
 Provide technical leadership and mentorship to journeyman data scientists, guiding best practices in modeling and optimization.
 Support briefings to senior Army leadership and stakeholders, clearly explaining model design, trade-offs, and operational impact.

Qualifications
Minimum Qualifications



 Bachelor's degree in operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, statistics, computer science, or related quantitative field; masters or PhD.
 7+ years of experience in advanced analytics, operations research, or data science, with direct responsibility for optimization model design and deployment.
 Demonstrated expertise in: 
 
 Linear and mixed-integer optimization, stochastic optimization, and/or robust optimization.
 Modeling tools and libraries (e.g., Pyomo, Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools, or similar).
 Integrating optimization models with predictive models (e.g., ML-driven demand forecasts).
 
 Proven experience translating complex mission and business objectives into formal optimization formulations and delivering production-caliber solutions.
 Experience working with cross-functional teams (data engineers, logisticians, software developers, and mission owners) in an Agile environment.
 Excellent written and oral communication skills, including experience briefing senior leaders and explaining trade-offs to non-technical audiences.
 Active SECRET clearance; U.S. citizenship required.

 


Desired Qualifications



 Experience in DoD logistics, supply chain, or munitions management; familiarity with Army ammunition systems and processes.
 Prior work with enterprise data platforms (e.g., Army Vantage, Army Data Platform) and AWS GovCloud or similar secure cloud environments.

 PMP and/or SAFe/Agile certifications

description:
Berkeley Lab's Applied math and Computational Sciences Division has an opening for a Beyond Moore Computational Research Scientist to evaluate and develop devices to hardware/circuit co-design flow for architectural specializations for high performance computing neuromorphic and edge computing applications.

In the absence of Moore's Law Scaling, the DOE must investigate alternative paths to continuing computing performance improvements for scientific applications through architectural specialization. Since the beginning of the microchip, we have become accustomed to Moore's Law relentlessly delivering a doubling of performance, energy efficiency, and density for high-performance computing (HPC) (and all electronic devices) every 18-24 months. This expectation has led to a relatively stable ecosystem built around general-purpose processor technologies such as the x86, ARM, and Power instruction set architectures. However, with the tapering of lithography improvements, shrinking transistors can no longer be relied on exclusively to deliver continued performance improvements in digital electronics.

Absent of a new transistor technology to replace CMOS, the primary opportunity for continued performance improvement for digital electronics and HPC is to make more efficient use of transistors through architecture specialization, application-specific acceleration, and compilers/programming-models that better control data movement than those available today.

The successful applicant will contribute to the development and evaluation of novel heterogeneous devices based circuit design for extreme heterogeneous SoC (System on Chip) designs, and evaluate their merit for emerging computational workloads for the purpose of maximizing performance and energy efficiency. This work will have a broad impact on high performance and other larger-scale computing for critical applications for society and science.

The successful applicant will need to have expertise with computer architecture and processor design and from the ground up, and have skills in Spice analog/digital circuit design, Verilog and use of CAD/EDA tools It is also beneficial if the candidate has experience with full tape-out experience of ASICs. Using those skills, the successful applicant will design post-Moore devices-based compute, memory, or data transfer blocks for key application kernels to demonstrate the merit of this approach.

The applicant will also make key intellectual contributions and consequently publish papers to the emerging field of extreme heterogeneous computing and domain-specific specializations. Knowledge of processor design techniques like Logic-In-Memory/In-Memory Computing, Spiking Neural Network (SNN) architectures and multivalued logic design techniques is a bonus.

You will:

Design circuits, hardware accelerators and processor architectures using post-Moore devices to accelerate key HPC applications and application kernels.Develop compact models and methodologies to use these circuits for performance and energy characterizations which can be used in architectural simulation framework for tightly integrating these accelerators into heterogeneous systems and SoCs that may contain multiple different kinds of accelerator devices.Identify opportunities and challenges for devices to architectural design space exploration for several post-Moore devices to address those bottlenecks and develop circuit design models to determine the performance potential for those solutions.Develop architectural and circuit models for emulation in FPGA hardwareDevelop metrics and benchmark tests in order to compare conventional CMOS based processors/accelerators and enhanced post-Moore devices based computational accelerators for key HPC applications and algorithms.Publish work in academic journals and present it at conferences and workshops.Lead and assist in the preparation of proposals for funding.Mentor graduate students and postdocs.We are looking for:

Reports To: VP of Information Technology; works day-to-day with Commercial leadership

Location: Broomfield, CO / Hybrid

Compensation: $95,000- $125,000 base + 10% annual bonus target based on EBITDA

Job Type: Full Time

Travel Requirements: 5%




 

About the Role

Lignetics makes consumable products, including heating pellets, animal bedding, and grilling pellets, where demand moves with weather, seasonality, and retailer inventory. As part of the IT team, you will build and maintain the commercial BI environment, analyze the signals that drive demand, and deliver the reporting and insight senior leadership uses to run the business. You will use modern analytics and AI tools to get there faster.




 

What You Will Do

• Build analysis and tools on point-of-sale, on-hand inventory, weather, and internal sales data that signal changes in demand by category, customer, and region.

• Surface those signals early (sell-through shifts, inventory build or depletion, weather departures from normal) so the forecast and commercial teams can act on them.

• Prepare and present regular sales performance reporting to senior leadership.

• Design, build, and maintain dashboards and automated reporting and alerts that reduce manual work.

• Integrate data from Salesforce, retailer portals, external sources, and acquired businesses into reliable BI sources.

• Own data integrity across BI sources: identify and troubleshoot discrepancies, trace them to root cause, resolve them with source-system owners, and put checks in place so they don't recur. Maintain consistent KPI definitions.

• Use AI tools to speed up analysis, coding, and reporting, and validate output before it reaches decision-makers.

• Partner with commercial and cross-functional teams on requirements and ad-hoc analysis.











Requirements
 

What You Bring

Required

• 3+ years in analytics, BI, or data science supporting sales, revenue, or demand planning, ideally in CPG, retail, agriculture, energy, or another seasonal or consumption-driven business.

• Strong SQL and Python or R, plus advanced Excel and Access.

• Applied statistics: regression, time series, and trend analysis.

• Hands-on experience with a visualization tool such as Tableau or Power BI.

• Demonstrated use of AI/LLM tools in real analytical work, with examples you can walk us through.

• Track record of diagnosing and fixing data quality issues across multiple source systems.

• Ability to explain analysis, and its limits, to non-technical executives in plain language.

• Ownership mindset: you take a messy question to a finished answer without being managed step by step.

Preferred

• Experience with retailer POS and inventory data (e.g., retailer portals, syndicated data).

• Experience analyzing weather- or seasonally-driven demand.

• Familiarity with Salesforce and ERP sales data.

• Experience with cloud data platforms and pipeline tools.

• Experience integrating data from acquisitions/disparate data sources.




What Success Looks Like

• 90 days: You know our data, categories, and customers; you have validated the core performance reporting and shipped your first automation.

• 6 months: Demand-signal analysis (POS, on-hand inventory, weather) is live for our major categories and feeding the forecast and pre-season planning cycle.

• 12 months: Demand shifts are flagged ahead of the forecast, manual reporting time is materially reduced, and leadership relies on your analysis for customer and inventory decisions.

Live Nation Entertainment is hiring a Senior Data Analyst, Marketing with 3 - 5 years of experience. Based in United States - Beverly Hills, CA and with Hybrid ways of working. 
 
 Job description and responsibilities: 

WHO ARE YOU?


Passionate and motivated. Driven, with an entrepreneurial spirit. Resourceful, innovative, forward thinking and committed. At Live Nation Entertainment, our people embrace these qualities, so if this sounds like you then please read on!


THE TEAM


We are excited about music, live entertainment, marketing, data, and technology. We are driven by a passion to understand the root causes of complicated problems and partner with stakeholders to discover and implement solutions. Most of us had no previous experience working in music -- just a shared excitement about the space, a willingness to go to concerts / venues / festivals when needed as part of the job, and a desire to go to concerts / venues / festivals in our free time, too.


The Marketing Insights and Data Analytics Services team within the Marketing & Data Strategy organization works on projects across all divisions, to develop insights around Fans and Marketing programs. These insights are used to inspire new marketing programs and improve existing marketing efforts across Concerts, Ticketmaster, and Sponsorship business units. We are also responsible for quantifying the value of our marketing efforts through our test and learn program, incrementality testing and attribution thought leadership.


THE ROLE


The Senior Marketing Data Analyst will play a strategic role in leveraging advanced data science techniques, statistical modeling, and analytics to drive marketing effectiveness and business growth. description:
About Lucid


At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid's proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise NothingTM” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 


We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what's possible and shape the future of mobility.

 






Position Overview




The Powertrain Robotics Engineer, supports robot commissioning, programming, recovery, and tooling integration across AMP-2 Powertrain robotic cells. Joining at facility launch, this engineer supports FANUC, ABB, and KUKA cells from first commissioning through volume ramp. The role is a hands-on contributor to robot uptime, cycle time, and safety compliance.






 






Key Responsibilities


 





Robot Integration, Commissioning, Teaching & Programming for FANUC, ABB, and KUKA
Support offline programming and simulation activities
Maintain and optimize the robots to maximize the throughput throughout the life-cycle of the asset.

Robot Recovery & Troubleshooting



Diagnose robot faults: encoder, drive, cables, controller, program issues, etc
Support production recovery events including robot resynchronization and program restoration
Conduct structured RCA for repeating robot failures

Tooling (EOAT) Integration



Support end-of-arm tooling design reviews, integration, and change management
Troubleshoot EOAT issues etc

Robot Safety Support



Support robot safety validation activities
Ensure safety configurations, light curtains, and interlocks are maintained and validated

HV Safety & Compliance



Enforce HV LOTO, HVIL continuity, and mandatory HV PPE for all work on or near EV Powertrain equipment
Comply with SASO, IEC 60204, and functional safety standards (ISO 13849 / IEC 62061)
Support HV emergency response including thermal runaway isolation and battery-related incident procedures
Achieve and maintain HV safety competency appropriate to scope of work

Launch Governance & Ramp-Up



Support AMP-2 Safe Launch activities, run-at-rate events, and capacity verification within scope
Contribute to Launch Readiness Reviews, Layered Process Audits, and Process Confirmation routines
Participate in QRQC / RCCA escalations during launch and ramp-up phases

Robot Application Engineering & Validation



Develop maintainable robot programs, frames, TCPs, payload data, zones, mastering, backups and recovery standards; validate path accuracy and cycle repeatability.
Integrate EOAT, vision, conveyors, safety PLC handshakes, process equipment and MES/traceability signals; confirm failure-mode recovery and restart behavior.
Execute reach, collision, singularity and cycle-time studies using RoboGuide, RobotStudio or KUKA.Sim and verify results on equipment.
Maintain controlled robot/EOAT backups, revision history, spare strategy and preventive-maintenance inputs.

Launch Governance, Change Control & Operational Readiness



Support FAT/SAT, commissioning, equipment acceptance, Safe Launch, run-at-rate and capacity verification with objective evidence and disciplined punch-list closure.
Control production, process, software and test changes through documented risk assessment, approvals, validation, revision history and rollback or containment planning.
Participate in readiness reviews, Layered Process Audits, Process Confirmation and QRQC/RCCA; close assigned actions with verified effectiveness.

Safety, Quality, Data Integrity & Compliance



Apply role-specific HV LOTO/HVIL, machine safety, stored-energy isolation, electrical safe-work and PPE requirements; never bypass safety devices or product protections.
Protect product genealogy, calibrated-tool status, test/measurement integrity, document control and audit-ready objective evidence.
Comply with applicable AMP-2, SASO, Saudi labor/EHS, IATF 16949, IEC 60204 and functional-safety requirements within assigned scope.

Saudization, Capability Transfer & Collaboration



Build Saudi national capability through structured OJT, skills matrices, practical assessment, certification, cross-training and documented knowledge transfer.
Create technical standards, troubleshooting guides and training material
Collaborate across Production, Quality, Maintenance, Automation/Robotics, Manufacturing Engineering, EHS, IT/OT, MES, Supply Chain, Product Engineering and suppliers.





 






Skills





Strong hands-on robotics programming skills (FANUC, ABB, etc)
Working knowledge of robot safety standards
Structured troubleshooting mindset
Effective communicator in bilingual (English/Arabic) technical environments
Technical standards, structured problem solving, risk-based decision making and controlled documentation
Data literacy: KPI definition, trend analysis, evidence-based validation and clear executive/shop-floor communication
Cross-functional influence, supplier coordination and disciplined ownership in a greenfield launch environment
Coaching, competency assessment and knowledge transfer in a multicultural English/Arabic workplace





 






Minimum Qualifications


 





Bachelor's degree in Mechatronics, Electrical, or Robotics Engineering
3+ years in industrial robotics
Hands-on programming experience with FANUC, ABB, or KUKA
Fluent in English; Arabic strongly preferred
Preferred: multi-brand robotics experience; EOAT integration; greenfield launch experience

Preferred Qualifications



Demonstrated experience with commissioning, FAT/SAT, launch, production readiness or high-volume manufacturing ramp within the role discipline
Working knowledge of IATF 16949, APQP/change control, machine/HV safety and traceability requirements applicable to the role
Lean/Six Sigma, greenfield EV/automotive launch and workforce-development experience

description:
At MITRE, your passion fuels work that impacts our nation and improves lives. This is where your skills strengthen national security, cybersecurity, health, transportation, and citizen services. We're a nonprofit engineering, applied research, and advanced technology organization working in the public interest. With objectivity and integrity at our core, we lead federally funded research and development centers for U.S. government agencies - collaborating with industry and academia to deliver integrated, high-impact solutions that advance our nation's health, security, and prosperity. Our people tackle the toughest technical challenges, supported by competitive benefits, meaningful career development, and a culture of innovation, collaboration, and technical excellence. Choose MITRE for a career with purpose - and help shape the future.

Department Summary:

This is an opportunity for a motivated Operations Research Analyst to join MITRE's Operations Analysis department. We are a large group of over 60 operations research professionals, including over 20 PhDs, who provide thought leadership on a variety of strategic and technical issues, perform analysis that enable our sponsors to make more effective decisions, lead internal research and development activities to bring new technical capabilities into the public sector, and serve as trusted third-party advisors to government sponsors on a variety of technical topics. 

In short, we apply our problem-solving skills to complex interdisciplinary problems that occur within or at the intersection of organizations, operations, and technology. We support sponsor projects across the defense and public sectors including homeland defense, military logistics, radio-spectrum frequency management, health care delivery, cybersecurity analytics, fraud detection, satellite planning, homeland security and civilian aviation. We apply advanced analytic techniques such as longitudinal analysis, large-scale integer programming, metaheuristics, agent-based modeling, reinforcement learning, predictive modeling, mathematical modeling, time series & forecasting, machine learning, optimization, statistics, probability modeling, regression analyses, Bayesian analysis, and different types of simulation to solve the nation's toughest problems. And our research pushes the boundaries on topics such as complex scheduling, medical image analysis, identifying changes in data streams and incorporating the latest AI advancements into our processes for efficiency and rigor.

If you are passionate about project-based analytical work in the public interest, you have found the right place.

Place of Work: Corporate Headquarters - 1730 South Street, Redding CA, 96001


Company Overview


Maas Energy Works is the leading developer and operator of agricultural waste-to-energy systems in the United States. The Company designs, develops, constructs, and operates biogas renewable energy generation systems, primarily on dairy farms. Our projects include anaerobic digesters, biogas-powered electric generation, and renewable natural gas upgrading.



Position Description
We are hiring a Data Engineer to own the operational backbone of our data platform: SQL Servers, the pipelines that move data out of it, and the Microsoft Fabric data warehouse that feeds reporting, regulatory work, and internal applications. The data is high-frequency time-series and operational data from more than 100 projects, so reliability, completeness, and monitoring matter as much as building new things.
This is a hands-on role on a small team that is actively modernizing its platform. We want someone who learns new tools on their own initiative, takes ownership of production systems, and wants to grow with the platform.


Essential Responsibilities
 


• Administer the SQL Server environment in Azure: backups and restore testing, SQL Agent jobs, index and statistics maintenance, security and access, storage growth, and performance tuning.
• Monitor continuous data ingestion from 100+ projects and resolve gaps, delays, duplicates, and out-of-range values before they reach downstream reporting.
• Build, maintain, and troubleshoot pipelines that move data from staging and external REST APIs into the Fabric data warehouse.
• Maintain and extend the warehouse's dimensional models, data quality rules, and load performance.
• Build alerting for pipeline failures, data freshness, and completeness, and own the response when they fire.
• Contribute to the migration of remaining workloads from Azure Synapse to Microsoft Fabric.
• Support analysts and application developers who consume warehouse data through Power BI semantic models and internal applications.
• Write and maintain runbooks and technical documentation, and work in Git with code review and CI/CD deployment.


Required Qualifications
• 3+ years of professional experience with SQL Server and T-SQL, including set-based query design, stored procedures, execution-plan tuning, and indexing.
• Hands-on database administration in production: backup and recovery, SQL Agent, maintenance jobs, logins and role-based security, and capacity monitoring.
• Experience building and operating production ETL/ELT pipelines (Azure Data Factory, Synapse pipelines, Fabric Data Factory, or SSIS), including incremental loads, failure handling, and reruns.
• Working knowledge of dimensional modeling: facts, dimensions, grain, and slowly changing dimensions.
• Hands-on Microsoft Fabric experience: Warehouse and Lakehouse, Data Factory pipelines, Dataflow Gen2, notebooks, and capacity monitoring.
• Familiarity with Azure fundamentals: resource organization, networking basics, managed identities, and Key Vault.
• Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, or alerting production data.
• Proficiency with Git.
• A track record of learning new tools and platforms independently and applying them to real work.
• Python, and C# programming languages
• Spark framework


Preferred Qualifications
• Experience with Power BI semantic models
• Experience with high-volume time-series, IoT, or industrial operations data.
• Microsoft certification DP-600 (Fabric Analytics Engineer) or DP-700 (Fabric Data Engineer).
 


Other Duties
Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive list of activities, duties, or responsibilities required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.


Physical Demand Requirements

Work Environment - Office Staff
This role operates primarily in a professional office environment and uses computers, cloud platforms, databases, development tools, and communication systems. Limited travel to company offices or project locations may be required.
Physical Demands - Office Staff
This is largely a sedentary role requiring extended computer work, regular communication, and the ability to manage multiple technical priorities. The position may occasionally require travel in vehicles or airplanes and access to company operating locations.

About the position

Manifold Bio is a platform biotechnology company pioneering AI-guided protein design and massively multiplexed in vivo screening to unlock tissue-targeted medicines and organism-scale models of living systems. Using proprietary molecular barcoding technology, we screen hundreds of thousands of protein designs simultaneously in living systems, producing in vivo-validated datasets at a scale no one else can match. Our team of protein engineers, biologists, and computational scientists works across this full stack to pursue programs both internally and with leading pharma companies.\n\nManifold Bio is seeking an exceptional Computational Scientist to join our growing Quantitative Biology team. You will work closely with experimental scientists to design and analyze highly multiplexed protein library experiments. You will specifically be working with traditional phage and yeast display readouts, as well as other proprietary display data. You will be expected to own and independently advance projects in areas related to your deep expertise such as protein design, DNA library design, or machine learning/biophysical modeling from MPRA data. To protect candidates from recruitment scams, MarCom Group will only communicate with applicants through domains such as @marcomgroup.com or mail@ats.rippling.com. MarCom Group will never contact an applicant from another domain or ask to provide payment as part of the recruiting process.



MarCom Group is a top-ranked creative agency that provides strategic advertising, branding, marketing, design, digital, and events solutions. We are a woman-owned small business founded in 1996 in the Washington, DC area.




The Audience Insights Analyst is a member of MarCom Group's Brand Strategy department, specializing in audience research, workforce intelligence, and candidate persona development to support awareness and recruitment marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for collecting, analyzing, and interpreting labor market data, demographic and psychographic research, workforce trends, and candidate behaviors to develop comprehensive, data-driven audience personas that inform recruitment marketing strategies. Working collaboratively with Creative, Media, and Account Services teams, the Audience InsightsAnalyst transforms complex research and workforce data into actionable insights that help clients better understand, attract, and engage priority talent audiences. The position plays a key role in identifying high-value talent segments, understanding candidate motivations and barriers, mapping candidate journeys, and translating audience intelligence into strategic recommendations for messaging, creative development, media targeting, and campaign optimization. The Audience InsightsAnalyst ensures marketing strategies are grounded in meaningful audience understanding, supported by reliable research methodologies, and aligned with hiring objectives and applicable compliance requirements.



MarCom Group Core Values 




At MarCom Group, our "Core Four" values guide every interaction - with each other and with our clients: 







 Foster Collaboration: We value every voice. We win as one. We proactively seek opportunities to collaborate, reaching across teams and with clients to create solutions together.


 Inspire Possibilities: We imagine more, create boldly, and turn ideas into reality. We stay open-minded, flexible, and creative, always seeking innovative approaches.


 Champion People: We invest in people, and they invest in themselves, so we grow together. We celebrate our team, share wins, and have immense compassion for each other, our clients, and the audiences we serve.


 Lead with Why: We seek to understand, are always curious, and act with intention. We ask "why" to get to the root of challenges and deliver solutions that truly matter




Supervisory Responsibilities 




The Audience InsightsAnalyst position does not formally supervise other employees but may facilitate research workstreams, guide deliverable development, and provide direction to internal team members supporting research development tasks. 



Duties & Responsibilities





 Conduct qualitative and quantitative research to identify, understand, and prioritize talent audiences relevant to recruitment initiatives.


 Lead the development, refinement, and maintenance of research-based audience personas for marketing campaigns, integrating demographic, psychographic, behavioral, geographic, occupational, and motivational data to identify distinct candidate segments.


 Translate audience research into persona frameworks that inform campaign messaging, creative direction, channel selection, and audience engagement strategies.


 Develop detailed audience profiles that capture candidate characteristics, career motivations, values, communication preferences, employment barriers, and recruitment decision drivers.


 Create scalable persona templates, segmentation frameworks, and audience intelligence resources that can be applied across multiple client accounts.


 Establish processes for validating and updating personas using campaign performance data, candidate feedback, and emerging research.


 Monitor changes in workforce trends, candidate sentiment, and employment preferences that may influence recruitment marketing effectiveness.


 Collaborate with Brand Strategy, Creative, Media, and Account Services teams to incorporate audience intelligence into integrated recruitment marketing strategies.


 Participate in campaign planning sessions, creative brief development, client workshops, and strategic presentations to ensure audience insights are incorporated into execution.


 Analyze marketing performance data to assess audience engagement, candidate response, and progression through awareness and recruitment funnels.


 Develop clear, compelling audience intelligence reports, persona profiles, candidate journey maps, and research presentations for internal and external stakeholders.




Skills & Qualifications



Required 





 Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Market Research, Psychology, Sociology, Data Analytics, Business, Communications, Human Resources, or a related field.


 5+ years of experience in market research, audience insights, workforce analytics, talent intelligence, recruitment marketing, or a related field.


 Experience developing audience segments, candidate personas, or research-based audience profiles.


 Experience conducting qualitative and quantitative research - including demographic, behavioral, psychographic, geographic, and occupational data - and translating into actionable recommendations.


 Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, visualization, and presentations.


 Strong analytical, communication, organizational, and project management skills.


 Ability to collaborate across teams and explain insights to technical and nontechnical audiences.




Preferred 





 Experience in recruitment marketing, employer branding, talent acquisition, workforce development, or public-sector marketing.


 Familiarity with federal hiring, workforce priorities, or specialized talent populations.


 Experience with labor market, survey, social listening, digital analytics, CRM, or recruitment funnel tools (i.e. Sprout, Salesforce/Yello, BLS, SEMRush, Qualtrics/Survey Monkey, Lightcast, etc.)


 Experience with data visualization or business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.


 Knowledge of statistical analysis, audience segmentation, research validation, candidate journey mapping, or competitive talent analysis.


 Understanding of equal employment opportunity principles, privacy, and responsible use of audience data.





The pay range for this role is:




80,000 - 95,000 USD per year (Remote)

description:
Marketing Data AnalystLocation: Remote
Status: Full-Time 

At Marketing Architects, we believe TV advertising is still the most powerful marketing channel. But the typical process for TV is expensive, difficult to scale and to measure. So we flipped the traditional approach on its head and rebuilt the agency model with the client in mind. Today, we're growing a team of talent from across the United States to reimagine how brands advertise on TV.



ROLE OVERVIEW The Data Analyst is a core member of our Analytics team, responsible for answering real business questions using marketing and media data. You'll report to the Director of Analytics and work closely with cross-functional partners to ensure our measurement is accurate, thoughtful and actionable.

This role is closest to the data and we're taking an all-inclusive approach to help clients effectively navigate the complexities of measuring television advertising effectiveness. You'll deeply understand campaign inputs, assumptions and outputs, and you'll help teams and clients clearly understand what the numbers mean (and what to do next). We expect AI to be part of how you work. Use it to move faster and cover more ground than an analyst could alone, and bring the judgment that decides which answers are actually right.

 What you'll do: 

Deliver accurate analysis: Complete high-quality analyses that directly answer business and client questions, ensuring data accuracy, and consistency.

Evaluate TV performance: Measure the impact of TV and streaming campaigns on digital performance, business outcomes and overall marketing effectiveness.

Uncover actionable insights: Go beyond surface-level results to identify patterns, risks and opportunities that strengthen campaign decisions.

Validate data and assumptions: Question inputs, methodologies and outputs to ensure results make sense and stand up to scrutiny. Including AI-generated outputs.

Translate data into clarity: Build clear visualizations and explain findings in plain language so internal teams and clients can confidently act on them.

Work AI-forward: Use AI tools to accelerate querying, scripting, QA and first-draft analysis so you can test more scenarios and turn work around faster using appropriate context, then apply your own judgment to what the results mean.

 Who you are: 

An agency-trained analyst: 2–5 years of experience in marketing analytics, media analytics or a related quantitative field, ideally supporting campaign measurement.

Strong academic foundation: 3.5 GPA or equivalent academic performance in a quantitative field such as business, economics, statistics, mathematics, computer science, marketing or similar.

Data-literate: You interpret performance data, identify trends, and connect insights back to defined KPIs to inform decisions.

Strong in Excel: Comfortable using formulas, pivots tables and structured analysis to organize, validate and analyze large datasets.

Experienced with BI or data tools: You've worked in platforms like Domo, Databricks, SQL or similar environments to explore and troubleshoot data.

Presentation-ready: You've built clear, client-ready slides that explain campaign results or analytical findings in a logical way and can present them with confidence.

AI-enabled: You use AI tools to improve workflows, explore data or enhance analysis and you understand their strengths and limitations. You can point to work AI helped you do faster or more thoroughly, and you can explain your methodology and your math without it.

Accountable for the answer: The conclusions are yours. You can walk anyone through the logic, the assumptions and the numbers unaided, and you know when a tool's output needs to be thrown out.

 Our values:

Hungry Humble Smart: We seek a trifecta of talent. We take initiative and act with urgency. Look inwards before outwards. Value EQ over IQ.

Mindset Matters: Success starts between our ears. We face challenges with a calm confidence and pivot quickly. As eternal optimists, we know we are capable of great things and have survived worse. Our best days are always ahead.

Team Is Hero: We, not me. Being a hero is a team sport and it's the unique talents of many that make us one of a kind. No one person can win the day, but great teams can change the world.



BENEFITS OVERVIEWWe offer rewarding careers that encourage growth while providing industry-leading benefits including:

Fully remote within the US

100% employer-paid medical, dental and disability, with vision option

Traditional and Roth 401(k) with a 4% company match

Flexible paid time off, 9 paid holidays plus 2 floating holidays

Paid parental leave

Annual office supply allowance, monthly internet stipend and employer-paid cell phone

Opportunities to connect virtually and in-person twice a year with our fully remote team

Learn more at marketingarchitects.com/careers



ADDITIONAL INFORMATIONWe want applications from everyone, regardless of race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, marital status, citizen status, age, disability, military or protected veteran status, genetic predisposition or carrier status or any other legally protected status.

Our remote-friendly work model supports flexibility across the US, however we are currently unable to support employment in California. We are unable to consider applicants who live outside of the US.

At this time, we're not considering candidates that need any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future. This includes, but is not limited to: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, O-1, etc.

The application for this position may request a short, job relevant assessment as part of our multi-stage interview process. Reasonable accommodations are available for this assessment, please reach out to talentteam@markarch.com.

The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs, location and market demands. The base pay range is subject to change and may be modified in the future.

This role centers on the development, optimization, and support of bioinformatics workflows and computational pipelines that drive MaxCyte\'s assay development and data interpretation efforts. Partner with interdisciplinary teams to integrate biological, genomic, and computational data for off‐target assessment in gene editing systems. Develop, optimize, and document scalable bioinformatics pipelines, ensuring reproducibility, traceability, and compliance with relevant standards (ex. GLP). Perform data processing and analysis including read alignment, variant detection, annotation, and quality control across multiple sequencing platforms. Evaluate and benchmark bioinformatics algorithms, tools, and reference databases for suitability and accuracy within MaxCyte workflows. Provide clear interpretation and visualization of bioinformatics results to guide experimental design and product development. Collaborate with software engineering teams to deploy validated pipelines into production environments. Maintain thorough documentation of all analyses, pipelines, and validation procedures to support regulatory and scientific transparency. Stay current with advances in bioinformatics tools, genome editing technologies, and NGS analysis methodologies. Demonstrated expertise in NGS data analysis, including alignment, variant calling, annotation, and data interpretation. Hands‐on experience with commonly used bioinformatics tools and packages (ex. Samtools, BWA, GATK, Picard, BEDTools, or equivalent). Familiarity with CRISPR‐based gene editing and related off‐target assessment methods is required. Strong programming skills in Python and R, with experience developing and maintaining computational pipelines. Proficiency in Linux environments, version control (ex. GitHub), and workflow management systems (ex. NextFlow, CI/CD). Experience with cloud computing environments (ex. AWS, GCP) for large‐scale data processing and pipeline infrastructure. Hands‐on experience building Docker containers and orchestrating batch processing workflows using AWS Batch and Elastic Container Registry (ECR), or similar. Proven ability to independently analyze and interpret complex genomic datasets. Strong organizational, communication, and documentation skills, with the ability to work effectively in a collaborative, interdisciplinary setting. Preferred Skills Experience in industry preferred. Experience integrating multi‐omics datasets (transcriptomics, epigenomics, proteomics) to support biological insight. Familiarity with regulatory and quality system standards (e.g., GLP, GxP) for bioinformatics data management. Working knowledge of statistical and computational approaches for data interpretation, visualization, and reproducibility. Familiarity with infrastructure‐as‐code frameworks (AWS CDK, Terraform). description:
Maximus' Learning and Organizational Development (L&OD) function is seeking a Sr. Specialist, AI & Technical Upskilling (remote) to help build the AI and technical skills our employees need to thrive in a rapidly evolving workforce. 

This role designs, coordinates, and continuously improves scalable learning solutions that help employees build practical AI and technical skills, use emerging technologies responsibly, and apply learning directly to their work. The Sr. Specialist partners with business stakeholders, subject matter experts, HR partners, technology teams, vendors, and learning contributors to translate skill needs into clear learning pathways, high-quality assets, practical reinforcement, and measurable outcomes. 

This role is ideal for a learning professional who brings strong instructional design judgment, curiosity about AI and emerging technology, stakeholder confidence, and program execution discipline.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities:

- Execute the development and implementation of learning assets through close collaboration with the Training Operations Team.

- Use training technology to help provide creative and scalable training solutions. 

- Help to develop and support the implementation of the LMS learning strategy and measurement of that strategy for the organization.

- Support LMS system audits.

- Create and document processes for learning solutions, architecture decisions and operating procedures.

- Work in partnership with the HRIS team to support LMS system updates.

- Work with vendor to secure and onboard new learning technologies for delivering, tracking, and/or creating learning content.

- Consult and collaborate with leaders at all levels as well as cross-functional stakeholders to and provide learning solutions using the LMS functionalities.

- Define support LMS system roles and permissions.

- Support and advise on overall system configuration and availability groups. 

- Support and train Global system Super Users and Admin.

 JOB SPECIFIC DUTIES: 

Design & Development

 - Support the design, development, and continuous improvement of enterprise AI and technical upskilling programs, including foundational AI literacy, responsible AI use, role-based technical learning, and applied learning experiences. 

 - Design and draft instructionally sound storyboards that translate complex AI and technical topics into eLearning, instructor-led, virtual, and blended learning formats. 

 - Develop and maintain learning pathways, job aids, facilitator guides, learner communications, discussion guides, practice activities, and reinforcement resources. 

 - Create practical learning scenarios that help employees recognize appropriate AI use cases, evaluate risks, improve prompts, validate outputs, and decide where human judgment is required. 

 - Apply adult learning principles, accessibility practices, and plain-language standards to make learning approachable, usable, and inclusive. 

AI & Learning Technology

 - Translate AI, automation, data, and technical concepts into clear, practical learning content employees can apply in real work scenarios. 

 - Contribute to responsible AI learning by ensuring content reinforces approved tools, data handling expectations, human oversight, privacy considerations, and organizational guidance. 

Stakeholder Partnership & Change

 - Partner with subject matter experts, business stakeholders, HR partners, change leads, and technology teams to identify skill needs, define learning objectives, and shape learning experiences that align to business priorities. 

 - Support external technical certification pathways and vendor-delivered learning offerings by helping assess fit, coordinate implementation, and monitor learner progress. 

 - Coordinate program logistics, content updates, facilitator preparation, vendor collaboration, communications, learner support, and delivery readiness across virtual, in-person, and blended formats. 

 - Maintain AI and technical learning materials as tools, models, policies, and workforce needs evolve. 

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

 - Support skills gap analysis and needs assessment work by gathering stakeholder input, reviewing learning data, and translating findings into recommended learning priorities. 

 - Use LMS data, survey feedback, assessments, and other learning analytics to evaluate participation, learner experience, behavior change, and program improvement opportunities. 

 - Recommend process improvements that make AI and technical upskilling programs more scalable, measurable, and easier for employees and leaders to adopt. 

 - Adhere to established safety standards and perform other duties as assigned.

- Bachelor's Degree and 5+ years of experience required

- Five (5) or more years of experience in the area of Learning & Development and Learning Management Systems administration required (preferable CSOD). 
- Three (3) or more years of experience supporting a global/complex instance of the Learning Management System Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD). 
- Experience working on complex issues where analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth knowledge of the company.
- Ability to regularly interact with senior leaders and executives.
- Demonstrated ability to think strategically and translate business performance gaps into learning and development strategies.

 JOB SPECIFIC MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS: 

 -Five (5) or more years of experience in Corporate Learning & Development, instructional design, curriculum development, or a combination of these areas.

 -Experience d esigning technical training and supporting certification strategy for technical audiences. 

 -Foundational understanding of AI concepts, LLMs, prompt engineering, and responsible AI practices, with the ability to translate these into learning content. 

 -Experience designing, drafting, and developing storyboards for learning solutions, including eLearning, instructor-led training, virtual learning, and blended formats. 

 -Demonstrated ability to identify learning needs and translate them into practical learning solutions. 

 -Experience navigating complex organizational environments and partnering with stakeholders across functions. 

 Preferred Qualifications: 

 The following qualifications are helpful but not required. Candidates are not expected to meet every preferred qualification. 

Design & Development

 -Strong understanding of instructional design principles and adult learning theory (e.g., ADDIE, Rapid Course Development). 

 -Experience developing learning assets across multiple formats, including eLearning, ILT, Virtual ILT, job aids, presentations, discussion guides, and performance support resources. 

 -Experience applying visual design principles to create polished, accessible materials such as slide decks, infographics, and quick reference guides. 

 -Strong writing, editing, facilitation, and communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics in plain language for different audiences. 

AI & Learning Technology

 -Experience designing, coordinating, or improving enterprise learning programs related to AI, technical skills, digital transformation, automation, data literacy, or emerging technologies. 

 -Proficiency with Canva, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Copilot, SharePoint, and Teams. 

Stakeholder Partnership & Change

 -Proven ability to partner with SMEs and cross-functional teams to gather content, clarify objectives, and align to business needs. 

 -Experience coordinating vendors, facilitators, internal contributors, and learning operations partners to deliver programs on time and with consistent quality. 

Measurement & Continuous Improvement

 -Experience supporting skills gap analyses and needs assessments. 

 -Ability to translate skills requirements into clear learning objectives, learning pathways, and program components. 

 -Experience using learning data, surveys, assessments, and learner feedback to identify opportunities for improvement. 

 -Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams, competing priorities, and deadlines while maintaining quality and stakeholder confidence. 

 -Curiosity and continuous learning mindset related to AI, data, automation, learning technology, and future skills.

We are seeking a Data Reporting and Analytics Consultant to support clinical research initiatives focused on vaccines and infectious diseases. In this role, you will work with clinical research data to develop and maintain analytical programs, generate reports, and support research teams in answering important healthcare questions.


This is an excellent opportunity for an early- to mid-career professional with a background in biostatistics, epidemiology, public health, data science, or a related field who enjoys combining programming and analytical skills with meaningful healthcare research.


You will collaborate with experienced researchers and analysts, contribute to ongoing research projects, and help ensure that data and analytical results are accurate, reliable, and useful for research decision-making.


Key Responsibilities:

Develop, maintain, and update analytical programs and reports supporting clinical research projects.
Use SQL and R or Python to access, analyze, manipulate, and interpret research data.
