Job Description Our client is a leading provider of sustainable energy solutions, specializing in renewable energy sources such as wind, solar, and battery storage. With a commitment to innovation and environmental responsibility, they aim to power a brighter, more sustainable future for communities and businesses around the world. Offering a diverse portfolio of energy products and services, they strive to meet the evolving needs of their customers while reducing carbon emissions and promoting energy efficiency. 

Take your career to the next level by working on a dynamic and innovative team as a Database Marketing Analyst. The position develops and delivers accurate marketing campaign populations for retail direct marketing initiatives targeting residential customers, small business customers, and prospects. The role applies a strong understanding of direct marketing objectives, customer eligibility, and campaign business rules to interpret requirements, build and extract target populations, and format data for execution in partnership with Marketing, Campaign Operations, and Channel Execution teams. 

Essential Duties/Responsibilities: This role focuses on audience and campaign list development and execution support based on defined business requirements. Pre-campaign analytics, predictive modeling, and post-campaign performance analysis are generally outside the scope of the position. Interpret campaign objectives, eligibility criteria, customer segmentation, and channel requirements to develop accurate target populations across multiple marketing channels. 

Ability to manage multiple campaign development projects simultaneously, each at different stages of the campaign lifecycle, while meeting deadlines and maintaining a high level of accuracy. Utilize SAS as the primary development tool to create, maintain, and execute campaign population processes while supporting ongoing business and marketing initiatives. Collaborate with Segment Marketing to understand and document campaign list requirements, and coordinate with Channel Marketing to deliver campaign populations and resolve issues during delivery and execution. 

Serve as the primary point of contact for Segment Marketing and Channel Marketing on campaign population development and delivery. Lead quality assurance for campaign development work by validating that outputs align with documented business rules and campaign requirements. Establish coding and development standards that promote consistency, accuracy, and repeatability across campaigns. 

Provide campaign population insights and progress updates during regularly scheduled campaign meetings. Coordinate data exchanges with Marketing Analytics to support campaign list development and related business needs. Use campaign list development findings to provide relevant audience and population insights to Segment Marketing. 

Demonstrate a dependable, diligent, and accountable approach to work. Education: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Computer Science, or a quantitative field from an accredited four-year college or university preferred. Experience: Minimum of 4 years of experience in direct marketing or marketing analysis, with strong analytical, logical, and problem-solving skills required. 

Experience using SAS software and working in a UNIX environment required. Additional Knowledge, Skills and Abilities: Thorough understanding of direct marketing, campaign management, customer segmentation, and targeted audience development concepts. Ability to interpret campaign objectives and translate business requirements, eligibility criteria, and customer rules into accurate campaign populations. 

Strong business judgment and attention to detail when evaluating campaign requirements, data conditions, and downstream execution impacts. Advanced SAS, SQL, and database skills. Strong proficiency in a UNIX environment. 

Strong data manipulation, preparation, validation, and presentation skills. Proven record of accurate, on-time delivery of campaign and project deliverables. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to clarify requirements and explain campaign population logic to business partners. 

Proficiency with Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Copilot. Competent with Databricks, Genie and campaign management tools. Experience with project management tools, such as Microsoft Project.

description:
Omniscient is an organic growth agency that builds revenue-focused organic growth systems for B2B software companies - optimized for both search engines and generative AI.




We pride ourselves on being lean, agile, and experimental. Our team thrives on R&D and innovation, always exploring the smartest ways to deliver exceptional results. We believe in a culture of building and shipping - whether it's client deliverables, new services, or internal tools that keep us ahead of the game.




If you're looking for a role where you'll tackle challenging problems, work with ambitious brands, and help shape the future of organic growth, let's talk.




Learn about the principles that drive how we work and build a company.

About this role




You own the evidence behind our clients' growth decisions.




Our clients are investing serious money in AI search, SEO, and organic growth programs, and their executives are now asking: how does all of this tie back to signups, pipeline, and revenue?




Your job is to answer that question credibly, with clean and correctly wired data. You'll run analytics audits and implementations across our book, including enterprise accounts on Adobe Analytics and Adobe Experience Cloud.




You'll support our team's experiments, some of them conventional CRO tests and some of them brand new - like measuring whether adding FAQ content to a landing page moves citation share in LLM results.




This role is our first dedicated analytics hire. You will report to our CCO and operate as a center of excellence for the agency, meaning that prioritization is a key part of the job. If you like operating autonomously to find the story in the data and explain it to teammates and clients, this job is for you.




We're a fully remote team. We require work hours to overlap +/- 3 hours with US Eastern Time, since you'll be working directly with US-based client stakeholders.



Your responsibilities





 Own analytics audits and implementation. Assess client tracking setups across web and product analytics, identify gaps in data quality, taxonomy, and measurement, and fix them yourself. This includes hands-on configuration of tracking, tagging, and events in Adobe Analytics, CJA, GA4, and product analytics tools, as well as the data layer and tag management architecture underneath.
 Build the measurement layer that connects organic and AI search to revenue. Make sure things are wired up correctly, integrate data across sources, and build the attribution view that lets client execs see how SEO, AI visibility, content, and paid contribute to business outcomes.
 Run advanced analysis and segmentation. Deepen our reporting so we can answer why metrics are moving, including funnels, cohorts, behavioral segments, and SQL when the dashboard cannot get you there. You don't wait on someone else to pull the data.
 Enrich our client reporting. Design a useful reporting approach, document it as standard, and train strategists and account managers to run it without you. Success here means the process outlives your involvement.
 Build BI reporting and dashboards clients actually use. In the tools each client already relies on, built so stakeholders bookmark them and share them internally.
 Be the senior data partner on our largest accounts. You'll carry the measurement relationship on our enterprise engagements, present findings to client executives, hold your own in QBRs and strategy conversations, and create the connective tissue between our day-to-day work and a client's strategic goals.
 Support experimentation design and analysis. With our team, run conventional CRO and landing page tests, and help us invent AEO experimentation. You'll have a chance to define hypotheses, measurement approaches, and the read of the data.
 Enable client-side teams. Some of our largest accounts want us to level up their internal teams, not just deliver to them. If sold, you'll run assessments, workshops, and training that make their people better at measurement.
 Help define what we can credibly sell. Partner with leadership on how we scope analytics, CRO, and experimentation services.




Who you are



 You've worked hands-on in an enterprise Adobe environment. Adobe Analytics is required, and you've used Customer Journey Analytics or Adobe Experience Platform alongside it. We mean production experience on a large, messy implementation, not a certification. Dreamdata and HockeyStack experience is a bonus.
 You've also worked with GA4 or comparable web analytics platforms, and with product analytics tools like Amplitude.
 You write SQL comfortably and can query, join, and shape data across sources to answer questions a dashboard can't.
 You can run an analytics audit end to end: find the gaps, prioritize them, and fix the implementation yourself.
 You can hold your own with a client's engineering team. You know what you're asking for when you request a data layer change; you can read an existing implementation, and you can scope work with the people who will ship it.
 You think in segments and cohorts, not just aggregates, and you know when an average is hiding the real story.
 You're a careful, meticulous reader of both data and instructions (the passcode is measurewhatmatters2026).
 You can explain a finding to a client's VP as clearly as you'd explain it to a fellow analyst, and you're comfortable being challenged on it.
 Data visualization skills are a strong plus. You know how to make a chart do the explaining.
 Experience in AEO, SEO, or organic growth marketing is a plus. Genuine curiosity about how AI search works is close to required, because a lot of this measurement problem has not been solved yet.
 You're not an asshole. We spend a lot of our days engaging with team members and clients. There's no room for assholes. You're friendly, eager to jump in and take ownership, and love to work as a team to be successful.




Why you should work with us




We're here to help you do great work and grow personally and professionally.



 A function to build: You're our first dedicated analytics hire. You'll set the standard, and if this works the way we think it will, you'll help us decide who to add next.
 Real impact: Your analysis directly shapes what clients decide to do next, and what we decide to build as a business. You're not producing reports that sit in a folder.
 Shiny new problems: Measuring AI search performance is an unsolved problem. You'd be helping define how it gets done, not applying a playbook someone else wrote.
 Autonomy and ownership: You own the audits, the implementation, the experiments, and the insight, end to end.
 Variety: You'll work across many clients, industries, and analytics stacks, including enterprise Adobe environments, not one narrow system.
 Coaching: We'll coach you toward becoming world-class at your function, and you'll help us do the same for the rest of the team.
 Remote flexibility: We're a 100% remote company, so you can work from anywhere.
 Team trips: We take team trips each year to places like Austin, Mexico City, Costa Rica, and Belgrade to get some time together in person.




Benefits




We're fortunate to offer competitive salaries and benefits, and we strive to create an environment that allows you to do your best work, develop your skills, and grow your career.



 Health insurance: 90% of medical, dental, and vision insurance premiums paid for employees in the US
 401k with employer match: We'll match 100% of your contributions up to the first 3% of pay, then 50% of your contributions on the next 2% of pay.
 Profit share: Opportunity to participate in our quarterly profit share program after 1 year of employment.
 Unlimited vacation: We trust you to take care of your work and communicate when you need time off. We recommend taking a minimum of 14 days a year.
 Learning and development stipend: $2,000 to spend on professional development after 1 year of employment.
 Free books program: We'll cover the cost of a Kindle and 1 Kindle book a month.
 Networking stipend: $50 per month to spend on coffee or lunch for professional networking.
 100% remote flexibility: Work from wherever you want.

One Off Robotics builds some of the largest robotic metal 3D printing systems in the industry, and we run them as a service. Based in Chattanooga, Tennessee, our team of engineers, designers and builders designs, wires, programs and commissions large-format robotic additive manufacturing work cells, then puts them to work producing real metal parts for customers.


The role


You'll write the software that makes our robotic work cells run, from the PLC and robot controller up to the Windows applications our operators use every day. You'll work across the whole stack and help shape how our software is architected as we scale from a few systems to many.


What you'll do

Veeva is building the industry cloud for Life Sciences through software, data, AI, and business consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.


Consulting is changing, and we're not like other firms. Launched in 2019, Veeva Business Consulting has grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep domain knowledge with innovative technology to help Life Sciences companies work in a more efficient and connected way.


We are growing aggressively as we look towards 2030. We are seeking great people to help shape the future of the industry with the world's leading software, data, AI, and expertise at their back.


The Role
As a Data Scientist in our EU Analytics practice, you will help customers bring treatments to patients faster by transforming how they work with Technology, Data, and AI. You will focus on reshaping operating models, driving organizational change, and measuring tangible business value.


You will play a pivotal role in building advanced analytical models and methodologies, integrating Veeva Data Cloud products with complex European healthcare data assets. You will drive innovation across our analytical offerings, ensuring Veeva remains at the forefront of data-led, tech-enabled Life Sciences commercial models. You will also collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to bridge technical modeling with practical business insights across European markets. You will take ownership of any of our analytics assets (e.g., design solution, manage expectations, status accountancy, impact measurement).


What You'll Do

Design, prototype, and scale advanced analytics solutions for Life Sciences customers across European markets
Process, harmonize, and connect Veeva Data Cloud products with diverse European healthcare data assets
Develop and apply statistical methodologies, machine learning, and AI models to solve complex, high-impact commercial and strategic business questions in the Life Sciences space
Build and design HCP precision engagement engines that connect disparate healthcare datasets integrated seamlessly with customer CRM information to enable personalized, data-driven targeting and activation
Collaborate closely in integrated, cross-functional teams alongside product managers, data engineers, operations, and consultants to deliver end-to-end analytical solutions and ensure continuous feedback and iteration
Maintain clear documentation of data methodologies, model architectures, and validation processes to ensure defensibility, scalability, and transparency across client engagements

Requirements

2+ years of proven experience in data science, advanced analytics, or machine learning roles, preferably within Life Sciences, pharmaceuticals, or healthcare analytics
Strong problem-solving and communication skills, with a track record of collaborating effectively across cross-functional teams. Skilled at translating complex technical challenges to non-technical stakeholders, driving impactful problem-solving sessions, and championing a pragmatic approach to solution design
Strong technical expertise across Python, SQL, advanced analytics, machine learning, and AI, with a proven ability to design and implement predictive models and intelligent algorithms that solve complex business problems
You bring Experience writing process documentation, technical specifications, and data collection guidelines to ensure quality, scalability, and repeatability across projects

Nice to Have

Knowledge of Veeva products
Experience delivering SaaS or Tech-enabled consulting solutions
M.S. or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
Languages in addition to English
Understanding of healthcare, life sciences, or pharmaceutical industry data
Experience with data visualization tools to create dashboards and reports
Understanding of data engineering concepts (ETL, data pipelines) and automation tools such as Apache Airflow
Familiarity with cloud based computing resources such as AWS

Interviewing with Veeva
We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.



Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:

A conversation with the hiring manager
A practical case exercise
A final conversation with our group's Senior Leader.
Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.



Perks & Benefits

Compensation: Highly competitive salary and equity in Veeva
Growth: Unrivalled career progression in a fast-growing, global team
Flexibility: Veeva is a Work Anywhere company. You can work from home or the office on any given day

Compensation

Total compensation: 48,000 - 75,000 EUR

Veeva's headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.

We value people for the individuals they are and the contributions they can bring to our teams.

description:
About Opeongo 

 Opeongo is a seed-stage AI company building the Meshwork Virtual Machine — a compound foundation model of the extracellular matrix (ECM) remodeling network, and the ECM layer of the digital human. It learns shared representations of tissue state from multimodal experimental data, simulates remodeling dynamics, and predicts response to perturbation. 

 We are hiring a Senior Applied Deep Learning Research Engineer to work on the model itself — the 

 architecture, training, and evaluation of the Meshwork Virtual Machine. 

 What you will work on 

 FOUNDATION MODEL RESEARCH 

 – Own research threads on the architecture of the Meshwork Virtual Machine — multimodal 

 representation learning, representation of heterogeneous biological measurements, simulation of 

 dynamics, and perturbation response prediction 

 – Design and run training runs and ablations, and draw conclusions that survive scrutiny 

 – Own evaluation that distinguishes real capability from leakage, batch artifacts, and wishful metrics 

 – Bring methods from the wider machine learning literature into a domain that has not yet applied them 

 ENGINEERING AND INFRASTRUCTURE 

 – Build the training and evaluation infrastructure the research requires 

 – Develop data pipelines that turn heterogeneous experimental data into model-ready inputs 

 – Own reproducibility for your work — experiment tracking, seeds, environments, and results others 

 can rebuild 

 – Make and defend practical decisions about compute, scale, and where efficiency actually matters 

 COLLABORATION AND SCIENTIFIC CONTRIBUTION 

 – Work directly with the biological team to turn biological questions into model questions, and results 

 back into experiments 

 – Learn enough of the underlying biology to ask good questions and to recognize when a result is 

 biologically implausible– Contribute to technical documentation, internal reports, and investor-facing scientific material 

 – Share work externally where it serves the platform — publications, preprints, and open source 

 Profile 

 Experience or demonstrable ability is required in each of the following. Candidates are assessed on the 

 substance of their work rather than on formal credentials alone. 

 REQUIREMENTS 

 – Command of modern deep learning — architectures, training dynamics, optimization, and evaluation 

 – Hands-on experience training and evaluating large models on real data, beyond fine-tuning existing 

 checkpoints 

 – Proficiency in Python and PyTorch or JAX, with the engineering ability to build experimental 

 infrastructure independently 

 – Judgment to own research direction rather than only execution — defining a problem, designing the 

 experiment that tests it, and determining when a result is sound 

 – Ability to communicate clearly with scientists who are not machine learning specialists 

 – Capacity to acquire domain knowledge in an unfamiliar field, and the rigor to do so properly 

 ADVANTAGES 

 Domain experience in the life sciences is an advantage rather than a requirement; the necessary 

 biological grounding is developed in role. 

 – Experience with transformers, graph neural networks, diffusion or generative models applied to 

 structured scientific data 

 – Foundation model work — pre-training, adaptation, or rigorous evaluation 

 – Multimodal or cross-modal modeling, including work on modalities with mismatched scale and noise 

 – Research experience at a frontier AI lab or a leading AI-for-science organization 

 – A PhD in machine learning, computer science, or a related field 

 – Exposure to biological, biomedical, or other high-noise experimental data 

 – Open-source authorship or maintenance 

 – Experience in a startup or early-stage research environment 

 How to apply 

 Send a CV and a brief cover note to . Links to publications, preprints, or code are 

 preferred over summaries of prior work. 

 Opeongo is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive workspace.

The ideal candidate will have expertise in NLP, deep learning, transformer models, and Large Language Models (LLMs). You will build scalable applications for text understanding, conversational AI, information extraction, document processing, search, and generative AI while collaborating with cross-functional teams to deliver production-ready AI solutions.
 
Key Responsibilities
 Design, develop, and deploy NLP and Generative AI solutions for real-world applications. Build and optimize models for text classification, named entity recognition (NER), sentiment analysis, question answering, summarization, machine translation, text generation, and conversational AI. Develop and fine-tune transformer-based models such as BERT, RoBERTa, T5, GPT, Llama, Mistral, and Gemma. Build Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and retrieval frameworks. Perform data preprocessing, tokenization, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and optimization. Develop scalable APIs and inference services for NLP applications. Evaluate model performance using NLP metrics such as Precision, Recall, F1-Score, BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, and BERTScore. Collaborate with data scientists, ML engineers, software developers, and product teams to deploy AI solutions into production. Optimize model performance, latency, scalability, and inference costs. Stay updated with the latest advancements in NLP, LLMs, Generative AI, and agentic AI. 
Required Qualifications
 Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Computational Linguistics, Data Science, or a related field. 2-5 years of experience in NLP, machine learning, or AI application development. Strong understanding of:
 Natural Language Processing (NLP) Deep Learning Transformer Architectures Language Modeling Information Retrieval Embeddings Prompt Engineering Proficiency in Python. Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow. Hands-on experience with Hugging Face Transformers, spaCy, NLTK, or Sentence Transformers. Experience developing REST APIs and deploying machine learning models. Familiarity with Git, Docker, Linux, and SQL. 
Preferred Qualifications
 Experience working with Large Language Models (LLMs) such as GPT, Llama, Mistral, Gemma, Claude, or similar models. Hands-on experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), semantic search, and vector databases such as FAISS, Pinecone, Milvus, Weaviate, or Chroma. Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, or LlamaIndex. Experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT), LoRA, or QLoRA. Knowledge of model deployment, inference optimization, and MLOps tools such as MLflow, Kubeflow, or Docker. Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. 
Technical Skills
 Python PyTorch / TensorFlow Hugging Face Transformers spaCy NLTK Sentence Transformers LangChain / LangGraph / LlamaIndex FAISS / Pinecone / Milvus / Weaviate / Chroma Docker Git Linux SQL REST APIs MLflow AWS / Azure / Google Cloud 
Soft Skills
 Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. Attention to detail and commitment to building high-quality AI solutions. Ability to work in cross-functional and Agile teams. Curiosity and passion for learning emerging AI technologies. 
Nice to Have
 Experience with multimodal AI and vision-language models. Familiarity with Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) or preference optimization techniques. Knowledge of AI agents, function calling, and workflow automation. Experience contributing to open-source NLP or AI projects. Publications or presentations related to NLP, LLMs, or Generative AI. 
Benefits
 Competitive salary and performance-based incentives. Comprehensive health and wellness benefits. Flexible or hybrid work arrangements. Learning, certification, and conference sponsorship opportunities. Access to modern GPU infrastructure and AI development tools. Opportunity to work on cutting-edge NLP, LLM, and Generative AI solutions in a collaborative and innovative environment.

Identifying and tracking WS's, including constituent systems, risks, issues, and opportunities.

Collaborate with others in the organization to ensure successful implementation of chosen problem solutions. Must have interpersonal skills with the ability to work on teams, persuade managers and executives to accept recommendations. Shall have the math skills to create models and methods to conduct appropriate research.


Models and methods are rooted in statistics, calculus, linear algebra, and other mathematics disciplines. Must be able to formulate mathematical or simulation models of problems, relating constants and variables, restrictions, alternatives, conflicting objectives, and their numerical parameters. Shall be able to diagnose problems and study relevant information to solve them. Perform validation and testing of models to ensure adequacy and reformulate models as necessary.


Utilizing and/or tailoring identified risks for implementation into the WS Worthiness Assessment (WWA) process. Aggregating and documenting the results of RIO analysis for presentation to AFNWC/NC leadership for situational awareness and to support decision‐making. Shall be able to formulate and apply mathematical modeling and other optimizing methods to develop and interpret information that assists management with decision making, policy formulation, or other managerial functions. Shall have sufficient knowledge of applied mathematics to understand and use the fundamental concepts and techniques of operations research methods of analysis. May collect and analyze data and develop decision support software, services, or products.


May develop and supply optimal time, cost, or logistics networks for program evaluation, review, or implementation. Developing, managing, and executing processes for assessing the WS ability to execute assigned missions.

Education/Certifications/Experience/Skills: Accredited BA Degree in operations research or at least 24 semester hours in a combination of operations research, mathematics, probability, statistics, mathematical logic, science, or subject‐matter courses requiring substantial competence in college-level mathematics or statistics, and 10 plus years of relevant experience. Courses acceptable for qualifying for operations research positions may have been taken in departments other than Operations Research, e.g., Engineering (usually Industrial Engineering), Science, Economics, Mathematics, Statistics, or Management Science. Must possess and maintain a government security clearance at the Top-Secret/SCI level. Must have the ability to work on high-visibility or mission critical aspects of a given program and performs all functional duties independently.


Must be proficient in the use of Microsoft programs (including Excel, Word, Outlook) Must be able to transport self to various facility sites, as required.

description: Position Summary The Clearing House is seeking an analytical and technically skilled Information Security Data Analyst to support cybersecurity risk reporting, data analysis, and performance measurement across the enterprise Information Security program. This role is responsible for transforming complex cybersecurity data into accurate, actionable insights that support operational decision-making, risk management, regulatory oversight, and executive reporting. The Information Security Data Analyst will work closely with Security Operations, Vulnerability Management, Identity and Access Management, Infrastructure, and Technology Risk teams to develop automated reporting, dashboards, and metrics that provide visibility into the organization's cybersecurity posture. A key focus of this position will be vulnerability management analytics, including the analysis of vulnerability exposure, remediation performance, asset criticality, and compliance with established remediation timelines. The ideal candidate combines strong data analytics capabilities with an understanding of cybersecurity concepts and can translate large volumes of technical information into clear, meaningful insights for technical teams and senior leadership. About The Clearing House: The Clearing House Payments Company L.L.C. is a bank-owned industry utility that shapes the payments landscape and provides infrastructure for safe, reliable, and efficient payments. We see an economy where everyone is connected and a future where modern payments make life easier. The Clearing House operates four payment systems: a high-value wire-transfer system (the CHIPS® network), the country's first and largest instant payments system (the RTP® network), an automated clearinghouse network (the EPN® network), and a check image exchange network (the Image Exchange Network). TCH also operates a bank account number tokenization service, runs a payments association known as the TCH Payments Authority, and maintains the rules for private-sector check image exchange through its ECCHO® business line. Key Responsibilities Cybersecurity Data Analytics & Reporting Collect, analyze, validate, and interpret cybersecurity data from multiple enterprise security platforms. Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models that measure cybersecurity risk, operational effectiveness, and control performance. Transform complex technical data into clear, actionable insights for Information Security leadership, executive management, and risk committees. Identify trends, anomalies, emerging risks, and opportunities for improvement across cybersecurity operations. Establish repeatable reporting processes that improve accuracy, consistency, and timeliness. Automate data collection, transformation, reconciliation, and reporting to reduce manual effort. Support the development of cybersecurity key risk indicators (KRIs), key performance indicators (KPIs), and operational metrics. Maintain clear documentation of data sources, metric definitions, calculations, assumptions, and reporting methodologies. Vulnerability Management Analytics Develop and maintain vulnerability reporting across on-premises infrastructure, cloud environments, applications, and enterprise platforms. Analyze vulnerability data from Tenable, ServiceNow Vulnerability Response, and other relevant security tools. Track critical and high-severity vulnerabilities, remediation timelines, aging, exceptions, and exposure beyond established service-level agreements. Correlate vulnerability findings with asset inventories, business criticality, ownership, and operational context to improve risk-based prioritization. Identify recurring vulnerabilities, remediation bottlenecks, data quality issues, and emerging exposure trends. Develop reporting that distinguishes newly discovered vulnerabilities from existing exposure, overdue remediation, and changes resulting from expanded scanning coverage. Partner with infrastructure and application teams to validate vulnerability data, identify remediation owners, and improve reporting accuracy. Support vulnerability governance meetings through preparation of metrics, trend analysis, and executive-level reporting. Develop analytical capabilities to measure remediation progress and assess the effectiveness of vulnerability management activities. Security Metrics & Risk Reporting Support the design, development, and maintenance of Information Security KRIs and KPIs aligned with enterprise risk management requirements. Produce recurring cybersecurity reporting for executive leadership, risk committees, and other governance forums. Analyze trends in security incidents, vulnerability exposure, identity controls, security monitoring, and remediation effectiveness. Establish consistent calculation methodologies, reporting thresholds, and data quality controls. Investigate unexpected changes in metrics and distinguish actual risk increases from changes in detection capabilities, scanning coverage, or data sources. Partner with Technology Risk and other stakeholders to ensure reporting is accurate, traceable, and aligned with approved risk definitions. Prepare supporting analysis and evidence for internal audits, regulatory examinations, and management reviews. Develop historical trending and comparative analysis to help leadership evaluate the effectiveness of security investments and operational improvements. Data Integration, Automation & Visualization Develop automated data pipelines and reporting solutions using SQL, Python, Power BI, APIs, and other approved enterprise technologies. Integrate data from cybersecurity platforms and cloud security tools. Build interactive dashboards that allow stakeholders to analyze security metrics by business service, asset criticality, technology platform, ownership, and risk category. Perform data cleansing, normalization, reconciliation, and validation across multiple systems. Identify inconsistencies between security tools and authoritative asset or configuration management data. Create reusable datasets, reporting templates, and standardized analytical models. Work with technology teams to improve data accessibility, reliability, and reporting automation. Apply appropriate data access controls and handling practices to sensitive cybersecurity information. Data Quality & Continuous Improvement Establish controls to ensure cybersecurity reporting is complete, accurate, consistent, and reproducible. Document data lineage, business rules, transformations, and calculation logic supporting key security metrics. Investigate data discrepancies and collaborate with system owners to resolve underlying issues. Identify opportunities to simplify reporting processes and eliminate redundant or manual activities. Develop quality assurance checks to detect missing records, duplicate findings, incorrect asset classifications, and inconsistent remediation statuses. Recommend improvements to cybersecurity data models, reporting architecture, and analytical capabilities. Support continuous improvement initiatives that strengthen the organization's ability to measure and manage cybersecurity risk. Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with Information Security teams to understand operational processes, reporting requirements, and cybersecurity risk drivers. Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud Engineering, Application Development, Enterprise Architecture, and Technology Risk teams. Translate technical findings into concise summaries that communicate business impact and recommended actions. Support leadership in responding to ad hoc analytical requests, regulatory inquiries, and emerging cybersecurity issues. Present analytical findings and explain trends, assumptions, and limitations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience. Strong proficiency in SQL, including querying, joining, aggregating, and analyzing large datasets. Experience using Python, PowerShell, or similar scripting languages for data analysis and automation. Experience developing dashboards and reports using Microsoft Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence platforms. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, data transformation, formulas, and analytical reporting. Experience integrating and analyzing data from multiple enterprise systems using APIs, databases, or automated data extracts. Understanding of cybersecurity concepts, including vulnerabilities, asset management, security incidents, risk ratings, and remediation processes. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with demonstrated ability to identify trends, anomalies, and data inconsistencies. Experience developing metrics, performance indicators, and recurring management reports. Ability to communicate complex analytical findings clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences. Strong attention to detail, organizational skills, and ability to manage multiple reporting requirements. Must be legally authorized to work in the United States. Preferred Qualifications Experience working in banking, financial services, payment systems, or another highly regulated industry. Experience analyzing vulnerability data and familiarity with security platforms. Understanding of vulnerability severity ratings, CVSS, CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV), and risk-based vulnerability prioritization. Familiarity with cybersecurity frameworks and regulatory expectations, including NIST CSF, FFIEC guidance, and relevant financial services requirements. Experience developing executive dashboards and reporting for risk committees or senior management. Knowledge of statistical analysis, trend forecasting, data modeling, and data visualization best practices. Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst, CompTIA Security+, or other data analytics or cybersecurity certifications. Physical Demands and Work Environment: The working environment is generally favorable. Lighting and temperature are adequate, and there are no hazardous or unpleasant conditions caused by noise, dust, etc. Work is generally performed within an office environment, with standard office equipment available. Travel may be required. Candidates will report to the office three days each week. Onsite work requirements may change at any time. The Clearing House operates U.S-based payments networks that clear and settle more than $2 trillion each day through wire, ACH, check image, and real-time payments. It is the nation's most experienced payments company, with a long track record of providing secure and reliable systems, payments innovation, and strategic thought leadership to financial institutions. In 2017, The Clearing House revolutionized U.S. payments by introducing the RTP® network, which supports the immediate clearing and settlement of payments, along with the ability to exchange related payment information across the same secure channel. These RTP capabilities enable all financial institutions to offer safer, faster, and smarter digital transaction services for their corporate and retail customers. Learn more at www.theclearinghouse.org.

description:
PIMCO is a global leader in active fixed income with deep expertise across public and private markets. We invest our clients' capital across a range of fixed income and credit opportunities, leveraging our decades of experience navigating complex debt markets. Our flexible capital base and deep relationships with issuers have helped us become one of the world's largest providers of traditional and nontraditional solutions for companies that need financing and investors who seek strong risk-adjusted returns. 
 
Since 1971, our people have shaped our organization through a high-performance inclusive culture, in which we celebrate diverse thinking. We invest in our people and strive to imprint our CORE values of Collaboration, Openness, Responsibility and Excellence. We believe each of us is here to help others succeed and this has led to PIMCO being recognized as an innovator, industry thought leader and trusted advisor to our clients. 
 
 JOB DESCRIPTION 
 
The commodities business is an important part of PIMCO's investment platform. We are seeking a Quantitative Research Analyst / Desk Quant to join our front-office Commodities Analytics team in Newport Beach. The role will provide direct quantitative support to specialist Portfolio Managers trading listed and OTC derivatives across energy, power, agricultural, metals and soft commodity markets. 
 
The successful candidate will combine rigorous statistical and econometric modelling skills with strong commodities knowledge and practical software-development capabilities. Working closely with Portfolio Managers, traders, quantitative researchers and technologists, the analyst will develop research, risk and pre-trade analytics used to identify relative-value opportunities, manage portfolios and support investment decisions. The role will also contribute to the expansion of analytics coverage across commodity markets and the continued development of the team's technology and AI-enabled research capabilities. 
 
 RESPONSIBILITIES 
• Develop quantitative tools and empirical studies to support relative-value analysis, trading-opportunity evaluation and portfolio-management decisions across commodity markets 
• Build, enhance and maintain models that generate risk analytics for existing and prospective commodity positions 
• Develop pre-trade analytics and research tools within the team's Python ecosystem, with an emphasis on robust, scalable and reusable solutions 
• Provide timely quantitative support to Portfolio Managers and traders during US trading hours, including day-to-day risk management and operational analysis 
• Research, back-test and maintain systematic, option and quantitative investment strategies 
• Apply statistical, econometric and machine-learning techniques to commodity-specific datasets and investment problems 
• Contribute to the enhancement of PIMCO's technology infrastructure supporting commodity and quantitative strategies 
• Help broaden analytics coverage across energy, power, metals, agriculture and soft commodities REQUIREMENTS 
• Master's degree or PhD in mathematics, statistics, econometrics, financial economics, physics, engineering, computer science or another highly quantitative discipline; PhD preferred 
• 2-5 years of relevant experience as a commodity quant supporting a sell-side trading desk or a quantitatively oriented asset manager; exceptional junior candidates with directly relevant doctoral research will also be considered 
• Strong grounding in probability, statistics, econometrics, financial mathematics and empirical research 
• Demonstrated experience modelling commodity-specific processes, ideally across one or more of power, weather, oil, natural gas, metals or agricultural markets 
• Strong statistical and econometric modelling skills; knowledge of risk-neutral derivatives modelling and option analytics is desirable 
• Advanced programming ability in Python with experience delivering reliable analytical or research tools 
• Experience developing risk analytics, systematic-strategy research, option-strategy back-tests or pre-trade analytics 
• Exposure to machine learning, AI engineering or modern data-science techniques is desirable 
• Ability to work closely with Portfolio Managers and traders, communicate complex quantitative concepts clearly and deliver accurate analysis in a time-sensitive front-office environment 
• Collaborative, intellectually curious and self-directed, with strong attention to detail and a commitment to high-quality research and implementation PIMCO follows a total compensation approach when rewarding employees which includes a base salary and a discretionary bonus. Base salary is the fixed component of compensation that is determined by core job responsibilities, relevant experience, internal level, and market factors. The discretionary bonus is used to award performance and therefore is determined by company, business, team, and individual performance.

Position Summary

Our client is seeking an experienced Solutions Architect - AI to lead the design and implementation of enterprise AI solutions across a complex, large-scale business environment.

This individual will serve as both a hands-on technical architect and strategic AI leader, helping identify high-value use cases, establish scalable architecture standards, evaluate emerging technologies, and move AI solutions from concept through production.

Responsibilities

- Define enterprise architecture, standards, and reusable patterns for AI, machine learning, and Generative AI solutions.
- Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and production-ready AI architectures.
- Partner with business, product, engineering, data, and technology teams to identify and prioritize AI opportunities.
- Architect end-to-end AI solutions covering data ingestion, model development, inference, integration, and production deployment.
- Design solutions utilizing Generative AI, LLMs, RAG, vector search, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
- Evaluate and implement open-source AI and machine learning technologies.
- Provide hands-on technical guidance, including reference architectures, pipelines, schemas, and development patterns.
- Establish MLOps practices including CI/CD, model monitoring, automated retraining, drift detection, and cost management.
- Develop AI observability standards covering model performance, data quality, system health, latency, and production feedback loops.
- Establish security and governance standards for enterprise AI solutions.
- Address AI-specific risks including prompt injection, adversarial attacks, data poisoning, model security, and privacy concerns.
- Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine how they can be integrated into existing enterprise applications and platforms.
- Lead build vs. buy vs. open-source evaluations for AI capabilities.
- Help establish and mature enterprise AI governance and Center of Excellence capabilities.
- Partner with technical teams to ensure AI architectures are practical, scalable, secure, and executable.
- Help teams adopt AI technologies and productivity tools safely and effectively.

- 9+ years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, AI, machine learning, or related technology disciplines.
- 5+ years of experience in AI/ML architecture or a comparable technical leadership role.
- Proven experience designing and delivering production AI solutions within retail, e-commerce, supply chain, or a large consumer-facing environment.
- Strong hands-on experience with open-source AI and machine learning frameworks.
- Strong proficiency with Python and modern machine learning frameworks.
- Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, RAG architectures, vector search, and agentic AI technologies.
- Experience with modern enterprise data architectures including lakehouse, streaming, and batch-processing environments.
- Experience with enterprise cloud and data platforms.
- Demonstrated experience with MLOps, model monitoring, drift detection, and production AI observability.
- Understanding of AI security, governance, privacy, and responsible AI practices.
- Experience evaluating and integrating emerging AI technologies into existing enterprise environments.
- Ability to operate as both a hands-on technical builder and enterprise-level architect.
- Strong communication skills with the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience helping establish or scale an enterprise AI Center of Excellence.
- Direct experience within a retail or large consumer-facing organization.
- Experience with AI red-teaming, adversarial testing, or AI risk assessment.
- Experience contributing to or implementing open-source AI technologies.
- Relevant cloud, AI, or machine learning certifications.

description:
PakEnergy is accelerating its innovation. Help us lead it.
 
 
 More than 2,300 oil and gas companies run their land, production, accounting and transportation on PakEnergy. We've started putting AI to work across that platform. Now we're accelerating our pace of innovation, and we're building the PakEnergy Innovation Lab to do it.
 
 
 
 The Lab's mandate is simple: find the highest-value problems our customers face, prove solutions quickly with working prototypes built on real operational energy data, and take what works into production. We're hiring a Lead Data Scientist to be the founding owner of data science and machine learning on the Lab's cross-functional team, reporting directly to our Chief Product Officer. This is a hands-on lead role: you'll build the models and write the code yourself while setting direction for the discipline. You'll have real autonomy. You own the data science approach on Lab projects, help shape the opportunity backlog with the Chief Product Officer and the industry experts, and make the call, backed by evidence, when an idea should stop. We value candor over polish: a fast, well-reasoned "this won't work" is a good outcome. Our data spans several product platforms, and part of the job is spotting the data gaps that limit what we can ship and helping close them.
 
 
 
 
 What we've already shipped with Pak AI
 
 
 AI-powered lease provision analysis (PakEnergy Land). Embedded AI that flags key lease provisions in seconds instead of hours, so land teams can manage large portfolios and acquisitions faster.
 PakCAPTURETM (PakEnergy Transportation). Drivers photograph tickets, receipts and paperwork in the mobile app. Pak AI extracts the key data, auto-populates pickup and drop-off forms, and files the documents with the right load.
 OnPing PlungerTM (OnPing). Optimization for plunger-lift wells. Pak AI learns each well's best historical runs, compares actual against expected performance, and tunes setpoints within the operator's automation and safety limits, or flags the well for human review. It has delivered up to 30% more production on conservatively set wells and 3.5–7% on wells that were already well optimized.
 
 
 These are the first steps. The Innovation Lab is where the next ones get found, proven and shipped.
 
 
 
 
 The team
 
 
 The Innovation Lab brings together everyone it takes to go from a customer problem to a working product:
 Industry experts for every PakEnergy product: Land, Production, Accounting and Transportation. They know the workflows, the data and the customers firsthand.
 A Lead Applied AI Engineer, your peer, who designs and builds the Lab's generative AI, LLM and agentic systems and gets them into production.
 Solution engineers who take prototypes to customers and into production.
 You, the Lab's founding owner of data science and machine learning.
 For a strong data scientist, this means you won't get requirements secondhand, you won't build in a vacuum, and there's a clear path from your model to a customer. Domain experts frame problems with you, your peer lead in applied AI builds the generative AI side, and solution engineers put the results in customers' hands.
 
 
 
 Why this role
 
 
 Founding owner of your discipline. You'll set the technical direction, standards and practices for data science in the Lab from day one, and help shape what the Lab works on.
 Real operational energy data. You'll work with SCADA and IIoT time series from OnPing, lease and contract documents, revenue and joint-interest accounting, and the tickets and paperwork behind every load hauled, across a customer base of more than 2,300 companies.
 Deep expertise around you. You'll work next to industry experts for every product, a peer lead in applied AI and solution engineers, so you can focus on the data science while the team brings domain depth and a route to customers.
 Ownership from prototype to production. You own the data science from problem framing through modeling and evaluation, and see it through customer pilots into production.
 A direct line to leadership. You report to the Chief Product Officer, and your work shapes the Pak AI roadmap.
 A path to leading a team. There are no direct reports today. As Innovation Lab initiatives mature and demonstrate value, this role is set up to help build and lead the Lab's data science team.
 
 
 
 What you'll do
 
 
 Frame problems with the industry experts. Partner with the Lab's Land, Production, Accounting and Transportation experts to turn customer pain points into well-defined, measurable data science problems, and size the opportunity.
 Own the modeling. Build forecasting, anomaly detection, optimization and predictive models on production, SCADA/IIoT, accounting, transportation and geospatial data, from exploratory analysis through working prototype.
 Experiment and evaluate rigorously. Design experiments, offline evaluations and pilot success metrics. Own the evidence on whether something works, and recommend when an idea should stop.
 Partner with the Lead Applied AI Engineer on GenAI and agentic work. They design and build the Lab's LLM, document AI and agentic systems. You bring the data, lead evaluation design, and contribute ML and statistical models those systems can use.
 Take it to customers and production with solution engineers. Partner on customer pilots, and for the ML models you own, define the data, monitoring and MLOps requirements for a clean handoff to product and engineering teams.
 Stay accountable after deployment. Partner with engineering teams on production monitoring, model performance, drift detection and continuous improvement for the models you own after handoff.
 Set the technical direction for data science. Define the Lab's data science approach, tooling and standards for data quality, experimentation, reproducibility and responsible ML, and raise data fluency across a cross-functional team.
 Build the foundation for a future team. Document how data science works in the Lab, mentor and coach teammates, and shape the roles and hiring plan for when the Lab expands.
 
 
 
 
 What you bring
 
 
 8+ years in applied ML or data science, including multiple models you built and shipped to production, used by real customers.
 A track record of setting technical direction for data science work: choosing the approaches, tooling and standards that others adopted.
 Experience mentoring, coaching or leading other data scientists or engineers, formally or as a technical lead.
 Depth in at least one of time-series forecasting, anomaly detection or optimization on noisy, real-world data, with strong grounding in statistics, experimental design and model evaluation.
 Expert Python and SQL. You're still hands-on and build the models yourself.
 Working knowledge of LLM and GenAI systems, especially how to evaluate them (test-set design, metrics, human labeling, error analysis), enough to be a strong technical partner to the Lab's Lead Applied AI Engineer.
 Experience working within lightweight, fast-moving software development practices that prioritize rapid experimentation, testing, customer validation and responsible production delivery.
 A track record of turning ambiguous problems into shipped products with domain experts, product and engineering, influencing executives and stakeholders along the way, and the candor to say when something won't work.
 
 
 Nice to have
 
 
 Oil and gas, energy or industrial domain experience is a plus, not a requirement. The Lab's industry experts bring deep knowledge of every PakEnergy product, and you'll learn the domain working beside them.
 Experience with SCADA/IIoT or geospatial data, or with labeling and evaluating document-extraction systems.
 Databricks, Spark, Azure and/or AWS, and MLflow or similar MLOps tooling.
 Experience hiring data scientists or building a data science function from an early stage.
 Experience on cross-functional or innovation teams that take prototypes to customers.
 
 
 Education: A degree in a quantitative field or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome but not required.
 
 
 
 Location: In office, Frisco, Texas or Calgary, Alberta.
 
 
 FLSA Status: Exempt (US/Frisco location only).
 
 
 Canadian Employment Classification: Applicable employment classification will be determined in accordance with Alberta employment standards.
 
 
 
Benefits: A casual business work environment, generous PTO, employer-sponsored health benefits, and a retirement savings plan (401(k) in the US).
 
 
 
 Equal opportunity
 

 PakEnergy is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to an inclusive hiring process.
 
 
 
 

 If you're excited about this role but don't check every box, we'd still like to hear from you.

PENNYMAC

Pennymac is (NYSE: PFSI) is a specialty financial services firm with a comprehensive mortgage platform and integrated business focused on the production and servicing of U.S. mortgage loans and the management of investments related to the U.S. mortgage market. 

 

At Pennymac, our people are the foundation of our success and at the heart of our dynamic work culture. Together, we work towards a unified goal of helping millions of Americans achieve aspirations of homeownership through the complete mortgage journey.

 

 
A Typical Day

Pennymac is seeking a Senior Analyst, Quantitative Research to support the development, execution, and maintenance of our prepayment, interest rate, fixed income, and derivative pricing models. Sitting within the Capital Markets team, you will work closely with senior quantitative researchers and trading desks to implement financial engineering models, process capital markets data, and maintain numerical algorithms used for pipeline hedging and portfolio valuation.

This role is tailored for early-career professionals with an advanced degree in Financial Engineering, Computational Finance, Quantitative Finance, or Applied Mathematics who possess solid programming skills and a foundational understanding of capital markets and mortgage-backed securities (MBS).

 

The Senior Analyst, Quantitative Research will:

Model Implementation & Maintenance: Assist in coding, testing, and maintaining quantitative tools for prepayment models, interest rate models, yield curve calibration, and option pricing.Financial Data Engineering: Build pipelines to clean, structure, and analyze large capital markets datasets (e.g., yield curves, swaption volatility surfaces, benchmark Treasury rates).Derivatives & Valuation Support: Run daily valuation scripts and risk analytics (e.g., duration, convexity, key rate durations) for fixed income products, whole loans, and MSR portfolios.Capital Markets Analytics: Collaborate with trading and hedging desks to produce ad-hoc analytical reports, backtest trading strategies, and execute sensitivity analyses.Model Documentation: Write technical documentation and run validation tests to support model risk governance requirements. 
What You'll Bring

Education: Master's degree in Financial Engineering (MFE), Quantitative Finance, Applied Economics, Computational Finance, or Applied Mathematics/Statistics. (BS with 2-3 years experience is acceptable)Experience: 2+ years of professional experience in capital markets, quantitative research, or financial risk management (internship/co-op experience accepted).Programming Skills: Strong proficiency in Python, C++, or R for financial modeling and numerical computations. Solid experience with SQL for database querying.Firm understanding of core quantitative concepts: Fixed income mathematics (yields, duration, convexity). Fundamentals of derivatives and option pricing models (e.g., Black-Scholes, binomial trees). Basic principles of interest rate dynamics and mortgage cash flow structures.Analytical Skills: Excellent problem-solving capabilities with high attention to detail when working with complex financial datasets. 

 
Why You Should Join

As one of the top mortgage lenders in the country, Pennymac has helped over 4 million lifetime homeowners achieve and sustain their aspirations of home. Our vision is to be the most trusted partner for home. Together, 4,000 Pennymac team members across the country are guided by our core values: to be Accountable, Reliable and Ethical in all that we do. 

Pennymac is committed to conducting a business that makes positive contributions and promotes long-term sustainable growth and to fostering an equitable and inclusive environment, where all employees and customers feel valued, respected and supported. 

 

Benefits That Bring It Home: Whether you're looking for flexible benefits for today, setting up short-term goals for tomorrow, or planning for long-term success and retirement, Pennymac's benefits have you covered. Some key benefits include: 

Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and VisionPaid Time Off Programs including vacation, holidays, illness, and parental leave Wellness Programs, Employee Recognition Programs, and onsite gyms and cafe style dining (select locations)Retirement benefits, life insurance, 401k match, and tuition reimbursement Philanthropy Programs including matching gifts, volunteer grants, charitable grants and corporate sponsorshipsWe value the hard work and dedication of our employees. In addition to a competitive salary, positions may offer bonus opportunities.



To learn more about our benefits visit: 

https://pennymacnews.page.link/benefits

 

For residents with state required benefit information, additional information can be found at: https://www.pennymac.com/additional-benefits-information

Peraton is seeking a Junior Data Engineer with ETL development and geospatial data experience to support the data engineering workstream on a federal data migration program. You will develop and deploy ETL pipelines, execute data ingestion workflows, and support spatial data validation activities within a cloud data Lakehouse environment. This is a fully remote position.


 


The Department of the Interior (DOI), U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service (FWS), and NOAA's National Marine Fisheries Service (NMFS) have identified a critical gap in the federal government's ability to conduct comprehensive Endangered Species Act (ESA) research. While FWS operates an authoritative web-based platform for managing data for terrestrial and freshwater species, it does not currently include NMFS marine and anadromous species data forcing agencies to rely on separate, manual processes. This program closes that gap by integrating marine and anadromous species data into the existing FWS platform, creating a single, unified experience for all ESA-listed species.


 


Work Location: Remote

 Develop, test, and deploy ETL pipelines using Databricks Delta Live Tables within a cloud data lakehouse staging environment.
 Execute range data aggregation and normalization activities, collecting data from multiple authoritative source systems and normalizing spatial formats and coordinate reference systems.
 Implement source-to-target transformation logic within ETL pipelines, applying field-level mapping rules, data type conversions, and null-handling logic
 Execute prototype data ingestion workflows using representative taxa, evaluating results against completeness, accuracy, consistency, and spatial integrity quality criteria.
 Document prototype ingestion results, defects, and remediation actions
 Produce the Prototype Ingest Results Report, documenting ingestion outcomes, data quality findings, defect severity classifications, and remediation actions for each representative taxa batch.
 Log all data quality defects with severity classifications and remediation tracking
 Maintain all ETL pipeline code in a version-controlled repository with mandatory peer review documentation.
 Support spatial data validation activities in coordination with GIS Engineers.
 Support interoperability testing by providing test datasets, pipeline execution support, and data validation assistance.

 Proficiency in SQL for querying, validating, and transforming data within the cloud data lakehouse environment
 Familiarity with geospatial data formats and coordinate reference systems

Phasecraft is the quantum algorithms company. We are building the mathematical foundations for quantum computing applications that solve real-world problems. Founded in 2019 by Toby Cubitt, Ashley Montanaro and John Morton, we are based in London and Bristol in the UK and opened an office in Washington DC in 2024, led by Steve Flammia. In 2025 we completed a $34m Series B funding round co-led by Plural, existing investor Playground Global, and Novo Holdings' Quantum Fund in its first direct quantum software investment.

Phasecraft's unprecedented access to today's best quantum computers – through partnerships with Google, IBM, Quantinuum and QuEra – provides us with unique opportunities to develop foundational IP, inform the development of next-generation quantum hardware, and accelerate commercialization of high-value breakthroughs.

One of the key applications of Phasecraft's quantum algorithms is to modelling materials and molecular systems, where we have demonstrated significant reductions in cost compared with the state-of-the-art.

On the back of these breakthroughs, we are now looking to hire a Senior Quantum Computational Materials Scientist to join our team in Washington DC. In this newly created role, you will play a key role in guiding and coordinating the materials team's research efforts in the US, working closely with the Head of the US office and the materials team lead at Phasecraft. 

The ideal candidate will have extensive experience of research in the theory and application of computational techniques to materials or chemistry simulation, with an interest in applying algorithms for quantum computers to computational materials science. Their work will contribute to Phasecraft's goal of developing quantum algorithms for near-term quantum computers, and may encompass topics such as algorithm design, optimization and implementation, resource analysis, classical and quantum simulation benchmarking. They will have the opportunity to direct and grow a portfolio of research activity across the breadth of Phasecraft's interests.

Commutable distance to Stamford, CT.

Pivotal is the leader in the emerging market of electric Vertical Takeoff and Landing (eVTOL) aircraft. We design, develop, and manufacture light eVTOL aircraft and are renowned for the BlackFly aircraft the world's first light eVTOL to fly manned missions and enter the consumer market. 

Efficient, compact, and simple, Pivotal aircraft are designed for a wide range of consumer, public service, and defense applications. Our distinctive tilt-aircraft architecture and scalable platform have been flying for over 10 years. Last year we announced our next-generation aircraft, the Helix, which is rapidly progressing toward general release and scalable production in 2026. 

Mobility is one of the most highly-valued areas of modern technology investments. This is the right company, in the right space, the right strategy, at the right time. If you are ready for adventure, we invite you to join our amazing team and grow with us.

The Autonomy team at Pivotal develops advanced autonomy capabilities for our aircraft, enabling safe, precise, and reliable mission execution from takeoff to landing. We are seeking a Computer Vision Engineer to support the development of next-generation perception systems for our autonomous aerial platforms, including the Helix family of systems. 

In this role, you will collaborate with autonomy, guidance, navigation and control (GNC), flight software, and AI engineers to design, implement, and deploy computer vision algorithms that operate effectively in dynamic, real-world environments. You will work across object detection, tracking, visual localization, scene understanding, sensor fusion, and perception-driven autonomy to enable robust autonomous operations in challenging mission scenarios. 

The ideal candidate combines strong computer vision fundamentals with practical experience deploying perception systems on robotic or autonomous platforms. You will play a key role in developing vision capabilities that support navigation, obstacle avoidance, target tracking, and mission autonomy while contributing to the broader autonomy stack deployed on operational aircraft. 

Responsibilities



Perception & Computer Vision: Design and develop perception systems for autonomous aerial platforms operating in GPS-denied and contested environments; implement object detection, classification, segmentation, and tracking algorithms using RGB, thermal, and multimodal sensor data; develop visual perception pipelines for obstacle detection, collision avoidance, and situational awareness; build scene understanding capabilities to support autonomous navigation and mission execution; evaluate and integrate state-of-the-art computer vision and AI techniques into operational systems. Visual Navigation & Localization: Develop visual-inertial odometry, localization, and mapping algorithms; implement vision-based navigation solutions for degraded and GPS-denied environments; support SLAM and feature-based localization systems; design robust estimation methods that fuse camera, IMU, GPS, lidar, and radar data; improve navigation performance through sensor fusion and environmental awareness.Machine Learning & AI: Develop, train, and deploy deep learning models for onboard perception; create data processing, labeling, augmentation, and evaluation pipelines; optimize neural networks for real-time inference on embedded computing platforms; analyze model performance and improve robustness across operational conditions; support deployment of perception models on edge AI hardware.Camera Systems & Sensor Integration: Integrate and evaluate diverse imaging systems including RGB, stereo, fisheye, thermal, and event-based cameras; develop camera calibration workflows and sensor characterization procedures; support multi-camera synchronization and calibration efforts; improve image quality, calibration accuracy, and perception system reliability; collaborate with hardware teams to evaluate and integrate emerging sensor technologies.Testing & Validation: Develop simulation and testing frameworks for perception algorithms; support software-in-the-loop, hardware-in-the-loop, and flight testing activities; analyze flight data to identify performance gaps and improve perception robustness; establish metrics and validation procedures for autonomous perception systems; document system performance and support field deployments.
Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Electrical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related technical field.
Experience: 2-4 years of industry experience in computer vision, robotics, machine learning, or autonomous systems OR Master's degree with 1-2 years of industry experience.
Strong proficiency in C++, Python, or Rust.
Experience with OpenCV and modern computer vision frameworks.
Experience developing perception systems using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar machine learning frameworks.
Strong understanding of image processing, geometric vision, and camera systems.
Experience with object detection, tracking, segmentation, and machine learning-based perception algorithms.
Familiarity with sensor fusion and state estimation techniques.
Experience with ROS/ROS2 or similar robotics middleware.
Experience developing software in Linux environments.
Preferred Qualifications

Master's or PhD in Computer Vision, Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a related field. Experience with autonomous aircraft, UAVs, robotics, or aerospace systemsExperience with visual SLAM, visual-inertial odometry, or localization systems. Knowledge of camera calibration, multi-camera systems, and geometric computer vision. Experience integrating lidar, radar, thermal cameras, and inertial sensors into perception systems. Experience deploying AI models on embedded platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson or similar edge computing hardware. Familiarity with simulation environments such as Gazebo, Isaac Sim, AirSim, or equivalent. Experience optimizing perception systems for real-time performance and resource-constrained platforms. Contributions to open-source robotics, autonomy, or computer vision projects.Familiarity with defense industry standards and security clearance processes.

Plaid's network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

Fraud Data is the data science and machine learning team within Plaid's Fraud organization, responsible for using data and ML to improve and scale Plaid's fraud products. Within Fraud Data, the Customer & Product Intelligence team focuses on understanding product performance, uncovering customer insights, and enabling go-to-market teams with data-driven solutions. The team partners closely with customers and GTM teams on fraud analyses and proofs of concept, turning customer learnings into scalable, reusable product capabilities. We also build the metrics, analytics, and data foundations that measure product health, identify opportunities for improvement, and guide product decisions across Plaid's Fraud portfolio.

As a Data Science Manager, you will lead a team responsible for customer-facing data science and Fraud product analytics. You will set the team's roadmap, develop its data scientists, and remain involved in analytical methods, technical reviews, and customer investigations. You will:

Set a 6–12-month roadmap with Product, Engineering, and GTM, and assign priorities and responsibilities across the team.

Define product metrics, their underlying data, and reporting and alerting practices; use the results in roadmap and investment decisions.

Establish a repeatable process for customer retrospectives and proofs of concept, including data checks, evaluation methods, and clear recommendations.

Identify fraud signals and product opportunities that recur across customer analyses and work with Product and MLEs to develop them.

Lead investigations into complex fraud cases across identities, accounts, devices, and transaction surfaces

Distill patterns from noisy signals into clear narratives and actionable insights

Bridge investigation outcomes to product and model improvements

Experiment with network/graph analysis, sequence mining, anomaly detection, and custom heuristics where off-the-shelf approaches fail

Drive post-incident learning by capturing lessons from fraud incidents and feeding them back into defenses
