description:
About Point One Navigation




Point One Navigation is on a mission to bridge the digital and physical worlds through precision location, with an API-first, developer-focused approach. Our RTK corrections network and FusionEngineTM software deliver centimeter-level accuracy and high-confidence positioning for vehicles, robots, drones, and devices across industries in outdoor applications. We are actively broadening our expertise into indoor environments to provide the same high-standard localization and navigational quality for users everywhere.



Role Outcome




Staff Computer Vision Engineers are responsible for the comprehensive lifecycle of Point One's spatial AI and visual navigation features, overseeing everything from initial camera integration and image processing to high-level architectural and algorithmic design.




This is an ownership-first role: you will conceptualize and drive complex technical challenges end-to-end - from early architecture through deployment in mission-critical systems - while raising the technical bar across the team.




FusionEngine already powers a wide range of devices, hardware platforms, and customer applications. The R&D team is responsible for making sure our vision and perception systems work reliably across all of them: Designing solutions robust to visually challenging environments, optimizing models for compute-constrained edge devices, and ensuring our algorithms stay thoroughly tested, verified, and production-ready as we scale.



Success in this role means:



 State-of-the-art CV and SLAM techniques are successfully translated from research papers, internal prototypes, or third-party solutions into highly performant, production-grade algorithms.
 Rigorous benchmarking pipelines are established to objectively evaluate internal algorithms against commercial OTS solutions and vendor offerings.
 Vision pipelines automatically generate and maintain accurate, semantically rich maps of complex indoor environments with minimal manual intervention.
 Real-time localization and multi-agent tracking (assets, robots, people) are highly robust, minimizing latency and identity switches even in dynamic or visually degraded conditions.
 Spatial data, coordinate frames, and map layers are exposed via clean data models and APIs, empowering our UI and infrastructure teams to build seamless user-facing applications.
 Junior engineers grow faster and the team's practices improve measurably over time.
Immediate Areas of Focus



Applied Research, Benchmarking & Selection



 Lead the research, evaluation, and selection of state-of-the-art computer vision, deep learning, and spatial navigation methodologies for highly accurate 3D maps of large-scale facilities, considering both internal development and third-party commercial solutions.
 Develop or integrate deep learning and classical CV algorithms to extract semantic information from environments (e.g., structural elements, zones, and specific objects) for overlay onto base map.
 Ensure maps can be dynamically updated over time as the physical layout of a facility changes, enabling map version management and consistency.
 Design and own a rigorous benchmarking framework to continuously evaluate the accuracy, latency, compute footprint, and reliability of internal code versus off-the-shelf and vendor technologies.
 Rapidly prototype new perception capabilities and architect their transition into highly optimized, edge-capable production code, or seamlessly encapsulate and integrate verified third-party modules.
 Collaborate tightly with infrastructure and UI engineers to manage data products, render maps, and track assets for the end user.


Drive Real-Time Localization and Tracking



 Understand how and work with the larger navigation team to use camera data with GNSS, IMU, wheel odometry, and other indoor positioning signals to maintain high-confidence state estimation for moving agents in all environments.
 Drive performance tuning for edge deployment to ensure tracking algorithms run with low latency and high reliability on constrained compute architectures.
 Proactively identify failure modes in tracking and mapping and design robust algorithmic fallbacks.


Raise the Technical Bar



 Mentor junior engineers and establish best practices across the team.
 Contribute to architecture discussions, technical strategy, and roadmap planning.
Qualifications



 7+ years of professional algorithm and software development experience, with significant depth in applied research, computer vision, or robotics.
 Expertise in modern C++ (C++14 or later) and Python, with a demonstrated history of success of taking AI model prototypes (PyTorch, TensorFlow) and turning them into scalable, real-time production systems.
 Expertise in ROS1/ROS2.
 Hands-on experience with Visual SLAM, 3D reconstruction, and mapping architectures.
 Experience in deploying semantic segmentation/object detection in real-world environments.
 Experience with multi-view geometry, camera calibration, and fusing vision with other sensor modalities (IMU, GNSS).
 Ability to take high-level research and business goals and decompose them into actionable engineering tasks, realistic schedules, and clear milestones.
 MS or PhD in Computer Science, Robotics, or equivalent experience.


Bonus Points For



 Background in deploying optimized vision models to edge devices using TensorRT, ONNX, or platform-specific accelerators.
 Experience in deploying multi-object tracking and ReID architectures in real-world, dynamic environments.
 Familiarity with managing large-scale point clouds, mesh generation, or NeRFs/Gaussian Splatting for environmental representation.
Our Cultural Foundation




At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position.




This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow - both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them.




That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today's outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows.




We think about our culture in two dimensions:



How We Show Up Every Day




These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work - the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate:



 Trust / Assume Best Intent - Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting.
 High Output, Action Oriented - Our default posture is "yes." We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us.
 Divine Discontent - We're never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles.
 No Ego, One Team - Collaboration without ego creates leverage. When we win as one team, we eliminate friction and move faster together.
 Self Accountability - Taking ownership is the straightest line to learning, self-improvement, and correcting our course of action. And blaming others around us is a fast path to destroying trust.
Operating Principles




These are the systems and norms that amplify speed and efficiency at the company level:



 Edge Innovation - We bias toward action over approval. Experiment, decide, and move - failure is just a step toward faster learning.
 No Hierarchies - We practice self-prioritization and go direct to the source. Flattening layers reduces drag and maximizes autonomy.
 Customer Experience First - We optimize for the end-to-end customer outcome, not functional or departmental efficiency. This focus cuts waste, aligns priorities, and ensures we spend effort where it matters most.

description:
## Senior Full Stack AI Engineer (Natural Language Systems)

Prompt is a mission-driven startup transforming healthcare through innovative B2B enterprise software for rehab therapy businesses. We're looking for an experienced Senior AI Engineer to lead our ambitious AI initiatives, with particular emphasis on speech and language processing. You'll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of real-world AI applications in healthcare—building systems that are used every day by clinics, staff, and patients.

We've established ourselves as the go-to platform in the rehab therapy space and are rapidly growing our market share by delivering software people love. As we scale our telephony AI and speech processing initiatives—including our AI scribe and other real-time language workflows—we need an innovative engineer who loves solving high-impact problems. This role combines deep technical expertise in AI with strong software engineering fundamentals to build reliable, production-grade systems that apply the latest generative AI and ML methods to real-world workflows where speed, accuracy, and results matter.

### What You'll Do

You'll drive Prompt's mission to improve healthcare through modern technology and lead AI projects from ideation through architecture to production and iteration until features are widely adopted and loved. This means developing and deploying real-time AI systems involving speech and natural language understanding—think transcription, summarization, and classification at scale. You'll build robust model and prompt pipelines for LLM-powered workflows with high accuracy and monitoring standards that matter.

Partnering closely with Product and Engineering, you'll identify high-leverage AI opportunities and deliver measurable outcomes. You'll help develop Prompt's strategic AI roadmap across speech, NLP, and core automation workflows, applying AI to improve client and internal operations including clinical documentation, customer support, and billing workflows. A critical part of this role involves developing a deep understanding of Prompt's product, customers, and the business of rehab therapy itself.

Beyond individual contributions, you'll help grow and lead the AI team, including training and development of junior team members.

### What We're Looking For

You need at least 4+ years of experience building AI/ML systems in industry or academia with meaningful production ownership. Strong experience building and evaluating NLP and/or LLM systems is essential—this includes retrieval, summarization, classification, extraction, and agent workflows. You must have real experience working with speech-related pipelines in production or near-real-time settings, such as speech-to-text, spoken intent classification, or conversational AI.

A track record of benchmarking and iteratively improving accuracy, cost, and latency is important. You should have an enthusiastic and pragmatic problem-solving mindset, along with excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

Technically, you'll need Python (>3.9), Docker basics, and AWS familiarity (S3, RDS, EC2) is preferred. You should be willing to learn and deeply understand the healthcare sector, specifically physical therapy, occupational therapy, and speech therapy.

This is a heavy code contribution role—please only apply if you're interested in that; this is not an engineering management position, though growth opportunities exist over time.

### Nice-to

- Have Experience

If you have experience building and optimizing real-time speech processing systems (latency, streaming, stability), working with modern STT engines and their evaluation, or modern TTS engines and voice pipeline integration, that's valuable. Experience designing, developing, and optimizing IVR applications or working with CPaa. S platforms like Twilio for telephony workflows and conversational routing is a plus. We'd also appreciate experience architecting ML/LLM evaluation pipelines and quality systems (offline + online evaluation, golden sets, regression testing), or work with recommendation systems, automation systems, or large-scale workflow orchestration.

Familiarity with Fast. API, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy, and Postgre. SQL is helpful, as is experience with CI/CD pipelines and production observability tooling. Any background building healthcare software and/or data processing pipelines is a bonus.

### What We Offer

We provide competitive salaries and potential equity compensation for outstanding performance. You'll work in a remote/hybrid environment with flexible PTO. Benefits include company-paid disability and life insurance, family and medical leave, medical, dental, and vision insurance, discounted pet insurance, FSA/DCA and commuter benefits, and 401k. We offer complimentary subscriptions to digital fitness classes and wellness content, plus access to our recovery suite at HQ with a cold plunge, sauna, and shower. Company-wide sponsored lunches are also part of the package.

Firm Overview



Providence Equity Partners L.L.C. is a leading middle-market private equity firm with deep sector expertise in media, communications and education focused on North America and Europe. Providence looks to invest in businesses that are benefiting from the long-term growth trends around experiences, learning, and connectivity by partnering with exceptional management teams to build enduring, scaled companies. Founded in 1989 in Providence, Rhode Island, the firm has invested over $40 billion across more than 180 portfolio companies with a transatlantic investment team based primarily in London, New York and Boston. Through disciplined portfolio construction, prudent risk management and a collaborative culture, the firm seeks to deliver strong results across market cycles. To learn more, please visit www.provequity.com.





Position Overview
The AI Solutions Architect is responsible for applying AI technologies to solve high-value business problems across PEP and its portfolio companies. This role will join the Firm's Portfolio Operations team and partners with IT, Investment, Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand business needs, identify where AI can meaningfully improve outcomes, and translate those opportunities into practical, secure, and scalable solutions.



The AI Solutions Architect will lead the evaluation, configuration, integration, and implementation of AI-enabled solutions using commercially available AI models, platforms, and enterprise technologies. The role will guide initiatives from opportunity identification and solution design through implementation, adoption, measurement, and continuous improvement. Success in this role requires strong technical fluency, business judgment, and the ability to translate business needs into practical solutions while ensuring appropriate security, privacy, governance, and responsible AI controls.



Responsibilities 
The AI Solutions Architect will be responsible for the following:

Partner with IT, Investment, Finance, Operations, and other business teams to understand business processes, identify high-value opportunities for AI, and prioritize initiatives based on business value, feasibility, risk, and scalability.

Translate business needs into practical AI-enabled solutions by evaluating available technologies and determining how existing AI tools, platforms, and enterprise capabilities can be applied to improve productivity, decision-making, operational effectiveness, or financial outcomes.

Design solution approaches that leverage existing AI capabilities, including generative AI platforms, intelligent agents, enterprise search, workflow automation, and other commercially available technologies.

Leverage current, commercially available AI solutions within existing business processes and enterprise systems, including Microsoft 365, SharePoint, Slack, Workday, DealCloud, and other firm and portfolio company platforms to solve prioritized business cases. Where an existing solution is not the best fit, recommend alternative AI approaches.

Evaluate AI models, platforms, applications, and third-party solutions and make recommendations based on business requirements, functionality, ease of implementation, integration needs, cost, security, scalability, and operational risk.

Determine the appropriate solution approach, including when to leverage an existing enterprise capability, configure a commercial AI product, integrate multiple technologies, or use a non-AI solution when it better addresses the business need.

Lead AI initiatives from business problem definition through implementation and adoption, coordinating solution design, configuration, integration, testing, stakeholder engagement, rollout, monitoring, and ongoing enhancement.

Establish reusable solution patterns, implementation approaches, and playbooks that enable successful AI use cases to be replicated and scaled across business functions and portfolio companies.

Partner with Technology and Legal teams to incorporate security, privacy, governance, regulatory, and responsible AI requirements into the selection, configuration, integration, and use of AI solutions.

Define and monitor measures of solution effectiveness and business impact, including adoption, productivity improvement, financial value, and return on investment, and use results to guide enhancements and future priorities.



In addition to the outlined responsibilities, you will be expected to handle ad hoc requests as they arise. This job description is not exhaustive and may not encompass all aspects of the role, as the needs of the business are continually evolving. Flexibility and adaptability are essential for success in this dynamic position.





Qualifications
The successful candidate will have a demonstrated record of success, a positive professional reputation, and the ability to exercise sound judgment and accountability. In addition, the successful candidate should have:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Data Science, Business Technology, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

8+ years of relevant professional experience in technology solutions, enterprise applications, digital transformation, technology consulting, systems integration, software solutions, product management. engineering management or a related field, with recent professional experience focused on applying AI technologies to business problems and implementing AI-enabled solutions.

Demonstrated experience translating business requirements into technology solutions and leading initiatives from problem definition and solution evaluation through implementation, adoption, and ongoing improvement.

Experience partnering directly with business stakeholders to understand workflows, identify opportunities for improvement, evaluate technology options, and implement solutions that deliver measurable business value.

Strong practical knowledge of generative AI technologies, commercially available AI platforms, and enterprise AI capabilities, including an understanding of their appropriate uses, limitations, and risks.

Experience applying capabilities such as generative AI, intelligent agents, enterprise search, retrieval-augmented generation, workflow automation, and AI-enabled productivity tools to business processes and use cases.

Experience configuring and integrating technology solutions with enterprise applications, APIs, business systems, structured and unstructured data sources, and workflow platforms.

Strong understanding of enterprise technology environments and the ability to assess how AI solutions can be incorporated into existing systems and business processes.

Demonstrated ability to evaluate third-party technologies and make recommendations regarding buy, configure, integrate, or alternative solution approaches based on business value, technical fit, scalability, cost, security, and risk.

Working knowledge of data security, privacy, access controls, AI governance, and responsible AI principles, with the ability to incorporate these considerations into technology selection and implementation.

Strong analytical and business problem-solving skills, including the ability to determine whether AI is an appropriate solution and identify simpler technology or process alternatives when appropriate.

Ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives, establish priorities, influence technical and non-technical stakeholders, and communicate AI capabilities, limitations, risks, and trade-offs clearly.

Sufficient technical fluency to work effectively with Technology teams, vendors, and solution providers and to understand integration requirements, APIs, data flows, system dependencies, and implementation considerations.



Requirements
We are committed to creating a workplace that fosters a collegial, inclusive, and collaborative environment As part of the Providence team, it's important that we hire candidates that align and exhibit our values:

Demonstrated ability to work effectively across teams, actively contribute ideas, and build strong, trustbased relationships to achieve shared goals and drive collective success.

Proven track record of taking accountability for outcomes, following through on commitments, and acting with honesty, transparency, and ethical judgment in all situations.

Commitment to fostering a positive, engaging workplace culture by supporting colleagues, contributing to a sense of belonging, and modeling behaviors that reflect and strengthen our organizational values.

Ability to work respectfully with individuals of diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, demonstrating empathy, fairness, and a commitment to inclusive practices in everyday interactions and decisionmaking.



This role may periodically require work outside standard business hours to meet business needs and deadlines. Performance is measured by results, quality of work, and timely delivery; employees are expected to use sound judgment regarding after-hours support and communicate proactively when unavailable.



This position is primarily performed in a professional office environment and involves prolonged computer use, regular communication by phone/video/email, attendance at meetings, and use of standard office equipment. Occasional business travel may be required based on business needs.

Company Description



See how Epsilon powers connected marketing by unlocking the full potential of data and identity.

 
Overview

For this role, we are seeking a qualified Senior Software Engineer to join Epsilon's Development Team in our Data Practice. In this role with our company, you will be focused on project tasks for Epsilon's TotalSource Plus (TSP) demographic and lifestyle products.

 

As a member of the Epsilon Data Team, you will work in a group that is not only focused on their project work but also their efficiency, compliance, standards, situational awareness, and readiness. You'll be a critical part of a fast-moving, innovative team where you'll work independently in some situations as well as working with a greater team in tasks that require full collaboration.

 

 
Responsibilities

What you'll do:

• Design, develop, and maintain scalable data processing solutions across on-premises and cloud environments using Python and Apache Spark on Databricks.
• Optimize and fine-tune Spark jobs for performance, including resource utilization, shuffling, partitioning, and caching, to ensure maximum efficiency in large-scale big data environments.
• Design and implement scalable, fault-tolerant data pipelines with end-to-end monitoring, alerting, and logging.
• Leverage AWS cloud services (2+ years preferred) to build and manage data pipelines and distributed processing workloads.
• Develop and optimize SQL queries across relational and data warehouse systems (RDBMS/Data Warehouse).
• Apply design patterns and best practices for efficient data modeling, partitioning, and distributed system performance.
• Use Git (or equivalent) for source control and maintain strong unit and integration testing practices.
• Collaborate with Product Owners, partners, and cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
• Demonstrate strong analytical skills with the ability to extract actionable insights from large datasets and support data-driven decision-making.
• Mentor junior engineers, conduct code reviews, and contribute to establishing engineering best practices and standards.

 
Qualifications

About you:
• 5+ years of software development experience in a scalable, distributed, or multi-node environment.
• Proficient in programming with Scala, Python, or Java; comfortable building data-driven solutions at scale, with Databricks preferred.
• Significant experience with Apache Spark and exposure to Hadoop, Hive, and related big data technologies.
• Demonstrated experience with cloud platforms (AWS, preferred) and an interest in cloud migration projects.

• Exposure to modern data tools and frameworks such as Kubernetes, Docker, and MWAA/Airflow.
• Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to own problems end-to-end and deliver results.
• Consultative mindset — comfortable taking initiative, building relationships, communicating broadly, and tackling challenges head-on.
• Collaborative team player with an eagerness to learn from peers and mentors while contributing to a culture of growth.
• Motivated to grow your career within a dynamic, innovative company.

 

What you'll bring:

• BA/BS in Computer Science or related discipline.
• At least 5 years of experience as a big data software developer. 
• Experience in Machine Learning, including model development, feature engineering, or integrating ML workflows into data pipelines.
• Experience with Databricks, including Notebooks, Delta Lake, Jobs, Pipelines, and Unity Catalog, preferred.
• AWS, Databricks, or Spark certification a plus.

 
Additional Information

When you join Epsilon, we'll create something EPIC together. We're a global leader in data and identity, with deep expertise in digital media, clean rooms, customer data platforms, loyalty and marketing services. Positioned at the center of Publicis Groupe, Epsilon helps brands deliver personalized experiences at scale and build lasting customer relationships by unlocking the full potential of data and identity. Epsilon operates in 30+ countries across EMEA, the Americas and APAC, with more than 8,000 employees.

 

Check out a few of these resources to learn more about what makes Epsilon so EPIC:

 

Our Culture: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/our-culture-epsilon

Life at Epsilon: https://www.epsilon.com/us/about-us/epic-blog

 

Epsilon has five values that define our culture and guide us as we create value for our clients, our people and consumers. We seek candidates who align with our company values, demonstrate them and make them meaningful in their day-to-day work:

Act with integrity. We are transparent and have the courage to do the right thing.Work together to win together. We believe collaboration is the catalyst that unlocks our full potential.Innovate with purpose. We shape the market with big ideas that drive big outcomes.Respect all voices. We embrace differences and foster a culture of connection and belonging.Empower with accountability. We trust each other to own and deliver on common goals. 

Because You Matter

As an Epsilon employee, you deserve perks and benefits that put you, your family and your finances first. Our benefits encompass a wide range of offerings, including but not limited to:

Time to recharge: Flexible time off (FTO), 14 paid holidays, paid sick timeFamily well-being: Parental/new child leave, childcare & elder care assistance, adoption assistanceExtra perks: Comprehensive health coverage, 401(k), tuition assistance, commuter benefits, professional development, employee recognition, charitable donation matching, health coaching and counselingEpsilon benefits are subject to eligibility requirements and other terms.

Epsilon also prohibits harassment of applicants and employees based on any of these protected categories. Epsilon will provide accommodations to applicants who need accommodations to complete the application process. Please reach out to LeaveofAbsence@epsilon.com to request an accommodation.

description:
QQR LABS


 Principal Engineer, Computer Vision & Edge AI


 Fort Worth, TX / Cincinnati, OH / Austin, TX (full relocation covered) or Remote, US | Full-time


 $220,000 to $280,000 base + 20 to 25% milestone bonus


 Freight fraud and cargo theft drain tens of billions of dollars a year from the US supply chain, and the industry still verifies trucks with paperwork. QQR Labs is building its first product where machine vision meets physical freight. The full scope and excitement of what we are building will be shared during the interview process.


 QQR Labs is the technology arm of QQR Freight, a platform whose sister companies include an asset-based motor carrier and a nationwide 3PL brokerage. We are not a pitch deck. There are trucks, lanes, revenue, and customers behind this, which means a real-world proving ground and a built-in first customer from day one.


 We are hiring the first engineer on the product, and you will own it end to end: the hardware in the field, the models on the edge, and the platform customers log into.


 What you will build


 
 Ruggedized capture hardware: industrial cameras, IR illumination, Jetson-class GPU compute, cellular backhaul, weatherproof enclosures built for unattended outdoor duty
 On-device ML: detection, classification, and OCR on vehicles at highway speed, day and night
 The data platform: high-volume ingestion, entity resolution, search, alerting, APIs
 The data engine: auto-labeling pipelines, continuous retraining, and evaluation loops fed by real-world captures
 Fleet tooling: provisioning, over-the-air updates, and health monitoring for hardware deployed far from a desk
 
 
 Requirements
 

 Who we want


 
 You have shipped computer vision on real hardware in the real world, not just in a notebook. Detection, tracking, OCR, deployed where weather, vibration, and glare live.
 A camera-first mindset: multi-camera perception, vision-only stacks, and models that hold up in rain, glare, and darkness
 Edge and embedded fluency: Linux on ARM, camera pipelines (GStreamer or similar), model optimization (TensorRT, ONNX, quantization)
 Cloud and data competence: Python, AWS or GCP, streaming ingestion, practical MLOps
 You make hardware decisions, work without a playbook, and own outcomes
 If you have built vision systems that live outdoors or on vehicles at scale, you already know this class of problem. Come build one where you hold real skin in the game.
 
 
 Benefits
 

 The package


 
 $220,000 to $280,000 base, plus a 20 to 25% annual bonus tied to build milestones (first unit live in the field, accuracy targets, deployment count)
 Long-term upside beyond salary, covered in the interview process. We want an owner, not an employee.
 Full relocation to Fort Worth, Cincinnati, or Austin, or remote (US) with regular time at HQ and in the field
 Visa sponsorship available, including H-1B transfers
 A funded hardware lab and field deployment budget from day one
 You interview with, and report to, the CEO

Description: 
 
 Quantum Sky is searching for a detail-oriented, collaborative Business Intelligence Analyst (FM/EDW Business Analyst) to support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) E-Commerce Operational Systems Support (EOSS) contract in Aurora, Colorado.
 
 
 
 

 In this role, you will serve as the functional linchpin between operational stakeholders and technical engineering teams across the enterprise. You will analyze, document, and manage business and system requirements bridging the DHA Financial Management suite—centered on Oracle Federal Financials (OFF R12)—and the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) business intelligence data marts.
 
 
 
 

 Your day-to-day focus will center on capturing business needs from DHA Contract Resource Management (CRM) financial managers, translating federal statutory mandates into system requirements, conducting rigorous cross-system gap analyses, maintaining end-to-end traceability, and supporting user acceptance testing across reporting repositories such as the Financial Reporting Data Mart (FRDM / Contractor Resource Center), Operations Reporting Data Mart (ORDM), Pharmacy Reporting Data Mart (PRDM), and the Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME) reporting area.
 
 Responsibilities:
 1. Requirements Discovery & Comprehensive Gap Analysis
 
 Actively interface with DHA CRM financial managers, DHA Office of General Counsel (OGC), and operational users to identify business problems and elicit functional system needs.
 
 
 Conduct comprehensive cross-system gap analysis whenever changes occur (e.g., analyzing how upstream configuration or accounting rule adjustments in Oracle Federal Financials affect downstream EDW staging, archival layers, and data mart reports).
 
 
 
 Provide business analysis and requirements definitions for reporting reconciliations, data discrepancies, and workflow improvements.
 
 
 2. System Requirements Documentation & RTM Governance
 
 
 
 Author, maintain, and update formal System Requirements Specifications (SRSs) for DHA ECS applications and operational interfaces (CDRL 0010), coordinating reviews to secure formal Government Contracting Officer Representative (COR) digital signatures.
 
 
 
 Build and maintain a bi-directional Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) for each application release, establishing complete traceability from initial stakeholder requirements through design specifications, software version builds, and test cases.
 
 
 
 Attach approved requirements packages and RTMs to Change Requests within the Solutions Business Manager (SBM) and Quality Center (QC) repositories to facilitate review by the Configuration Working Group (CWG) and Configuration Management Board (CMB).
 
 
 3. Federal Mandates & Enterprise Initiative Analysis
 
 Provide dedicated business analysis, functional data modeling, and test coordination for key contract initiatives:
 
 
 
 
 Government Invoicing (G-Invoicing): Analyze Intragovernmental Transactions (IGT) Buy/Sell business rules, General Terms and Conditions (GT&C), orders, performance, and fund settlement integration with OFF.
 
 
 
 BEA SFIS, Data Act & SLOA Compliance: Perform annual business analysis of the DoD Business Enterprise Architecture (BEA) standard release; define system and reporting changes required to sustain Standard Financial Information Structure (SFIS), Data Act, and Standard Line of Accounting (SLOA) compliance across OFF and EDW.
 
 
 
 Central Accounting Reporting System (CARS): Define functional requirements for ingesting and processing the CARS Transactional Data Extract (CTDE) within OFF and EDW to automate daily cash and disbursement reconciliations for Agency Location Code 97000012.
 
 
 
 Line of Accounting (LOA) & Common Cost Accounting Structure (CCAS): Perform functional requirements discovery and document data dictionary additions across OFF and EDW to support cost accounting reporting.
 
 
 
 TRICARE Encounter Data System (TEDS) Interface: Analyze updates in TEDS healthcare and pharmacy claims records, mapping schema changes to OFF claims processing extensions and EDW reporting repositories.
 
 
 
 Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME): Support functional analysis, data ingestion validation, and specialized financial reporting for CAP/DME data submitted by Managed Care Support Contractors.
 
 
 
 CRM System Integration Test (CRMSIT): Collaborate directly with the CRM Financial Manager during biennial CRMSIT testing; identify specific test claim scenarios, define modified TED record values, and analyze payment calculation results.
 
 
 4. Testing, User Acceptance & Defect Management
 
 
 
 Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Test Engineers to translate functional business requirements into rigorous test scenarios and scripts within HP Quality Center (QC) / ALM.
 
 
 
 Support Government User Acceptance Testing (UAT): assist users during test execution, capture test artifacts/screenshots, validate business logic, and help classify test defects as major, moderate, or minor.
 
 
 
 Verify that software modifications fully satisfy documented business requirements prior to CMB approval and production deployment.
 
 
 5. Reporting Validation & User Enablement
 
 
 
 Validate ad hoc queries and standard reports generated via Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), BI Publisher, and SplashBI to ensure business logic accuracy and accounting integrity.
 
 
 
 Assist in developing application user training materials, user guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support financial and operational users across DHA commands and MTFs.
 
 
 
 Ensure all functional reporting outputs adhere to Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility criteria.
 
 Qualifications: 
 
 Required:
 
 
 
 
 Citizenship: Must be a U.S. Citizen (mandatory for DHA IT network access and security vetting).
 
 
 
 Formal Education: Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution in Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Engineering, or a related field.
 
 
 
 
 Experience Substitution Rule: In lieu of a bachelor's degree, fifteen (15) years of dedicated Business Analyst experience may be substituted).
 
 
 
 
 Years of Experience: Minimum of five (5) years of documented business analysis experience supporting large-scale enterprise IT systems of comparable size, scope, and complexity to the DHA EOSS contract.
 
 
 
 Core Competency: Proven experience writing formal System Requirements Specifications (SRS), business process flows, functional design specifications, and maintaining bi-directional Requirements Traceability Matrices (RTM)
 
 Cybersecurity Certification: Must possess or obtain a DoD 8140.03 / DoDD 8570.01-M IAT Level II certification within three (3) months of hire.
 
 
 Desired:
 
 
 
 
 Financial ERP Systems: Functional understanding of Oracle Federal Financials / Oracle E-Business Suite (EBS) R12 modules (General Ledger, Purchasing, Payables, Receivables), U.S. Standard General Ledger (USSGL), and federal accounting flows.

DescriptionQuantum Sky is searching for a detail-oriented, collaborative Business Intelligence Analyst (FM/EDW Business Analyst) to support the Defense Health Agency (DHA) E-Commerce Operational Systems Support (EOSS) contract in Aurora, Colorado.


In this role, you will serve as the functional linchpin between operational stakeholders and technical engineering teams across the enterprise. You will analyze, document, and manage business and system requirements bridging the DHA Financial Management suite—centered on Oracle Federal Financials (OFF R12)—and the Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) business intelligence data marts.


Your day-to-day focus will center on capturing business needs from DHA Contract Resource Management (CRM) financial managers, translating federal statutory mandates into system requirements, conducting rigorous cross-system gap analyses, maintaining end-to-end traceability, and supporting user acceptance testing across reporting repositories such as the Financial Reporting Data Mart (FRDM / Contractor Resource Center), Operations Reporting Data Mart (ORDM), Pharmacy Reporting Data Mart (PRDM), and the Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME) reporting area.

Conduct comprehensive cross-system gap analysis whenever changes occur (e.g., analyzing how upstream configuration or accounting rule adjustments in Oracle Federal Financials affect downstream EDW staging, archival layers, and data mart reports).

 Provide business analysis and requirements definitions for reporting reconciliations, data discrepancies, and workflow improvements.

2. System Requirements Documentation & RTM Governance Author, maintain, and update formal System Requirements Specifications (SRSs) for DHA ECS applications and operational interfaces (CDRL 0010), coordinating reviews to secure formal Government Contracting Officer Representative (COR) digital signatures.

 Build and maintain a bi-directional Requirements Traceability Matrix (RTM) for each application release, establishing complete traceability from initial stakeholder requirements through design specifications, software version builds, and test cases.

 Attach approved requirements packages and RTMs to Change Requests within the Solutions Business Manager (SBM) and Quality Center (QC) repositories to facilitate review by the Configuration Working Group (CWG) and Configuration Management Board (CMB).

3. Federal Mandates & Enterprise Initiative AnalysisProvide dedicated business analysis, functional data modeling, and test coordination for key contract initiatives:

 Government Invoicing (G-Invoicing): Analyze Intragovernmental Transactions (IGT) Buy/Sell business rules, General Terms and Conditions (GT&C), orders, performance, and fund settlement integration with OFF.

 TRICARE Encounter Data System (TEDS) Interface: Analyze updates in TEDS healthcare and pharmacy claims records, mapping schema changes to OFF claims processing extensions and EDW reporting repositories.

 Capital and Direct Medical Education (CAP/DME): Support functional analysis, data ingestion validation, and specialized financial reporting for CAP/DME data submitted by Managed Care Support Contractors.

 CRM System Integration Test (CRMSIT): Collaborate directly with the CRM Financial Manager during biennial CRMSIT testing; identify specific test claim scenarios, define modified TED record values, and analyze payment calculation results.

4. Testing, User Acceptance & Defect Management Collaborate with Quality Assurance and Test Engineers to translate functional business requirements into rigorous test scenarios and scripts within HP Quality Center (QC) / ALM.

 Support Government User Acceptance Testing (UAT): assist users during test execution, capture test artifacts/screenshots, validate business logic, and help classify test defects as major, moderate, or minor.

 Verify that software modifications fully satisfy documented business requirements prior to CMB approval and production deployment.

5. Reporting Validation & User Enablement Validate ad hoc queries and standard reports generated via Oracle Analytics Server (OAS), BI Publisher, and SplashBI to ensure business logic accuracy and accounting integrity.

 Assist in developing application user training materials, user guides, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to support financial and operational users across DHA commands and MTFs.

 Ensure all functional reporting outputs adhere to Section 508 and WCAG 2.1 Level AA accessibility criteria.

description:
About Sciene At Sciene, the mission is to empower professional services firms with cutting-edge, customized AI solutions - enhancing automation, analytics, and optimization across industries while prioritizing security, cost efficiency, and state-of-the-art technology. Our flagship product, the Sciene AI Companion , is an autonomous customer success platform deployed across Quartile - the world's largest retail media optimization platform, managing performance marketing for 1,000+ brands.

It automates relationship-heavy enterprise workflows end to end: generating personalized email replies in the CSM's own voice (8x faster), building full presentation decks for client meetings (12x faster), and detecting and diagnosing account fluctuations before anyone has to ask (6x faster). None of this replaces human judgment - it removes the work that was getting in the way of it. Read more about how we built it: Sciene AI Companion: Building an Autonomous Customer Success Platform on Databricks OVERVIEW Sciene runs a production agentic AI platform : a config-driven engine where every product is an agent with its own identity, skills, tools, and quality gates, executing ReAct loops against real business data across multiple LLM providers.

The platform is built; what it needs now is deeper machine learning judgment behind every model decision it makes. The Senior ML Specialist is the team's authority on how these models actually work and how to measure them. You will decide which models run which tasks and prove it with statistically sound benchmarks, design the evaluation methodology the whole team relies on, build classifiers and fine-tuned models where they beat prompting, and diagnose model behavior from first principles rather than by trial and error.

You will do this inside a production codebase - shipping, operating, and monitoring what you design. WHO THIS ROLE IS FOR This is a machine learning role first and a software engineering role second. We are looking for someone whose core professional background is in machine learning and statistics - not a software engineer who adopted LLM APIs in the last few years.

You should be able to explain from first principles how a large language model is trained and why it behaves the way it does, reason about model outputs as probabilistic objects, and tell whether a difference between two models on a benchmark is real or noise. REQUIREMENTS 5+ years of applied machine learning experience , with a substantial part predating the current generative AI wave - training, evaluating, and deploying models, not only integrating LLM APIs Strong foundation in statistics and probability : hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, sampling and sample-size reasoning, bias/variance, calibration, and the ability to state when a measured difference is statistically meaningful Deep understanding of LLM and generative AI theory : transformer architecture and attention, tokenization, embeddings, the training pipeline (pretraining, supervised fine-tuning, RLHF/DPO), decoding strategies (temperature, top-p, sampling vs. greedy), scaling behavior, and the known failure modes - hallucination, sycophancy, long-context degradation, prompt sensitivity - and why they occur Hands-on classical ML and NLP : classification, clustering, feature engineering, text classification, embeddings and semantic similarity - and the judgment to know when a small trained model outperforms an LLM on cost, latency, or accuracy Experience fine-tuning models (LoRA/PEFT, supervised fine-tuning, or full fine-tuning) and building the datasets for it - and equally, knowing when prompting or retrieval is the better answer Experience designing evaluation methodology for AI systems : building offline eval sets, LLM-as-judge and its known biases, inter-rater agreement, regression benchmarks, and significance testing on results Production-grade Python : PyTorch, scikit-learn, Hugging Face, and modern async Python; comfortable shipping into a FastAPI/Pydantic codebase with tests and CI - this role ships code, not only notebooks Hands-on experience with at least one major LLM provider API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), including structured outputs and tool/function calling, and an understanding of the trade-offs between models and providers Master's or PhD in Machine Learning, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field - or equivalent demonstrated depth (publications, competition results, released models or research code) The autonomy expected of a senior: you own a problem end to end - from framing to shipped, measured outcome - and are accountable for the result PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Publications, research, or open-source contributions in NLP or machine learning; strong Kaggle or equivalent competition record Experience with retrieval systems: embedding model selection, chunking strategies, reranking, and retrieval quality evaluation Experience with agent evaluation: trajectory analysis, tool-use accuracy, multi-step task success metrics Experience with model cost and latency optimization: model routing, distillation, prompt caching, quantizationExperience with Databricks (MLflow, model serving, Delta Sharing) and with Azure (Container Apps, Key Vault) and Docker Experience with observability stacks: OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Loki, structured logging Experience with the Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar agent-integration standards Track record of shipping something from 0 to 1 in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift often WHAT YOU'LL DO Own model strategy across the platform: evaluate and select models per task (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and emerging providers) using our benchmark and LLM-as-judge harness, and make the decision defensible with proper statistical treatment of the results Design and maintain the evaluation methodology the team relies on: offline eval sets, judge calibration and reliability, regression benchmarks, and quality metrics that go beyond "it looks right" Build classification and fine-tuned models where they beat prompting - for routing, categorization, and detection tasks - including dataset construction, training, evaluation, and deployment Design, develop, and ship agentic AI products on our platform: agent identities, reusable skills, tool integrations, and structured outputs - often config-driven, with platform-level code changes when the engine needs to grow Do prompt and context engineering grounded in how models actually process context: system prompt assembly, context injection from live data sources, thread/memory management, and structured output design with Pydantic schemas Own output quality: design deterministic enforcers, validation quality gates, and LLM-as-judge evaluators, and measure whether the judges themselves are reliable Diagnose model behavior from first principles - hallucination, inconsistency, drift across model versions - and turn the diagnosis into fixes in prompts, retrieval, guardrails, or model choice Build and extend agent tools that query Databricks, MongoDB, and external systems, and integrate agents with the broader ecosystem via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) Operate what you ship: instrument services with OpenTelemetry, monitor quality, latency, and cost in Grafana, and improve them over time Collaborate with data engineers, software engineers, and product to deliver end-to-end AI solutions, and raise the team's ML fundamentals through reviews and knowledge sharing Follow the research literature critically and bring in techniques that hold up on our data - not every paper does Document and maintain the codebase, ensuring code quality and adherence to best practices *This is a PJ contract based in Brazil.*

 Boston · On-site · Full-time
 










 We are looking for an early-career engineer who wants to build robots that perform real manufacturing work. You will contribute to manipulation, controls, perception, planning, and AI-assisted robotics development while working directly with hardware.
 










 What you may work on:
 





 Integrate sensors, end-effectors, robots, and manufacturing equipment into complete working systems.

 Evidence of hands-on robotics work through projects, research, coursework, open-source contributions, professional experience, or independent builds.
 

 The ability to design useful experiments and debug interactions among software, electronics, mechanics, sensors, and the physical environment.
 

 Curiosity, good experimental habits, and a willingness to take ownership of ambiguous technical problems.
 

 Applicants should indicate the kinds of systems they want to own and develop.
 









 Who this is for:
 




 Early-career engineers with hands-on robotics experience, strong experimental habits, and the curiosity to own ambiguous technical problems.
 










 About Strive:
 




 Strive Robotics is an AI systems integrator for manufacturing. We build robots and software that let customers deploy and reconfigure robotic workflows without outside integrators or robotics experience. Our approach combines classical controls, model-based perception, and fine-tuned vision-language-action models, choosing the tools that get reliable robotic solutions into customers' hands as quickly as possible.

An exciting opportunity is available for a Research Scientist specializing in AI and Machine Learning for biologics. This fully remote contract role requires working Eastern Standard business hours and offers the chance to contribute to cutting-edge advancements in antisense oligonucleotide (ASO) therapeutics and antibody discovery. The position focuses on integrating advanced ML and AI techniques to accelerate discovery and optimization across multiple biologic modalities.



The successful candidate will develop sequence-aware predictive models to prioritize oligonucleotide therapeutics based on exon-skipping response, extending these approaches across diverse ASO modalities. Responsibilities include designing and implementing AI/ML methods for de novo antibody discovery, fine-tuning protein language models, and developing generative protein design workflows. The role also involves deploying machine learning methods to support multi-objective optimization of antibodies, antigens, ADCs, and other biologic modalities.



Additional duties include building reproducible computational frameworks for biologics, curating and harmonizing datasets, defining robust sequence and structure features, and establishing benchmarks to assess model performance. The scientist will collaborate closely with experimental teams to validate predictions and adopt both proprietary and open-source tools to enhance modeling workflows. Maintaining a well-documented codebase and providing user guidance for cross-functional teams is essential.



Candidates should hold a PhD in Computational Chemistry, Computational Biology, Machine Learning, Biomedical or Chemical Engineering, with at least three years of relevant industry experience. A strong background in oligonucleotide chemistry, antibody design, and computational modeling of antibody-antigen interactions is required. Expertise in probabilistic and deep learning models, programming in Python, R, and SQL, and experience with modern deep learning frameworks are essential. Familiarity with large-scale computing, cloud infrastructure, and collaborative tools is expected. Strong communication skills and a commitment to teamwork and continuous learning are vital for success in this role.

Big Data Engineer with Bachelor Degree in Computer Science, Computer Information Systems, Information Technology, or a combination of education and experience equating to the U.S. equivalent of a Bachelor's degree in one of the aforementioned subjects.


 
 
 Job Duties and Responsibilities:


 
 Collaborate with System Architects to design, develop, test, and implement efficient Snowflake data models aligned with enterprise data warehousing standards.
 Build and manage cloud and hybrid integrations using third-party ETL tools like Azure Data Factory for seamless Snowflake data pipelines.
 Maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub and Azure DevOps to ensure code quality, version control, and automated deployment for Snowflake solutions.
 Conduct SQL performance analysis, query optimization, and database tuning to improve efficiency and scalability in Snowflake models.
 Develop robust, scalable Snowflake integrations and data models following industry best practices.
 Perform root cause analysis on data model issues and resolve performance bottlenecks to maintain reliable Snowflake systems.
 Engage with customers and architects to refine requirements and communicate effectively for business alignment.
 Apply strong time management to prioritize concurrent tasks and deliver Snowflake projects promptly.
 Use analytical and problem-solving skills to address complex warehouse challenges within the Snowflake ecosystem.
 
 
 
 Work experience / Technologies required for the position:


 
 At least 5+ years of experience in building and optimizing Big Data, Data pipelines, architectures and data sets.
 Experience in performing root cause analysis on internal and external data and processes to answer specific business questions and identify opportunities for improvement.
 Strong analytic skills related to working with unstructured datasets.
 Build processes supporting data transformation, data structures, meta data, dependency and workload management.
 A successful history of manipulating, processing and extracting value from large disconnected data sets.
 Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and highly scalable Big Data, data stores.
 Experience in supporting and working with cross-functional teams in a dynamic environment.
 Experience with big data tools: Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, etc.
 Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases, including AzureSQL and Snowflake.
 Experience with Azure cloud services: ADLS, AzureSynapse, Azure Databricks, Delta Lake
 Experience with stream-processing systems: Storm, Spark-Streaming, etc.
 Experience with object-oriented/object function scripting languages: Python, Java, C++, Scala, etc.
 
 
 Work location is Portland, ME with required travel to client locations throughout USA. 


 Rite Pros is an equal opportunity employer (EOE).

 565 Congress St, Suite # 305 

 Portland, ME 04101.

description:
Riverside Overview

Riverside Research is an independent National Security Nonprofit dedicated to research and development in the national interest. We provide high-end technical services, research and development, and prototype solutions to some of the country's most challenging technical problems.
 
 All Riverside Research opportunities require U.S. Citizenship.

Position Overview

Riverside Research's Applied Mathematics and Physics Solutions group is seeking a Senior Computational Scientist/Scientific Programmer to advance high-impact computational electromagnetics (CEM), scientific computing, and physics-based modeling and simulation capabilities in support of challenging government and defense applications.

The successful candidate will combine strong technical expertise with independent problem-solving, technical leadership, and business acumen. This individual will lead and contribute to the development of advanced computational methods, guide multidisciplinary technical teams, and translate complex customer problems into effective technical solutions.

The position offers the opportunity to shape technical direction, lead research and development efforts, engage directly with customers, and help grow a portfolio of technical programs and capabilities. The successful candidate will be expected to operate with a high degree of autonomy, communicate effectively across technical and business audiences, and take ownership of technical outcomes.

Candidate can work in our facilities in Fairfax, VA or Dayton, OH.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership: Provide technical direction and subject matter expertise in computational electromagnetics, applied mathematics, computational physics, and scientific modeling and simulation. Formulate approaches to complex technical problems, evaluate alternatives, manage technical risk, and drive solutions from concept through implementation and validation.Research and Algorithm Development: Research, develop, implement, evaluate, and improve state-of-the-art numerical methods, computational algorithms, and physics-based models to address challenging electromagnetic and related scientific problems.Technical Program Leadership: Serve as a Principal Investigator (PI), technical lead, or equivalent technical authority for research, development, and customer-funded efforts. Establish technical objectives, develop execution strategies, manage technical risks, and ensure delivery of high-quality results.Customer Engagement and Business Growth: Engage with government and defense customers to understand mission needs, communicate technical approaches, build customer confidence, and identify opportunities for follow-on work and new technical capabilities.Technical Planning and Proposal Development: Contribute to technical volumes, cost and schedule estimates, statements of work, multi-year technical roadmaps, and government proposals. Help shape fundable research and development concepts aligned with customer needs and organizational strategy.Software and Computational Development: Contribute to scientific software development through algorithm design, requirements definition, interface specifications, verification and validation planning, code reviews, and performance evaluation. Collaborate with software engineers to ensure that computational methods are implemented as reliable, maintainable, and usable software.Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Provide technical guidance and coordinate work across scientists, software engineers, electrical and RF engineers, program managers, and other stakeholders. Align technical execution with program objectives, schedules, resources, and customer commitments.Technical Communication: Prepare and present technical reports, research findings, briefings, and recommendations for audiences ranging from technical specialists to customers and senior leadership.Mentoring and Team Development: Mentor junior and mid-level staff, promote technical rigor and sound engineering practices, and help develop the next generation of technical leaders.Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Active Top Secret/SCI Security Clearance and consent to CI PolyEducation and Experience: Degree in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computer science, or a related STEM disciplineBachelor's with 8+ years of experience, orMaster's with 6+ years of experiencePhD with 3+ years of experienceRelevant years of experience may be substituted in lieu of a degree.Demonstrated experience developing, applying, or validating physics-based computational models, numerical methods, or scientific simulation software.Strong foundation in applied mathematics, numerical analysis, computational physics, or a closely related technical discipline.Demonstrated proficiency in scientific computing and programming, including experience in a relevant compiled language such as C, C++, or Fortran and/or an equivalent scientific programming environment.Ability to independently frame complex technical problems, evaluate potential approaches, exercise sound technical judgment, and deliver results with limited direction.Demonstrated technical leadership, such as leading a research task, directing technical work, serving as a technical lead or PI, or taking ownership of a significant technical deliverable.Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to technical and nontechnical audiences.Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively across disciplines, build productive working relationships, and mentor or support the development of other technical staff.Ability to balance technical rigor with customer needs, practical constraints, and program objectives.Ability to travel (less than 10%) 

Desired
Active Top Secret/SCI Security Clearance w/ CI PolyPhD in physics, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, computational science, or a related discipline with 8+ years of experience.Experience with numerical techniques such as method of moments, surface or volumetric integral equations, finite-difference time-domain methods, finite-element methods, asymptotic methods, domain decomposition, hierarchical Adaptive Cross Approximation (hACA), or multi-level fast multipole methods (MLFMM).Experience with high-performance scientific computing, parallel algorithms, distributed computing, or performance optimization on large computing systems, including MPI and/or OpenMP.Demonstrated contributions to business development, including customer engagement, opportunity shaping, proposal development, technical volume leadership, or development of follow-on work.Publications, technical reports, patents, or other demonstrated contributions to scientific or engineering advancement.

description: Required Skills:• 5-7 years in operations, program management, analytics, consulting or applied AI, where you were responsible for results.• You use AI every day and have built something with it that has actually moved the needle, such as a workflow, an automation or an analysis. You know where it breaks, and you keep pushing it further.• You're comfortable with numbers: accuracy, precision and recall, sampling. SQL and notebooks help. If you haven't used them yet, you'll pick them up quickly with AI assistance.• You're curious about how work actually gets done, including the awkward exceptions, and you've taken a messy process and made it measurable.• You've worked on quality in some form, such as review guidelines, QA or audits.• You write clearly and can work with business leads, PMs and engineers in the same week.• You're fine working with limited direction, and you try things yourself instead of waiting for someone to build them. A technical background isn't required.• You don't need to have designed evaluations or calibrated LLM judges before. We'll teach you, and you'll work with a team that has done it many times.Preferred experience• Hands-on SQL, Python or API experience.• Trust and safety, content moderation, annotation operations or other human-in-the-loop work at scale.• Fine-tuning models or calibrating LLM judges.• Background in a two-sided marketplace, travel, or another operations-heavy business.• Experience setting up intake and prioritization for a new team.Duties:We're the AI & ML Enablement team in Supply Tech. We help teams across Client use AI to do real work, and prove that it works. Right now, we're helping business and field teams use AI to take on the review and quality work they run, and helping product teams understand whether an AI feature works before it reaches our users. Day to day, we move manual review processes to AI and put people where their judgment matters most. We design new workflows so AI does the work from the start. We also build the labeled datasets that show whether the AI is right, and we keep everything running as models and policies change. Our methods and projects change as the models do, and we expect the scope of this role to grow with them.The difference you will make:You'd work alongside our team on whichever problems AI could take on, whether that's a business team with a process that's slow, expensive or inconsistent, or a product team getting an AI feature ready to launch. The job looks much the same either way. You start with how the work really gets done, help build an AI version of it, and test it until you trust the results. Then you hand it off and use what worked on the next problem. The mix of projects will keep changing as AI takes on more of the work, so we care more about how you work than about a fixed list of projects. This is a hands-on role. You help build the workflow, ship it, and stay on to make sure it works.A typical day:• Help the team decide which projects will drive the largest business impact, and make the case for the ones worth doing.• Sit with the team that owns a problem, map how the work gets done today, and work out how AI can do it and where people step in for the hard cases.• Build the AI workflow: write the prompts, set up the pipeline, and keep it at the agreed quality level, watching for drift once it's live.• Build the test sets, measure accuracy, and calibrate LLM judges against human reviewers.• Support product teams in agreeing on what "good enough to launch" means for an AI feature, and bring the evidence for the go/no-go call.• Turn unclear policy into criteria a reviewer can apply consistently, working with product, Legal and Policy.• Work with subject matter experts to write labeling guidelines and produce human-verified labels on real data.• Run labeling at scale with vendor agents, and check their work against agreement metrics and your own spot checks.• Make what you build reusable and document what you learn, so the next team gets to production faster.• Keep our methods current as models, tools and vendor agents change, and retire what stops working.• Own the workstreams you're assigned, from setup through quality checks. Model infrastructure and product roadmaps stay with the teams that own them.**Only those lawfully authorized to work in the designated country associated with the position will be considered.** **Please note that all Position start dates and duration are estimates and may be reduced or lengthened based upon a client's business needs and requirements.**

Are you passionate about applying AI, machine learning, and NLP to solve complex challenges in oncology? Join our team and make an impact.

The Computational Scientist promotes machine and deep learning artificial intelligence (AI) research through Roswell Park and provides senior level AI technical expertise as required to facilitate demand within the Biomedical Research Informatics Shared Resource. Works in concert with other departments throughout the organization and serves as a subject matter expert in the area of ML/AI in oncology. Promotes engagement of the research community, facilitates oncology research, use-case development, assists with user support, developing, and delivering advanced training.

This role is primarily centered on Clinical Natural Language Processing (NLP): developing, evaluating, and deploying methods to transform unstructured clinical text, radiology reports, and pathology reports into high-quality structured data for research use. description:
Description 

 
We are seeking a Big Data Engineer to design, build, and maintain real-time and near-realtime data ingestion pipelines supporting a mission-critical system and moves data across security domains using cross domain solutions (CDS) / guards. You will be responsible for the reliable flow of streaming data from a wide range of sources into our data platform, ensuring data quality, observability, and scalability.

You'll partner closely with data engineers, platform engineers, analytics teams, and security/governance personnel to deliver trustworthy, low-latency data that supports operational decisions — while ensuring compliance with cross-domain and data classification requirements. This position is on-site in Honolulu, HI.

Key Responsibilities

Aid the team in delivering continual data feeds to users and monitoring the health of data quality and overall data ingest.Design, build, and maintain resilient real-time/near-realtime ingestion pipelines using Apache NiFi and REST APIs, with appropriate backpressure, prioritization, retries, and error-handling strategies.Configure and monitor data flows moving across security domains via cross domain guards/solutions, ensuring data integrity and compliance with transfer policies.Parse, transform, validate, and route structured and unstructured data in a variety of formats, including Excel, CSV, JSON, and XML.Employ data manipulation and visualization tools (e.g., Grafana, Prometheus) to effectively convey pipeline status, data quality, and historical trends to leadership, users, and the data team.Collaborate with platform, software, and other data engineers to (re)configure and continuously improve data ingestion pipeline reliability.Develop and maintain software/scripts to automate monitoring of real-time feeds and alert on timeliness, volume, lineage, and distribution data issues.Translate learnings from historical pipeline data into actionable steps to improve data ingest reliability and performance.Partner with security and governance teams to enforce encryption, authentication, authorization, and data classification requirements across pipelines and cross-domain transfers.Write and maintain scripts (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate data processing, validation, and monitoring tasks.Document data flows, system configurations, and standard operating procedures. 

 
 Qualifications 

 
TYPICAL EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE: Bachelors and nine (9) years or more experience; Masters and seven (7) years or more experience ; PhD or JD and four (4) years or more experience.U.S. Citizenship and an active TS/SCI clearance.Bachelor of Science degree in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Physics, Information Systems, Information Technology, or related field.3+ years of experience in data engineering, data operations, or DevOps roles supporting production data pipelines.Proficiency in Python, Bash, or similar scripting languages commonly used in data science/data analytics applications.Working knowledge of the Linux (RedHat) command line; familiarity with Windows environments.Solid understanding of data engineering fundamentals: data pipelines, streaming architectures, ETL/ELT concepts, and data quality principles.Familiarity with JSON, XML, CSV, and Excel data formats, parsing, and transformation.Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have)

Experience with streaming/messaging platforms and tools: Kafka, JMS, Apache Flink/Spark Streaming.Experience with monitoring/observability tools: Grafana, Prometheus, Elasticsearch.Experience with data platforms such as Snowflake.Familiarity with cross domain solutions/guards (e.g., data diode concepts, transfer validation, content filtering).Experience enforcing encryption, authentication/authorization, and data classification policies in partnership with security/governance teams.Experience with version control tools (e.g., Git) and Agile/Scrum practices.Prior experience in a government, defense, or intelligence community environment. 

 Target salary range: $120,001 - $160,000. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.
